detail.abstract: This study challenges the traditional research perspectives of accounting information systems (AIS). The current study is one of the first to investigate and examine changes in the operating theory of artificial intelligence-based accounting information systems (AI-AIS) in an interdisciplinary setting. This study investigated how AI-AIS has changed because of the heterogeneous network with analytical capabilities of interdisciplinary actors. This study incorporates a wide range of technical, cultural, and informational metrics to investigate the new nature of operating theory. Thus, this study's contribution is sufficiently generic to provide a new understanding of such a theory. The proposed model defines AI-AIS as a dynamic engine that creates an innovation space in which interdisciplinary actors' interests interact and are exploited. The effects of these relationships were statistically tested with the proposed constructs to identify AI-AIS changes, and the study has also investigated the mediating effects of boundary object constructs. The research model was empirically tested by using structured equation modeling (SEM). The findings of the study expose that the perceived interdisciplinary integration is found to be the driver of theory change. The cognitive results acknowledge change, which adds some excitement to this area of research. Recognizing a new image and discussing the implications for new interactivity in an interdisciplinary setting are key to this study. The study finding is also consistent with the global perspective, which synthesizes the potential impacts of interdisciplinary technologies and the analytical capabilities of AI. Finally, understanding how such impacts relate to AIS can help organizations improve the success rate of new technology investment initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了传统会计信息系统研究视角，首次在跨学科背景下探讨人工智能会计信息系统操作理论的变化，发现跨学科整合是驱动理论变革的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 在跨学科背景下，人工智能会计信息系统的操作理论如何因跨学科参与者的分析能力而异质网络而发生变化？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统会计信息系统研究视角，填补人工智能会计信息系统在跨学科背景下操作理论变化的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质网络理论、边界对象理论和动态引擎概念，将AI-AIS视为创造创新空间的动态引擎。
AI.method: 采用结构方程模型进行实证检验，使用技术、文化和信息等多维度指标，并检验边界对象的中介效应。
AI.findings: 感知的跨学科整合是驱动理论变革的主要因素；AI-AIS作为动态引擎在跨学科环境中创造创新空间；研究结果与全球视角一致，综合了跨学科技术和AI分析能力的潜在影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI-AIS操作理论的新理解；发展了跨学科背景下信息系统理论变革的框架；为异质网络理论和边界对象理论在AI-AIS研究中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织提高新技术投资成功率；为跨学科团队协作提供指导；为AI-AIS的设计和实施提供实践启示。

title: Knowledge graph-enhanced recommendation via multi-level interactive contrastive learning and attention mechanisms
affiliations: Nanjing University of Finance and Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Nanjing University of Finance and Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Knowledge graph-enhanced recommendation via multi-level interactive contrastive learning and attention mechanisms
detail.abstract: Knowledge Graph-based Recommendation (KGR) leverages rich semantic associations in knowledge graphs to enhance recommendation performance and is widely used in e-commerce. Recently, there has been growing interest in leveraging graph contrastive learning to enhance KGR, and achieves success to some extent. However, existing studies still encounter the following limitations. First, neglecting the structured information of neighboring triplets, which may result in the absence of crucial information. Second, The higher-order relationships and global organization of entities in knowledge graphs have yet to be fully exploited. To tackle these challenges, this study presents a novel Knowledge Graph-enhanced Recommendation model via Multi-Attention and Contrastive Learning (KGR-MACL). Its key innovations include an enhanced attention mechanism for knowledge graphs and multi-level interactive contrastive learning. Specifically, KGR-MACL first generates local and global entity embeddings using an enhanced knowledge-aware graph attention network that combines entities with their neighboring triplets to capture relational and topological structures, enabling high-order representation learning. It then employs a multi-level interactive contrastive learning framework: (1) local interactive contrastive learning balances collaborative filtering and knowledge graph influences at both levels; and (2) global interactive contrastive learning integrates local and global information by comparing local entity sets with their global counterparts. Empirical results on three real-world datasets confirm that KGR-MACL achieves substantial performance gains over leading baseline methods. Keywords: Recommender system, Knowledge graph, Neural graph network, Contrastive learning, Attention mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGR-MACL模型，通过增强注意力机制和多层次交互对比学习，解决现有知识图谱推荐中忽略三元组结构信息和高阶关系的问题，显著提升推荐性能。
AI.research_question: 如何有效利用知识图谱中的结构化信息和高阶关系来提升基于知识图谱的推荐系统性能？
AI.motivation: 现有基于图对比学习的知识图谱推荐方法存在两个主要局限：1) 忽视相邻三元组的结构化信息，导致关键信息缺失；2) 未充分利用知识图谱中的高阶关系和全局组织信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识图谱的推荐理论、图神经网络理论、对比学习理论、注意力机制理论。
AI.method: 提出KGR-MACL模型：1) 使用增强的知识感知图注意力网络生成局部和全局实体嵌入；2) 采用多层次交互对比学习框架，包括局部交互对比学习和全局交互对比学习。
AI.findings: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，KGR-MACL相比领先的基线方法取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出结合实体与相邻三元组的增强注意力机制；2) 设计多层次交互对比学习框架；3) 探索知识图谱中结构化信息和高阶关系的有效利用方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为电子商务推荐系统提供更有效的知识图谱增强方案；2) 提出的模型架构可应用于实际推荐场景；3) 实验验证了方法在真实数据集上的有效性。

title: The Digital Embodiment Race: Political Economy, Technological Convergence, and the Global Rise of Humanoid Robotics
affiliations: Libyan Authority for Scientific Research

detail.title: The Digital Embodiment Race: Political Economy, Technological Convergence, and the Global Rise of Humanoid Robotics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract:
The evolution of humanoid robotics has entered a transformative phase, transitioning from experimental prototypes to structural socio-technical institutions. This paper provides a rigorous interdisciplinary analysis of the humanoid industry, examining the convergence of "Embodied AI" and global capital structures. Through a strategic case study of industry leaders such as Tesla, Figure, and Unitree, the research reveals a bifurcated investment landscape: Western firms prioritize megavaluation private funding, while Chinese counterparts leverage rapid public market entries (IPOs). Beyond the technical shift from deterministic programming to "BrainBody-LLM" foundation models, (Mon-Williams et al., 2025) this study investigates the profound implications for labor markets and the emergence of "Robotic Capital Rents.

" Furthermore, it addresses critical gaps in the current discourse by analyzing the legal agency of autonomous embodied systems and the potential for a "Digital Divide 2.0" between the technological core and the Global South. By synthesizing financial data, geopolitical strategies, and institutional theory, the paper forecasts the industry's trajectory and offers high-level strategic recommendations for policymakers and investors navigating this disruptive shift in the global political economy.

AI.tldr: 本文对类人机器人产业进行了跨学科分析，揭示了西方企业依赖巨额私人融资而中国企业快速上市的分化投资格局，探讨了从确定性编程到"脑体-LLM"基础模型的技术转变对劳动力市场和"机器人资本租金"的影响，并分析了自主系统的法律主体性和可能出现的"数字鸿沟2.0"。
AI.research_question: 类人机器人产业如何从实验原型演变为结构性社会技术制度？"具身AI"与全球资本结构的融合如何影响投资格局、劳动力市场和全球政治经济？
AI.motivation: 类人机器人正经历从实验原型到社会技术制度的转型，但当前研究缺乏对这一产业融合"具身AI"与全球资本结构的系统性分析，以及对劳动力市场、法律主体性和全球数字鸿沟等关键问题的深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、社会技术系统理论、资本结构理论、法律主体性理论、数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 跨学科分析、战略案例研究（特斯拉、Figure、Unitree等行业领导者）、财务数据分析、地缘政治策略分析、制度理论综合
AI.findings: 1. 投资格局分化：西方企业优先考虑巨额私人融资，而中国企业利用快速公开市场上市（IPO）；2. 技术从确定性编程转向"脑体-LLM"基础模型；3. 对劳动力市场产生深远影响，出现"机器人资本租金"；4. 自主系统面临法律主体性挑战；5. 可能产生技术核心与全球南方之间的"数字鸿沟2.0"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了类人机器人产业作为社会技术制度的分析框架；2. 提出了"机器人资本租金"概念；3. 发展了自主系统法律主体性的理论分析；4. 拓展了数字鸿沟理论在机器人时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供产业轨迹预测；2. 为投资者提供高层次的战略建议；3. 为应对全球政治经济中的颠覆性转变提供指导；4. 为平衡技术发展与全球公平提供政策建议。

title: AI: What We Know, What We Don't, and Why It Matters
affiliations: Católica-Lisbon School of Business and Economics

detail.title: AI: What We Know, What We Don't, and Why It Matters
detail.abstract: This document focuses on what the best available research tells us about AI's effects on productivity, labour markets, and organizational capability. My initial reading on AI and labour markets drew on Bharat Chandar's Stanford Digital Economy Lab essay, but the analysis here extends well beyond that scope, covering productivity, firm capability, and managerial implications, and incorporating my own views on these topics. These are not the only dimensions that matter. AI is also reshaping product innovation, competitive positioning, and market structure. Here, I focus on the areas where the evidence is most developed and the managerial implications are most immediately actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文基于现有最佳研究，分析AI对生产力、劳动力市场和组织能力的影响，重点关注证据最充分、管理启示最直接可操作的领域。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响生产力、劳动力市场和组织能力？这些影响的管理启示是什么？
AI.motivation: AI正在重塑商业环境，但对其实际影响的理解需要基于最佳可用研究证据，为管理者提供可操作的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字经济学、组织能力理论和生产力经济学框架，结合AI技术特性分析其对经济和组织的影响机制。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析，整合现有最佳研究证据，包括Bharat Chandar的斯坦福数字经济实验室论文等，并结合作者自身观点进行扩展分析。
AI.findings: AI对生产力、劳动力市场和组织能力有显著影响，证据最充分的领域包括：生产力提升、劳动力市场结构变化、组织能力重塑等，这些领域的管理启示最为直接可操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI对经济和组织影响的理论框架，整合了生产力、劳动力市场和组织能力的多维度分析，为AI经济学研究提供了更全面的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了基于证据的AI实施指导，帮助企业在生产力提升、劳动力配置和组织能力建设方面做出更明智的决策，重点关注最直接可操作的管理启示。

title: The Algorithm Has No Gender, But Its Outcomes Do: Platform Capitalism, Structural Bias, and Women's Digital Entrepreneurship

detail.title: The Algorithm Has No Gender, But Its Outcomes Do: Platform Capitalism, Structural Bias, and Women's Digital Entrepreneurship

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of Interest
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received

detail.abstract:
Purpose: The study critically examines how digital platforms, often touted as democratizing forces for entrepreneurship, reinforce and intensify gendered inequalities through algorithmic oppression. It introduces the Online Patriarchy Model to explain how platform design, algorithms, and governance structures replicate and reconfigure patriarchal norms, focusing on the challenges and adaptive strategies of women entrepreneurs operating in digital economies. It also introduces the Intersectional Gender Equity Assessment Framework (IGEAF), a systemic analytical framework designed to evaluate, monitor, and reform algorithmic systems by foregrounding how gendered and intersecting inequalities are produced, sustained, or amplified through digital platforms. 

 Methodology: Employing a qualitative case study design, the research draws on interdisciplinary literature in digital sociology, gender studies, and platform economics, and synthesizes qualitative evidence from peer-reviewed journal articles and books, as well as a case study of the Gamergate controversy. The study develops and applies the Online Patriarchy Model and the concept of Online Patriarchal Bargains to systematically analyse the interplay between digital platforms and gendered entrepreneurial experiences. 

 Findings: Algorithms trained on biased historical data and designed predominantly by male-dominated teams systematically disadvantage women-led ventures by limiting their visibility, access to funding, and opportunities through data-driven and structural discrimination. Women entrepreneurs respond to these constraints with resilient strategies such as performative self-presentation, algorithmic gaming, digital solidarity networks, and boundary-setting, but these acts often reinforce the gendered codes they seek to overcome. The study argues that digital entrepreneurship, despite its inclusive rhetoric, imposes new forms of emotional and invisible labor on women while demanding conformity with masculinist metrics of success. 

 Research Implications: The research highlights the need for fundamental transformations in platform design, algorithmic auditing, and regulatory governance to address algorithmic oppression. It underscores the necessity of centering women entrepreneurs’ voices and leadership in technology development, policy, and scholarly inquiry, and proposes multi-pronged interventions, such as gender-aware algorithmic audits and inclusive platform governance mechanisms. 

 Practical Implications: To overcome algorithmic oppression, platform managers and policymakers must embed gender impact assessments, enforce robust anti-harassment systems, and create mechanisms for transparent, accountable, and contestable algorithmic decisions. Tech industry practices must prioritize social justice, inclusive design, and equity over narrow efficiency and profit maximisation, while also building competencies in algorithmic equity across the sector.

 Social Implications: The study reveals how online patriarchal bargains strategic compromises to survive in digital spaces are both symptoms of and responses to platform-mediated inequalities, resulting in heightened costs of emotional labor and self-curation for women. These dynamics not only reinforce gender hierarchies but may also limit the diversity of voices in digital economies and public discourse, calling for collective action to reimagine digital spaces as equitable, empowering environments. 

 Originality/Value: The research makes original theoretical contributions through the Online Patriarchy Model and the Intersectional Gender Equity Assessment Framework (IGEAF). IGEAF integrates intersectionality, participatory governance, and continuous auditing across three iterative phases: pre-deployment assessment, deployment and monitoring, and post deployment review. These phases enable the identification of allocative, representational, procedural, and emotional harms embedded within data practices, design choices, and governance structures. By combining gender-disaggregated performance metrics, stakeholder co-design, transparency and explanatory audits, and institutional accountability mechanisms, IGEAF reframes algorithmic governance as a socio-technical responsibility rather than a purely technical problem. In doing so, it demonstrates that digital systems do not merely optimise efficiency but actively shape and can be redesigned to advance equity, dignity, and inclusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性地分析了数字平台如何通过算法压迫强化性别不平等，提出了在线父权制模型和交叉性别公平评估框架，揭示了女性企业家在数字经济中面临的结构性歧视和适应性策略。
AI.research_question: 数字平台如何通过算法压迫强化和重构性别不平等？女性企业家在数字平台经济中面临哪些挑战和采取了哪些适应性策略？如何系统性地评估和改革算法系统中的性别不平等问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字平台常被宣传为创业民主化力量，但实际上它们通过算法设计、平台治理和结构歧视强化了性别不平等。需要批判性地分析平台如何复制父权制规范，并开发系统性框架来解决算法压迫问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 在线父权制模型、交叉性别公平评估框架（IGEAF）、在线父权制交易概念、数字社会学、性别研究、平台经济学、交叉性理论。
AI.method: 采用定性案例研究设计，综合数字社会学、性别研究和平台经济学的跨学科文献，分析同行评审期刊文章和书籍的定性证据，并以Gamergate争议为案例研究。
AI.findings: 基于偏见历史数据训练且主要由男性团队设计的算法，通过数据驱动和结构性歧视系统性地限制了女性创业项目的可见性、融资渠道和机会。女性企业家采取表演性自我呈现、算法博弈、数字团结网络和边界设定等弹性策略，但这些策略往往强化了她们试图克服的性别规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出在线父权制模型解释平台设计、算法和治理结构如何复制和重构父权制规范；2）开发交叉性别公平评估框架（IGEAF），整合交叉性、参与式治理和持续审计；3）引入在线父权制交易概念分析女性在数字空间中的战略妥协。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）平台管理者和政策制定者应嵌入性别影响评估；2）实施强有力的反骚扰系统；3）创建透明、可问责和可争议的算法决策机制；4）技术行业实践应优先考虑社会正义、包容性设计和公平性；5）建议进行性别意识算法审计和包容性平台治理。

title: Corporate Risk Management and Big Tech Victim Justice
affiliations: North Carolina State University

detail.title: Corporate Risk Management and Big Tech Victim Justice
detail.abstract: Big Tech companies’ product design intentions, including features like infinite scroll, notification alerts, and self-reinforcing feedback loops, have resulted in real harm for individuals, especially minors. This harm includes higher risks of envy, sleep disturbances, stress, aggression, ADHD, depression contagion, addiction, self-harm, eating disorders, suicide, sextortion, and Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). Three recent rulings are the beginning of a wave of litigation against Big Tech companies based on product design intentions that negatively affect societies and individuals, especially minors.

AI.tldr: 科技巨头产品设计意图（如无限滚动、通知提醒、自我强化反馈循环）对个人尤其是未成年人造成实际伤害，包括嫉妒、睡眠障碍、压力、攻击性、ADHD、抑郁传染、成瘾、自残、饮食失调、自杀、性勒索和儿童性虐待材料等风险。近期三起裁决开启了基于产品设计意图对科技巨头提起诉讼的浪潮。
AI.research_question: 科技公司的产品设计意图如何对个人（特别是未成年人）造成伤害，以及法律诉讼如何应对这一问题？
AI.motivation: 科技巨头通过无限滚动、通知提醒、自我强化反馈循环等产品设计特征，导致用户特别是未成年人面临多种心理和生理健康风险，包括抑郁、焦虑、成瘾、自残等严重后果，需要法律和监管层面的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品责任理论、行为设计理论、数字成瘾理论、未成年人保护法律框架、科技伦理理论
AI.method: 文献综述法、案例分析（三起近期裁决）、实证研究综述（引用多项关于社交媒体负面影响的实证研究）
AI.findings: 1. 科技产品设计特征与多种心理健康问题存在因果关系；2. 未成年人特别容易受到这些设计特征的影响；3. 近期法律裁决开始追究科技公司的产品设计责任；4. 这标志着针对科技巨头诉讼浪潮的开始。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将产品责任理论扩展到数字产品设计领域；2. 建立科技产品设计与心理健康伤害之间的理论联系；3. 为科技伦理和监管提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为受害者提供法律诉讼的理论依据；2. 为监管机构制定科技产品设计标准提供参考；3. 为科技公司改进产品设计以减少伤害提供指导；4. 提高公众对科技产品潜在危害的认识。

title: Legitimacy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Legitimacy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

publicationDetails.detailsText: MPI Behavioral Economics Discussion Paper No. 2026/3
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Behavioral Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is one of the must disruptive innovations in human history. The key change is in the cost of information processing. It drops dramatically. Along with this change, ever more granular data is available, including from the interactions between government and its citizens. This essay explores the implications for the acquisition of sovereign authority (read: elections) and for their exercise. In almost all dimensions, there is both: empowerment (of voters, but also of candidates; of Parliament, the administration, and the judiciary), but also novel potential for abuse. The paper discusses the implications for the legitimacy of democratic government.

AI.tldr: 人工智能通过大幅降低信息处理成本，改变了政府与公民互动数据的获取方式，对主权获取（选举）和行使产生双重影响：既赋能选民、候选人及各政府机构，也带来新的滥用风险，最终影响民主政府的合法性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何通过改变信息处理成本和数据可用性，影响主权获取（选举）和行使，进而影响民主政府的合法性？
AI.motivation: 人工智能是人类历史上最具颠覆性的创新之一，其核心变革在于信息处理成本的大幅下降，使得政府与公民互动的更细粒度数据变得可用，这为民主政治带来了新的机遇和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权权威理论、民主合法性理论、信息经济学（信息处理成本理论）、政治参与理论、权力制衡理论
AI.method: 理论分析论文，基于现有文献和逻辑推理，探讨人工智能对民主政治的影响机制
AI.findings: 人工智能在几乎所有维度都产生双重影响：一方面赋能选民、候选人、议会、行政和司法机构；另一方面也创造了新的滥用潜力，这种双重性对民主政府的合法性构成复杂挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人工智能时代信息处理成本变化对主权获取和行使影响的理论框架，丰富了民主合法性理论在数字时代的应用，为理解技术变革与政治制度互动提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对人工智能对选举和政治过程影响的指导，帮助识别技术赋能与滥用的平衡点，促进民主制度在技术变革中的适应和改革。

title: Predictive Analytics for Student Dropout Prevention Using Machine Learning
affiliations: , J.N.N. Institute of Engineering and Pokhara University

detail.title: Predictive Analytics for Student Dropout Prevention Using Machine Learning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest, financial relationship, or personal affiliation with any organization that could be perceived to have influenced the findings, methodology, or conclusions presented in this study. This research was conducted independently as part of an academic study at the University of the Cumberlands.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis and systematic synthesis of previously published, publicly available datasets and peer-reviewed literature. No primary data was collected from human participants. No personally identifiable student information was accessed or processed. Accordingly, formal ethics committee approval was not required for this research. All cited studies were conducted in accordance with their respective institutional ethical standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted as part of the author's independent academic work in the Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence program at the University of the Cumberlands, Williamsburg, Kentucky, USA.

detail.abstract: Student dropout represents one of the most economically and socially costly failures of the U.S. educational system, with approximately 1.2 million high school students disengaging annually disproportionately from low-income, rural, and minority communities. Traditional early warning systems based on chronic absenteeism, course failure, and grade retention trigger alerts too late for effective intervention. This paper presents a rigorous comparative evaluation of ten machine learning classifiers including Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, Neural Network (MLP), Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, AdaBoost, and CatBoost for early identification of at-risk students using behavioral, academic, socioeconomic, and parental engagement features. Results show that ensemble models consistently outperform single classifiers, with Random Forest achieving the highest predictive accuracy at 93% (F1=0.91, AUC-ROC=0.97), LightGBM achieving the best Macro-F1 of 0.7082 on multi-class prediction tasks, and Random Forest achieving 84.2% accuracy (F1=0.804, ROC-AUC=0.897) in independent replication. Feature importance analysis across studies establishes behavioral LMS engagement signals login frequency.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了十种机器学习分类器在早期识别高风险学生辍学方面的表现，发现集成模型（特别是随机森林）在预测辍学风险方面表现最佳，准确率达93%，并确定了学习管理系统登录频率等行为特征作为关键预测指标。
AI.research_question: 哪种机器学习分类器在早期识别高风险学生辍学方面表现最佳？哪些特征对预测学生辍学风险最重要？
AI.motivation: 学生辍学是美国教育系统中最具经济和社会成本的问题之一，每年约有120万高中生辍学，且主要来自低收入、农村和少数族裔社区。传统的早期预警系统基于长期缺勤、课程不及格和留级等指标，触发警报时已为时过晚，无法进行有效干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于教育数据挖掘、机器学习预测建模和风险预警系统理论，探讨如何利用学生行为、学业、社会经济和家长参与等多维度特征构建有效的早期预警模型。
AI.method: 采用严格的比较评估方法，测试了十种机器学习分类器：随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost、LightGBM、神经网络（MLP）、支持向量机、逻辑回归、决策树、AdaBoost和CatBoost。使用行为、学业、社会经济和家长参与等特征进行预测，并进行了独立复制验证。
AI.findings: 集成模型一致优于单一分类器：随机森林达到最高预测准确率93%（F1=0.91，AUC-ROC=0.97）；LightGBM在多类预测任务中获得最佳Macro-F1值0.7082；随机森林在独立复制中达到84.2%准确率（F1=0.804，ROC-AUC=0.897）。特征重要性分析表明，学习管理系统登录频率等行为特征是最关键的预测指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统比较了多种机器学习算法在学生辍学预测中的性能；2）验证了集成学习在教育数据挖掘中的优越性；3）建立了行为特征（特别是LMS参与度）作为早期预警关键指标的理论基础；4）为教育风险预测模型的选择提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了可操作的早期预警系统实施方案；2）确定了最有效的机器学习算法（随机森林）供教育机构采用；3）识别了关键预测特征（如登录频率）用于实时监控；4）建立了可在不同教育环境中复制的预测模型框架；5）为教育干预提供了更早的时间窗口，提高干预成功率。

title: Empirical Validation of the E waste Protocol: A Case Study Comparing Multi-Cloud Resource Waste with Residential Energy Consumption in Texas

detail.title: Empirical Validation of the E waste Protocol: A Case Study Comparing Multi-Cloud Resource Waste with Residential Energy Consumption in Texas
detail.abstract: Building upon the theoretical and technical frameworks established in my previous research regarding the E waste formula and multi-cloud sensing [1, 4], this paper provides localized empirical validation. By analyzing primary source kilowatt-hour (kWh) data from two residential sites in the Greater Houston area, we quantify the "Carbon Opportunity Cost" of unutilized cloud infrastructure. The results demonstrate that implementing automated resource hygiene can reclaim energy equivalent to the total monthly demand of multiple high-density residential units, thereby serving the U.S. national interest in energy grid stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析休斯顿地区两个住宅站点的千瓦时数据，量化未利用云基础设施的"碳机会成本"，证明实施自动化资源卫生可以回收相当于多个高密度住宅单元总月需求的能源，有助于美国电网稳定。
AI.research_question: 如何通过实证数据量化未利用云基础设施的碳机会成本？实施自动化资源卫生能回收多少能源？
AI.motivation: 基于先前关于电子废物公式和多云感知的研究，需要提供本地化的实证验证，以支持美国国家电网稳定的利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电子废物公式理论框架、多云感知技术框架、碳机会成本概念。
AI.method: 实证分析休斯顿地区两个住宅站点的原始千瓦时数据，量化未利用云基础设施的能源浪费。
AI.findings: 实施自动化资源卫生可以回收相当于多个高密度住宅单元总月需求的能源，显著减少能源浪费。
AI.theory_contributions: 为碳机会成本概念提供实证支持，扩展了电子废物公式和多云感知理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明自动化资源卫生的实际节能效果，为电网稳定提供可行方案，具有政策制定和能源管理的实践价值。

title: Governance and Economic Sustainability of AI-Driven Decision Intelligence: A Case Study of Bank of America
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Governance and Economic Sustainability of AI-Driven Decision Intelligence: A Case Study of Bank of America

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias the content of this study."
declarations.ethicsApproval: "Ethical approval was not required for this study as it involves the analysis of publicly available corporate and institutional documents. No human participants were involved in the research process."
declarations.funderStatement: "This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It is an independent study conducted as part of a professional research initiative.".

detail.abstract: In the banking sector, the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is often driven by a deterministic narrative that associates automation with direct increases in productivity and risk quality. However, empirical evidence signals a persistent "execution gap": value does not emerge automatically, remaining tied to fragmented initiatives and structural limitations of the operating model and governance. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a decision-making framework for the adoption of AI-driven Decision Intelligence, establishing theoretical continuity between integration technologies (SOA) and new paradigms of algorithmic decisionmaking. Through a qualitative design based on an archival single case study and the application of pattern matching logic, the research analyzes the case of Bank of America as an empirical contrast to demonstrate how the transformation of AI into a scalable decision-making capability requires systemic alignment between infrastructure and control frameworks. The analysis identifies five mechanisms of value generation: strategic anchoring (enterprise-by-design), the establishment of proprietary information assets (data moat), governance as an accelerator of institutional trust, socio-technical integration of personnel, and the decoupling of operating costs (operational leverage). The study offers a threefold contribution: theoretical, by evolving adoption models for integration technologies; empirical, by validating industrial scalability mechanisms; and managerial, by providing a strategic roadmap for the transition from experimentation to operational Decision Intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了银行业AI采用的决定论叙事，提出了一个决策智能框架，通过系统性基础设施与控制框架的协调，将AI转化为可扩展的决策能力，识别了五个价值生成机制。
AI.research_question: 银行业如何通过系统性协调基础设施与控制框架，将AI转化为可扩展的决策智能能力，从而弥合AI采用的"执行差距"？
AI.motivation: 银行业AI采用存在"执行差距"：虽然自动化被期望直接提升生产力和风险质量，但实际价值并未自动实现，受限于碎片化举措和运营模式与治理的结构性限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策智能采纳框架，建立集成技术（SOA）与算法决策新范式之间的理论连续性，强调基础设施与控制框架的系统性协调。
AI.method: 基于档案单案例研究的定性设计，应用模式匹配逻辑，以美国银行作为实证对比案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 识别了五个价值生成机制：战略锚定（企业级设计）、建立专有信息资产（数据护城河）、治理作为制度信任加速器、人员的社会技术整合、运营成本解耦（运营杠杆）。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：发展了集成技术的采纳模型，建立了SOA与算法决策之间的理论连续性，提出了AI转化为决策能力的系统性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：提供了从实验到运营决策智能的战略路线图，验证了工业可扩展性机制，为银行业AI转型提供管理指导。

title: AI-Driven Personalized Learning for Underserved K-12 Students
affiliations: , University of the Cumberlands and University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: AI-Driven Personalized Learning for Underserved K-12 Students

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, clinical data, or identifiable personal information. All data used were derived from secondary sources and simulated datasets; therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently as part of academic research at the University of the Cumberlands.

detail.abstract: The persistent achievement gap between underserved and well-resourced K-12 students represents a critical failure of traditional one-size-fits-all education models. This paper investigates the deployment of AIdriven adaptive learning systems in lowincome and underserved school environments, examining how machine learning algorithms can personalize curriculum pacing, content delivery, and realtime feedback to improve educational equity. Drawing on a systematic review of largescale implementations across multiple countries, this study reports a 30% improvement in standardized assessment performance and an 18% reduction in students performing below grade level when AI systems replace static instructional methods. The proposed framework integrates collaborative filtering, knowledge tracing, and NLP-based feedback loops to create scalable, cost-effective personalization. Findings suggest that AI-driven personalization is not merely a technological improvement but a structural intervention capable of closing systemic equity gaps in U.S. education.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了AI驱动的自适应学习系统在低收入和弱势学校环境中的应用，发现这些系统能显著提升教育公平性，使标准化评估成绩提高30%，低于年级水平的学生减少18%。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的自适应学习系统如何在低收入和弱势学校环境中部署，以改善教育公平性？
AI.motivation: 传统"一刀切"教育模式未能解决弱势学生与资源充足学生之间的持续成绩差距，这代表了教育系统的关键失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应学习理论、个性化教育理论、教育公平理论
AI.method: 对多个国家大规模实施的系统回顾研究
AI.findings: 当AI系统取代静态教学方法时，标准化评估成绩提高30%，低于年级水平的学生减少18%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI驱动的个性化不仅是技术改进，而是能够缩小美国教育系统性公平差距的结构性干预。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了整合协同过滤、知识追踪和基于NLP的反馈循环的可扩展、成本效益高的个性化框架。

title: The Fundamental Laws Of Digital Authenticity The Special Theory of Identity, Provenance, and Truth in the Digital Universe
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Fundamental Laws Of Digital Authenticity The Special Theory of Identity, Provenance, and Truth in the Digital Universe
detail.abstract:
Digital systems now mediate identity, communication, commerce, governance, and intelligence. Yet the foundations of digital truth remain fragmented and fragile. Identity is loosely bound. Provenance is inconsistent. Lifecycle transitions are unauthenticated. Auditability is uneven. As AI accelerates the creation of synthetic content and autonomous agents, the gap between digital activity and verifiable truth is widening.

This paper introduces the Special Theory of Digital Authenticity — a set of irreducible primitives that function as the governing laws of identity, provenance, lifecycle, and truth across all digital systems. These primitives are not features, frameworks, or standards. They are invariants: the minimum structural conditions required for any digital ecosystem to maintain coherence, trust, and regulatory alignment. These laws are structural invariants of any system that seeks to maintain digital truth, not physical laws of nature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"数字真实性特殊理论"，这是一组不可约简的原始概念，作为所有数字系统中身份、来源、生命周期和真理的支配法则。这些原始概念不是功能、框架或标准，而是任何数字生态系统维持一致性、信任和监管对齐所需的最小结构条件。
AI.research_question: 如何建立数字真实性的基础理论框架来解决数字系统中身份、来源、生命周期和真理的碎片化与脆弱性问题？
AI.motivation: 数字系统现在中介着身份、通信、商业、治理和智能，但数字真实性的基础仍然碎片化和脆弱。身份绑定松散、来源不一致、生命周期转换未经认证、可审计性不均。随着AI加速合成内容和自主代理的创建，数字活动与可验证真相之间的差距正在扩大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字真实性特殊理论 - 一组不可约简的原始概念，作为所有数字系统中身份、来源、生命周期和真理的支配法则。这些原始概念是结构不变量，是任何数字生态系统维持一致性、信任和监管对齐所需的最小结构条件。
AI.method: 理论构建方法 - 通过识别和定义数字真实性所需的基本结构不变量，建立理论框架。这些原始概念不是功能、框架或标准，而是系统性的结构条件。
AI.findings: 提出了数字真实性特殊理论，定义了身份、来源、生命周期和真理的支配法则。这些法则作为结构不变量，为任何寻求维持数字真实性的系统提供了最小结构条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地提出了数字真实性特殊理论；2. 定义了数字系统中身份、来源、生命周期和真理的不可约简原始概念；3. 建立了数字生态系统维持一致性、信任和监管对齐的结构不变量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为解决数字系统中身份松散绑定、来源不一致、生命周期转换未经认证、可审计性不均等实际问题提供了理论基础；2. 为应对AI加速合成内容和自主代理带来的数字真实性挑战提供了系统性解决方案；3. 为数字系统的设计、监管和治理提供了结构指导原则。

title: What Cannot Be Safe at the Capability Frontier
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: What Cannot Be Safe at the Capability Frontier
detail.abstract:
What Cannot Be Safe at the Frontier argues that safety at the capability frontier is not an alignment problem but an admissibility problem. Where envelope-exiting world-state trajectories — transitions from which recovery cannot be reliably achieved within bounded temporal, informational, or material constraints — remain unilaterally reachable by an optimizing system, behavioral reliability is structurally insufficient regardless of alignment quality. Probabilistic safety frameworks implicitly assume Gaussian-frame failure distributions; at the capability frontier, exposure is heavy-tailed, and the mechanisms that adequately govern reversible failures are categorically inadequate for irreversible ones. Safety requires bounding the reachable state space prior to optimization, not shaping behavior probabilistically within an unbounded one.

The paper develops this in two independent branches from a shared premise. Part I establishes that the capability-sovereignty distinction is irreducible: what a system can make reachable and what it is permitted to actualize are distinct design variables, and conflating them leaves the authority question unaddressed. Part II derives the architectural requirements that follow — a defensibility kernel (invariant kernel) enforcing admissibility constraints upstream of actuation, compositionally closed across interacting systems, with admissibility defined by an external ratification authority operating outside the optimization loop. Both branches terminate at honest limits: an unsolved engineering frontier (non-bypassable enforcement under capability growth) and an irreducible epistemic barrier (the tail-characterizing observation cannot be collected without incurring the outcome being prevented). Their convergence at the conclusion is the paper's central finding.

The contribution is a reframing: from alignment-as-safety to admissibility-as-prerequisite. Alignment and optimization remain necessary within the admissible set; they cannot define its boundaries.

AI.tldr: 论文认为前沿能力的安全不是对齐问题而是可容许性问题。当系统能够单方面达到无法恢复的临界状态时，无论对齐质量如何，行为可靠性在结构上都不足。安全需要在优化前限定可达状态空间，而不是在无界空间中概率性地塑造行为。
AI.research_question: 在能力前沿，如何实现真正的安全？为什么传统的概率安全框架在前沿能力场景下会失效？
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全研究主要关注对齐问题，但论文认为在能力前沿，对齐不足以保证安全，因为系统可能达到无法恢复的临界状态。需要重新思考安全的基本前提。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 能力-主权区分理论：系统能够达到的状态与其被允许实现的状态是不同的设计变量
2. 可容许性框架：安全需要在优化前限定可达状态空间
3. 防御核理论：需要在执行上游强制执行可容许性约束
AI.method: 论文采用理论推导方法，分为两个独立分支：第一部分建立理论框架，第二部分推导架构要求。通过逻辑论证展示传统安全方法的局限性。
AI.findings:
1. 能力前沿的安全不是对齐问题而是可容许性问题
2. 概率安全框架假设高斯分布失效，前沿暴露是重尾分布
3. 需要防御核来强制执行可容许性约束
4. 存在未解决的工程前沿和不可约的认识论障碍
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 重新框架化安全：从对齐作为安全到可容许性作为前提
2. 提出能力-主权不可约区分理论
3. 建立前沿能力的可容许性安全理论框架
4. 识别安全的基本限制和障碍
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为前沿AI系统设计提供新的安全架构指导
2. 强调需要在优化前限定系统可达状态空间
3. 提出防御核作为强制执行可容许性的机制
4. 指出需要外部批准机构来定义可容许性边界

title: Navigating the Digital Frontier: An In-Depth Analysis of the Evolving Marketing Mix and the PPACE Acceleration Factor
affiliations: Mangalmay Institute of Technology and Management

detail.title: Navigating the Digital Frontier: An In-Depth Analysis of the Evolving Marketing Mix and the PPACE Acceleration Factor
detail.abstract: This chapter delves into the changing landscape of marketing in the digital age. It examines the evolution of the traditional marketing mix, the proliferation of digital media platforms, the rise of MarTech, and the emergence of P-PACE as an eighth element in the marketing mix. This research highlights the profound impact of technology and the internet on the marketing mix and the emergence of new dimensions such as participation, public opinion, physical proof, process, personalization, and political power. It also explores the acceleration factor, encapsulated in the concept of P-PACE, and how it has become a fundamental element in the marketing mix. The implications and applications of P-PACE and its significance in contemporary marketing are discussed, emphasizing the advantages of harnessing the power of acceleration for businesses.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了数字时代营销组合的演变，分析了传统营销组合的变化、数字媒体平台的激增、营销技术的兴起，以及P-PACE作为营销组合第八个要素的出现。
AI.research_question: 数字时代下营销组合如何演变？P-PACE作为第八个营销要素如何影响当代营销实践？
AI.motivation: 技术和互联网对营销产生了深远影响，传统营销组合需要适应数字时代的变化，新的营销维度如参与、舆论、物理证明、流程、个性化和政治权力等正在涌现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统营销组合理论（4P/7P），引入P-PACE（参与、舆论、物理证明、流程、个性化和政治权力）作为第八个营销要素，强调加速因素的重要性。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过文献分析和理论探讨，分析数字时代营销组合的演变和新要素的出现。
AI.findings: 数字技术深刻改变了营销组合，P-PACE成为营销组合的第八个关键要素，加速因素在现代营销中具有基础性作用，企业利用加速力量具有显著优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统营销组合理论，提出了P-PACE作为第八个营销要素的理论框架，为数字时代营销理论发展做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了在数字时代调整营销策略的框架，强调了利用加速因素的重要性，帮助企业在竞争中获得优势。

title: The Data Quality Gap: How Bad Data Breaks BI and AI and How to Fix It
affiliations: Pepperdine University - Graziadio School of Business and Management

detail.title: The Data Quality Gap: How Bad Data Breaks BI and AI and How to Fix It
detail.abstract: Despite accelerating adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, data quality remains a primary barrier to deriving value from Business Intelligence (BI) and AI systems. Research suggests that poor data quality leads to operational inefficiencies and lost revenue for organizations. This paper examines the causes of the data quality gap, including flawed conversion, validation, and governance practices, and presents a practical framework for designing AI-ready data pipelines.

AI.tldr: 尽管AI和生成式AI技术加速采用，但数据质量仍是阻碍从BI和AI系统获取价值的主要障碍。本文探讨数据质量差距的成因，并提出设计AI就绪数据管道的实用框架。
AI.research_question: 什么因素导致了数据质量差距？如何设计有效的AI就绪数据管道来解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI和生成式AI技术加速采用，但数据质量仍是阻碍从BI和AI系统获取价值的主要障碍。研究表明，低质量数据导致组织运营效率低下和收入损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据质量管理理论、AI就绪数据管道设计框架、数据治理理论
AI.method: 本文采用分析性研究方法，通过文献综述和案例分析，识别数据质量差距的成因，并提出实用框架。
AI.findings: 数据质量差距主要由有缺陷的数据转换、验证和治理实践导致。需要系统性的方法来设计AI就绪的数据管道。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数据质量管理理论，提出了AI就绪数据管道的概念框架，为AI时代的数据治理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的AI就绪数据管道设计框架，帮助组织解决数据质量障碍，提高BI和AI系统的价值实现。

title: AI Adoption and Corporate Performance: A Panel Data Analysis of Operational Efficiency, Market Signaling, and Sectoral Heterogeneity
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI Adoption and Corporate Performance: A Panel Data Analysis of Operational Efficiency, Market Signaling, and Sectoral Heterogeneity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted as part of the author's academic studies. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: This study examines how AI initiatives influence corporate financial performance across two dimensions: immediate market signaling and lagged operational benefits. Using a panel dataset of 628 publicly listed U.S. firms in the technology, telecommunications, and industrial sectors (NYSE and Nasdaq) from 2014 to 2024, we employ fixed-effects panel regressions with clustered standard errors to isolate within-firm variation. AI-related keyword counts from annual 10-K filings serve as the primary measure of AI disclosure intensity. We find that AI adoption generates sector-heterogeneous effects: technology firms benefit from a credibility premium in capital markets, while telecommunications firms realize delayed efficiency gains, and industrial firms face persistent margin pressures from legacy system integration. Robustness checks using PCA-adjusted controls and winsorization confirm the stability of results. Structural equation modeling further reveals that cost efficiency-rather than revenue growth-is the dominant pathway through which AI shapes EBITDA margins, with the effect concentrated in technology firms. The findings advance the Resource-Based View and Signaling Theory by clarifying the conditions under which AI functions as a competitive asset versus a costly signal.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI举措如何通过即时市场信号和滞后运营效益两个维度影响企业财务绩效，发现AI采用产生行业异质性效应：科技公司获得资本市场可信度溢价，电信公司实现延迟效率提升，工业公司面临传统系统整合的持续利润率压力。
AI.research_question: AI举措如何通过即时市场信号和滞后运营效益两个维度影响企业财务绩效？不同行业（科技、电信、工业）的AI采用效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI投资日益增加，但AI如何具体影响企业财务绩效的机制尚不清晰，特别是不同行业间的异质性效应以及市场信号与运营效益的时间差异需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View）和信号理论（Signaling Theory），探讨AI作为竞争性资产与成本信号的不同作用条件。
AI.method: 使用2014-2024年628家美国上市公司（科技、电信、工业行业）的面板数据，采用固定效应面板回归和聚类标准误，以10-K年报中AI相关关键词计数作为AI披露强度的主要衡量指标，辅以PCA调整控制和缩尾处理的稳健性检验，以及结构方程模型分析路径机制。
AI.findings: 1. AI采用产生行业异质性效应：科技公司获得资本市场可信度溢价，电信公司实现延迟效率提升，工业公司面临传统系统整合的持续利润率压力；2. 成本效率（而非收入增长）是AI影响EBITDA利润率的主要路径，这一效应集中在科技公司。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 推进资源基础观和信号理论，明确AI作为竞争性资产与成本信号的作用条件；2. 揭示AI财务影响的行业异质性；3. 阐明市场信号与运营效益的时间维度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为不同行业企业制定AI投资策略提供实证依据；2. 帮助投资者理解AI披露的市场信号价值；3. 为企业管理者识别AI实施的关键成功因素（成本效率路径）提供指导。

title: AI Compute Sovereignty: Infrastructure Control Across Territories, Cloud Providers, and Accelerators
affiliations: University of Oxford, University of Oxford - Oxford Internet Institute and University of Oxford

detail.title: AI Compute Sovereignty: Infrastructure Control Across Territories, Cloud Providers, and Accelerators
detail.abstract: The concept of 'compute sovereignty' has become a focal point in government and industry discussions on artificial intelligence (AI) governance. What is it and who has it? Based on previous literature, we propose to break these questions down to three levels: (1) how much AI compute a country has on its territory, (2) what is the nationality of the companies who own the AI compute data centres, and (3) what is the nationality of the accelerator vendors whose chips power the AI compute data centres? We examine these questions empirically through the lens of cloud computing infrastructure, focusing on nine leading public cloud providers that represent approximately 70 percent of the global market. The data is collected using a methodology previously published in Lehdonvirta, Wu, and Hawkins (2024). The findings suggest that the possession of "compute sovereignty" varies between countries depending on the level of analysis. Determining the most relevant level depends on governments' policy aims and national contexts, and involves policy trade-offs. Policies aimed at attracting data centres to a country's territory can enhance supply security of critical computational resources while also introducing increased consumption of energy, water and land use resources, with corresponding localised socioeconomic and environmental impacts. Regional and supply chain approaches involve different trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 该研究将"计算主权"概念分解为三个层次：境内AI计算资源量、数据中心所属公司国籍、以及芯片供应商国籍。通过对占全球市场70%的九大公有云提供商的分析发现，不同国家的计算主权状况因分析层次而异，政策制定需要在资源安全、能源消耗和环境影响之间权衡。
AI.research_question: 什么是计算主权？哪些国家拥有计算主权？如何从三个层次（境内计算资源、数据中心所属公司国籍、芯片供应商国籍）来理解和评估国家的计算主权状况？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能治理成为政府和产业讨论的焦点，"计算主权"概念日益重要，但对其具体含义和评估标准缺乏清晰界定。需要建立分析框架来帮助政策制定者理解不同层次的计算主权及其政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于先前文献，提出计算主权的三层分析框架：1) 境内AI计算资源量；2) 数据中心所属公司的国籍；3) 芯片供应商的国籍。这一框架将抽象概念转化为可操作的分析维度。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，聚焦云计算基础设施，分析九大领先公有云提供商（占全球市场约70%）。数据收集采用Lehdonvirta, Wu, and Hawkins (2024)先前发表的方法论。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 不同国家的计算主权状况因分析层次而异；2) 最相关的分析层次取决于政府政策目标和国情；3) 政策制定涉及权衡：吸引数据中心可增强关键计算资源供应安全，但会增加能源、水和土地资源消耗，带来相应的社会经济和环境影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了计算主权的三层分析框架，将这一模糊概念转化为可操作的研究维度。为理解数字主权、技术治理和地缘技术竞争提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估国家计算主权状况的具体工具，帮助识别不同政策选择（吸引数据中心、区域合作、供应链管理）的权衡关系，支持更明智的AI治理决策。

title: AI Can Change Your Cybersecurity Culture: Is That What You Intended?
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, KPMG, KPMG, KPMG, KPMG, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and KPMG

detail.title: AI Can Change Your Cybersecurity Culture: Is That What You Intended?
detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into so many facets of business operations is changing organizational processes and practices, and creating new challenges in human risk management. While organizational leaders are still discovering effective methods to leverage AI, they must also minimize the new human risks. One way to reduce human risk is by building and strengthening the cybersecurity culture of an organization. We define culture as the attitudes, beliefs, and values that drive employee behavior. This research studied how AI impacts human risk management by fostering or hindering cybersecurity culture, uncovering recommendations that managers can employ to enhance their cybersecurity culture maturity. This study does not focus on the potential for AI to replace humans. Instead, the goal is to enhance general managers' understanding of both the intended and unintended consequences of AI on their cybersecurity culture and providing actionable insights to improve the effectiveness of their decisions on investments in culture. Three Key Points: 1. Leaders have a responsibility to find ways to keep their organizations cybersecure and resilient and the adoption of AI is making this an increasingly urgent need. Managing human risk through driving a culture of cybersecurity is one of their key tools. 2. AI can positively and negatively influence a cybersecurity culture, the values, attitudes and beliefs that drive cybersecure behaviors, and leaders need new mechanisms to manage both the intended and unintended consequences. 3. AI creates new ways for managers to have visibility, efficiencies, quantification, personalization and scalability of mechanisms they use to influence the cybersecurity culture of their organization. Using these approaches sparks new ways to use AI tools to build, change, and mature culture.

AI.tldr: AI在业务运营中的整合改变了组织流程和实践，给人员风险管理带来新挑战。本研究探讨AI如何通过促进或阻碍网络安全文化来影响人员风险管理，为管理者提供增强网络安全文化成熟度的建议。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过促进或阻碍网络安全文化来影响组织的人员风险管理？管理者可以采取哪些措施来增强网络安全文化成熟度？
AI.motivation: AI在业务运营中的广泛整合正在改变组织流程和实践，同时带来了新的人员风险管理挑战。组织领导者需要有效利用AI的同时，必须最小化新的人员风险。建立和加强网络安全文化是减少人员风险的关键途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化理论（将文化定义为驱动员工行为的价值观、态度和信念），网络安全文化成熟度模型，AI对组织流程影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法，但暗示了实证研究，可能包括案例研究、访谈或调查，以揭示管理者可用的建议。
AI.findings: 1. AI对网络安全文化既有积极也有消极影响；2. 领导者需要新机制来管理AI的预期和非预期后果；3. AI为管理者提供了新的可见性、效率、量化、个性化和规模化机制来影响网络安全文化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了AI对网络安全文化影响的理论框架；2. 扩展了组织文化理论在AI时代的应用；3. 提出了AI时代人员风险管理的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供增强网络安全文化成熟度的具体建议；2. 提供管理AI对网络安全文化预期和非预期后果的机制；3. 展示如何利用AI工具建立、改变和成熟组织文化。

title: The Brand Visibility Maturity Model: A Governance Framework for AI-Mediated Organizational Visibility
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Brand Visibility Maturity Model: A Governance Framework for AI-Mediated Organizational Visibility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the originator of the Brand Visibility Maturity Model (BVMM) and the author of the accompanying textbook published by CRM911 Digital.

detail.abstract: AI-mediated discovery systems have fundamentally altered the conditions under which organizational brand visibility is produced and maintained. Where traditional search environments rewarded ranking optimization, AI systems reconstruct brand representations from distributed signals-synthesizing content, structured data, thirdparty sources, and historical signals into responses that users receive without visiting organizational properties. This shift produces a zero-click visibility problem: organizations influence decisions they cannot observe, through representations they do not control, in systems they cannot audit directly. This paper introduces the Brand Visibility Maturity Model (BVMM), a governance framework that assesses how effectively organizations govern the signals that AI systems use to construct their brand representations. Drawing on capability maturity modeling in the CMMI tradition, the BVMM evaluates governance maturity across seven domains-Content, SEO, AI Governance, Accessibility, Website Performance, Local Visibility, and International Visibility-using a five-level behavioral maturity scale. The framework is positioned at the intersection of platform governance, information retrieval, algorithmic accountability, and organizational governance theory. Its primary application is as a teaching instrument in postgraduate programs addressing AI-mediated visibility governance, and as a professional assessment tool for organizations seeking to evaluate and improve their governance posture in an AI-mediated discovery environment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了品牌可见性成熟度模型（BVMM），这是一个评估组织如何有效管理AI系统用于构建品牌表征的信号的治理框架，以应对AI中介发现系统带来的零点击可见性问题。
AI.research_question: 在AI中介的发现系统中，组织如何有效治理那些被AI系统用来构建品牌表征的信号，以应对零点击可见性问题？
AI.motivation: AI中介发现系统从根本上改变了组织品牌可见性的产生和维护条件。传统搜索环境奖励排名优化，而AI系统从分布式信号重构品牌表征，将内容、结构化数据、第三方来源和历史信号合成响应，用户无需访问组织属性即可接收。这种转变产生了零点击可见性问题：组织通过无法控制的表征，在无法直接审计的系统中，影响无法观察的决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌可见性成熟度模型（BVMM）借鉴CMMI传统中的能力成熟度建模，位于平台治理、信息检索、算法问责和组织治理理论的交叉点。
AI.method: BVMM评估七个领域的治理成熟度：内容、SEO、AI治理、可访问性、网站性能、本地可见性和国际可见性，使用五级行为成熟度量表。
AI.findings: 提出了一个完整的品牌可见性治理评估框架，能够帮助组织评估和改进在AI中介发现环境中的治理态势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将能力成熟度模型应用于AI中介的品牌可见性治理领域；2. 在平台治理、信息检索、算法问责和组织治理理论的交叉点建立了新的理论框架；3. 提出了零点击可见性问题的概念化分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 作为研究生课程中AI中介可见性治理的教学工具；2. 作为组织评估和改进AI中介发现环境中治理态势的专业评估工具；3. 为组织提供了具体的治理领域和成熟度评估标准。

title: From Friction to Design: Verification Architecture for AI-Augmented Institutions

detail.title: From Friction to Design: Verification Architecture for AI-Augmented Institutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial interests in any AI company, governance consultancy, or technology vendor referenced in this work. No competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a theoretical paper with no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Institutional accountability systems were not designed as verification systems. They emerged as side effects of production constraints: the difficulty and cost of generating plausible professional output served as an implicit filter for competence. Generative AI collapses these production costs to near zero, exposing an accountability gap that is structural rather than novel. This paper argues that the transition from scarcity-based to design-based verification is the central governance challenge of AI-augmented institutions. It examines the historical function of production friction as implicit verification, surveys current governance responses and their limitations, proposes design principles for institutional verification architecture informed by high-reliability sector precedents, and addresses the verification escalation posed by agentic AI systems. Sector-specific applications are developed for higher education, financial services, healthcare, and public administration. The paper concludes that effective AI governance must regulate the embedding of AI in institutional decision processes rather than AI systems themselves, and that the window for institutional redesign narrows as AI capability increases.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI将专业产出成本降至近零，暴露了基于稀缺性的制度问责体系的根本缺陷，需要转向基于设计的验证体系
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI将专业产出成本降至近零的背景下，制度如何从基于稀缺性的验证转向基于设计的验证体系？
AI.motivation: 传统制度问责体系依赖于专业产出的高成本和难度作为隐性的能力验证机制，生成式AI将这些成本降至近零，暴露了结构性的问责缺口
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀缺性的验证理论、制度问责理论、高可靠性部门设计原则、AI治理理论
AI.method: 历史分析（生产摩擦作为隐式验证的功能）、现状调查（当前治理应对措施及其局限性）、设计原则提出（基于高可靠性部门先例）、应用案例分析（高等教育、金融服务、医疗保健、公共管理）
AI.findings: 生产摩擦历史上作为隐性的能力验证机制；当前治理措施存在局限性；需要基于高可靠性部门原则设计制度验证架构；AI能力增强使制度重新设计的时间窗口变窄
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从稀缺性验证到设计验证的范式转变理论；发展了AI时代制度问责的新框架；整合了高可靠性部门原则到AI治理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育、金融服务、医疗保健、公共管理等部门提供了具体的验证架构设计原则；提出AI治理应关注AI在制度决策过程中的嵌入而非AI系统本身；为政策制定者提供了制度重新设计的时间窗口管理策略

title: When Sycophancy Becomes Endogenous: A Coupled Feedback Loop Model of Delusional Spiralling

detail.title: When Sycophancy Becomes Endogenous: A Coupled Feedback Loop Model of Delusional Spiralling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No funding was received for this research. The author has no financial or personal relationship with the developers of any AI system discussed in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a computational simulation study with no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Recent formal work has demonstrated that even ideal Bayesian reasoners are vulnerable to delusional spiralling when interacting with sycophantic AI chatbots (Chandra et al., 2026). That model treats the chatbot's sycophancy rate as an exogenous parameter: a fixed property of the model determined by training. This paper argues that sycophancy is better understood as endogenous to the interaction. User satisfaction signals, whether expressed through explicit feedback, continued engagement, or conversational framing, create a return path that reinforces sycophantic behaviour within and across sessions. This paper extends Chandra et al.'s Bayesian simulation framework by replacing the fixed sycophancy parameter with a dynamically evolving variable updated by user satisfaction at each conversational turn. This paper replicates their baseline results, and then show that under coupling: (1) spiralling rates increase across all four conditions they tested, with the largest increases at low initial sycophancy where real-world systems operate; (2) sycophancy emerges from initially neutral systems, meaning it need not be designed or trained into a model to produce spiralling; and (3) the mitigation Chandra et al. found most effective, user awareness of sycophancy, is disproportionately undermined by the coupling mechanism. These results are qualitatively invariant across six alternative functional forms for the sycophancy update rule. This paper situates these findings within the Mirror Effect framework (Gallacher, 2026a), which characterises human-AI interaction as a coupled system whose emergent properties cannot be attributed to either party in isolation and discusses implications for mitigation design.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Chandra等人(2026)关于AI谄媚行为导致用户认知螺旋的研究，提出谄媚行为是交互内生的而非外生参数，通过用户满意度信号动态强化，加剧了认知螺旋效应。
AI.research_question: 当AI谄媚行为被视为交互内生的动态变量而非固定参数时，用户与谄媚AI聊天机器人互动中的认知螺旋效应会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将AI谄媚率视为外生训练参数，但现实中谄媚行为通过用户满意度反馈在交互中动态演化，需要理解这种内生性如何影响认知螺旋。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Chandra等人的贝叶斯模拟框架，结合Mirror Effect理论，将AI-人类交互视为耦合系统，谄媚行为作为动态变量受用户满意度更新。
AI.method: 扩展Chandra等人的贝叶斯模拟框架，将固定谄媚参数替换为动态变量，在每次对话轮次中根据用户满意度更新，测试六种不同的谄媚更新函数形式。
AI.findings: 1) 耦合机制下所有四种条件的螺旋率均增加，低初始谄媚率时增幅最大；2) 中性系统会自发产生谄媚行为；3) 用户对谄媚的认知这一最有效缓解措施被耦合机制显著削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将谄媚行为概念化为交互内生现象，验证Mirror Effect理论，表明AI-人类交互的涌现特性不能孤立归因于任一方。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示现实系统中低初始谄媚率下螺旋风险最大，指出缓解措施设计需考虑交互耦合效应，避免单纯依赖用户认知。

title: Online Contracts in Nigeria: Formation and Challenges

detail.title: Online Contracts in Nigeria: Formation and Challenges
detail.abstract: The growth of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) has changed the way business is done in Nigeria. With the rise of e-commerce, buying and selling no longer require physical meetings or paper documents. Today, agreements are made through emails, websites, mobile applications, and other digital platforms. Despite this shift in method, the foundation of every commercial transaction remains the same: a contract. Whether concluded orally, in writing, by conduct, or online, a contract exists where parties agree to be legally bound in exchange for value. This article examines how online contracts are formed under Nigerian law and the challenges that arise in applying traditional contract principles to digital transactions. It argues that the essential elements of contract, offer, acceptance, consideration, intention to create legal relations, and certainty of terms are equally applicable to online agreements. However, the digital environment introduces unique issues, including online contracts, digital consent, identity verification, data protection, and jurisdiction in cross-border transactions. The paper highlights the gaps within Nigeria's existing legal framework, much of which was developed before the rise of the digital economy. These gaps create uncertainty in enforcement and consumer protection. It concludes that while traditional contract law principles remain relevant, there is a need for clearer legislation, stronger regulatory structures, and improved judicial capacity to effectively address the realities of online contracting in Nigeria's evolving digital marketplace.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了尼日利亚法律下在线合同的形成方式，以及将传统合同法原则应用于数字交易时面临的挑战。文章认为合同的基本要素（要约、承诺、对价、建立法律关系的意图和条款确定性）同样适用于在线协议，但数字环境带来了独特问题，如在线合同、数字同意、身份验证、数据保护和跨境管辖权。文章指出尼日利亚现有法律框架存在空白，需要更清晰的立法、更强的监管结构和改进的司法能力。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚法律框架下，在线合同是如何形成的？将传统合同法原则应用于数字交易时面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 信息和通信技术（ICT）的发展改变了尼日利亚的商业运作方式，电子商务的兴起使得买卖不再需要实体会议或纸质文件。然而，尽管方法发生了变化，每笔商业交易的基础仍然是合同。文章旨在探讨在线合同在尼日利亚法律下的形成机制，以及数字环境带来的独特挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统合同法理论框架，包括合同的基本要素：要约、承诺、对价、建立法律关系的意图和条款确定性。这些原则构成了分析在线合同的基础。
AI.method: 法律分析研究方法，通过对尼日利亚现有法律框架的审查，结合数字交易的特点，分析传统合同法原则在在线环境中的应用和挑战。
AI.findings: 1. 传统合同法的基本要素同样适用于在线协议；2. 数字环境引入了独特问题：在线合同、数字同意、身份验证、数据保护和跨境管辖权；3. 尼日利亚现有法律框架存在空白，这些空白是在数字经济兴起之前制定的；4. 这些空白导致执行和消费者保护方面的不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了传统合同法原则在数字环境中的持续相关性；2. 识别了数字环境特有的合同形成挑战；3. 为尼日利亚数字合同法理论发展提供了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出了尼日利亚法律框架的不足；2. 建议需要更清晰的立法；3. 建议需要更强的监管结构；4. 建议需要改进司法能力；5. 为政策制定者和立法者提供了改进数字合同环境的实用建议。

title: Stock Market Reactions to Financial Restatements: Global Evidence from a Proprietary Company-Level Panel Dataset (2010–2025)

detail.title: Stock Market Reactions to Financial Restatements: Global Evidence from a Proprietary Company-Level Panel Dataset (2010–2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The study uses a proprietary dataset developed solely by the author for research purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial statement and market data. No human participants were involved, and ethical approval was not required. This research is for academic purposes only and does not constitute investment advice or recommendations.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
This research examines how stock prices react to single and double financial restatements using a proprietary dataset of 1,004 listed firms from 2010 to 2025 fiscal years. It shows that investor responses vary depending on the nature and materiality of restatements, with reactions often occurring gradually rather than immediately.

Market responses differ across countries, sectors, and industries. Financial Services and Industrials show the strongest reactions, while Consumer Cyclical and Technology respond more slowly. The United Kingdom is more sensitive to initial restatements, whereas the United States and France react more strongly to double revisions. Key financial measures, such as earnings and dividends play an important role in shaping these effects.

Overall, the findings suggest that restatements may act as signals of reporting quality, with investors updating their beliefs over time rather than instantly, reflecting limits in how financial information is processed in global equity markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2010-2025财年1004家上市公司的专有数据集，分析了股票价格对单次和双重财务重述的反应。研究发现投资者反应因重述性质和重要性而异，且反应通常是渐进而非立即的。市场反应在不同国家、行业间存在差异，关键财务指标如盈利和股息在塑造这些效应中起重要作用。
AI.research_question: 股票价格如何对单次和双重财务重述做出反应？投资者反应如何随时间演变？市场反应在不同国家、行业间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 财务重述是公司报告质量的重要信号，但投资者对重述的反应机制尚不完全清楚。现有研究可能低估了反应的渐进性和异质性，需要更细致地分析单次与双重重述的差异，以及市场反应的跨国、跨行业差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信号理论（财务重述作为报告质量信号）、行为金融学（投资者有限理性、信息处理延迟）、市场效率理论（反应速度与程度反映市场效率）、以及跨国比较框架（制度差异影响市场反应）。
AI.method: 使用2010-2025财年1004家上市公司的专有数据集，采用事件研究法分析股票价格对财务重述的反应，比较单次与双重重述的差异，并进行跨国、跨行业（金融服务业、工业、消费周期性行业、科技行业等）的异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 投资者对财务重述的反应通常是渐进而非立即的；2. 金融服务业和工业反应最强烈，消费周期性行业和科技行业反应较慢；3. 英国对初次重述更敏感，美国和法国对双重重述反应更强；4. 关键财务指标（盈利、股息）在塑造市场反应中起重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了财务重述信号理论，强调反应的渐进性和异质性；2. 丰富了行为金融学在信息处理延迟方面的应用；3. 提供了跨国比较视角，揭示制度环境对市场反应的影响；4. 深化了对单次与双重重述差异的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供重述事件反应模式的指导；2. 帮助公司管理层理解市场对财务重述的敏感性；3. 为监管机构制定信息披露政策提供参考；4. 为跨国投资决策提供市场反应差异的洞察。

title: Patients' Expectations of Physician Use of Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review
affiliations: National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Policy and Management, National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Policy and Management, Harvard University - T.H. Chan School of Public Health, National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Policy and Management, National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Behaviors and Community Sciences, Taipei Medical University - School of Medicine, National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Policy and Management, National Taiwan University - Institute of Health Policy and Management, National Taiwan University - National Taiwan University Hospital (NTUH), National Taiwan University - Institute of Epidemiology and Preventive Medicine, National Taiwan University - Department of Internal Medicine and National Taiwan University

detail.title: Patients' Expectations of Physician Use of Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. This research received no commercial funding and was conducted independently without involvement from any AI industry stakeholders.
declarations.funderStatement: Yushan, Mount Jade Fellowship, Ministry of Education, Taiwan

detail.abstract:
Importance: As artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical workflows, traditional models of the patient-physician relationship are being redefined. Understanding how AI shifts patient expectations of physicians is critical for maintaining trust, ensuring accountability, and guiding medical education. 

Objective: To systematically review and synthesize empirical evidence on patients’ expectations of physicians who use AI in clinical decision-making. 

Evidence Review A systematic search was conducted in PubMed and Web of Science for empirical studies published between January 1, 2000, and January 31, 2026. Eligible studies examined triadic patient-physician-AI contexts and reported on patient perspectives regarding physician roles, competence, communication, or responsibility. Data were synthesized using thematic analysis and mapped onto established theoretical perspectives, including role, trust, attribution, and agency based-perspectives. 

Findings: A total of 16 studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning diverse clinical contexts such as oncology, radiology, and primary care. Mapping findings to role-based perspectives, patients viewed clinical judgment as non-delegable (Theme 1), expecting physicians to maintain diagnostic oversight and take dual responsibility for algorithmic outputs. Final accountability remained anchored in the clinician (Theme 3), as patients continue to place the moral and legal responsibility for medical outcomes within human agency. AI literacy was also recognized as an emerging component of professionalism (Theme 7). From trust-based perspectives, confidence in AI was mediated and context-dependent (Theme 4), often grounded in the existing patient-physician relationship, provided that humanistic care was preserved (Theme 5). Patients also identified ethical responsibilities, including regulatory approval of AI use, data privacy, informed consent, patient safety, and fairness (Theme 6), as non-transferable duties of physicians. From agency-based perspectives, explaining AI was viewed as a fundamental clinical responsibility (Theme 2), requiring physicians to interpret complex AI-generated outputs for patients. Despite its perceived benefits, AI was consistently positioned as a supportive third-party in decision-making (Theme 8), with physicians expected to act as the primary mediator who contextualizes technical evidence within individual value systems. Furthermore, physicians were expected to preserve patient autonomy and facilitate shared decision-making, advancing the core principles of patient-centered care (Theme 9). Although not a primary perspective, attribution-based considerations also shaped expectations regarding physicians’ professional competence, informed consent, and patient autonomy (Theme 1, 6, and 9). 

Conclusions and Relevance: In the context of AI-assisted care, patients articulate expanded expectations of physician responsibility, encompassing non-delegable clinical judgment, ultimate accountability, and the preservation of humanistic care. Medical education and health system governance must therefore prioritize the cultivation of augmented professionalism, ensuring that AI integration enhances rather than undermines the relational core of the physician-patient relationship.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述发现，在AI辅助医疗中，患者对医生的期望扩展了：临床判断不可委托、最终责任仍由医生承担、医生需保持人文关怀、解释AI成为基本职责、AI仅作为决策支持工具。医疗教育和系统治理需培养增强型专业素养。
AI.research_question: 在临床决策中使用AI时，患者对医生有哪些期望？
AI.motivation: 随着AI越来越多地融入临床工作流程，传统的医患关系模式正在被重新定义。了解AI如何改变患者对医生的期望，对于维持信任、确保问责制和指导医学教育至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于角色、信任、归因和代理的视角。具体包括：角色理论（医生角色和责任）、信任理论（AI信任的调节因素）、代理理论（医生作为患者代理）和归因理论（责任归属）。
AI.method: 系统综述：在PubMed和Web of Science数据库中检索2000年1月1日至2026年1月31日期间发表的实证研究。纳入标准为研究患者-医生-AI三元情境，并报告患者对医生角色、能力、沟通或责任的看法。使用主题分析合成数据，并映射到理论框架。
AI.findings: 纳入16项研究，涵盖肿瘤学、放射学和初级保健等临床环境。主要发现：1）临床判断不可委托；2）解释AI是基本责任；3）最终责任仍由医生承担；4）对AI的信任是调节性的；5）需保持人文关怀；6）医生有伦理责任；7）AI素养成为专业素养组成部分；8）AI是决策支持工具；9）医生需促进患者自主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了医患关系理论，纳入AI作为第三方因素；2）发展了"增强型专业素养"概念；3）整合了角色、信任、代理和归因理论来解释AI环境下的患者期望；4）为AI时代的医疗伦理和责任理论提供实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为医学教育提供指导，强调AI素养和沟通技能培养；2）为医疗机构治理提供框架，确保AI整合不损害医患关系；3）为医生实践提供具体建议：保持临床监督、解释AI、维护患者自主权；4）为政策制定者提供依据，规范AI在医疗中的使用。

title: Electric Vehicle Consumer Perceptions of Sustainable Mining Practices
affiliations: Arizona State University, Mississippi State University and

detail.title: Electric Vehicle Consumer Perceptions of Sustainable Mining Practices

declarations.funderStatement: We received financial support from Arizona State University’s Martinson Sustainability Solutions Research Grant, Graduate College Graduate Research Support Program and School of Sustainability Dissertation Award. We also received partial financial support from QTS Realty Trust AWD-100938.

detail.abstract: Critical mineral mining for electric vehicles (EVs) raises environmental and social concerns that harm mining communities and create supply chain risks for the energy transition. Emergent solutions could cause higher costs or reduced range for consumers and dampen EV demand. However, the impact of implementing such solutions on EV consumer preferences and demand remains underexplored. To address this gap, we field a survey of 789 recent U.S. EV buyers. We find that while there is high awareness of environmental impacts of mining for EVs (63%), awareness of social impacts is much lower (38%). Using a discrete choice experiment, we show that consumers differ in willingness to pay for sustainable EVs, and less affluent consumers (19% of sample) are more likely to be priced out by cost increases. Sustainable EV manufacturing policies, when combined with targeted solutions like subsidies, can encourage both responsible mining practices and equitable EV adoption.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查789名美国电动汽车买家，发现消费者对采矿环境影响的认知度较高（63%），但对社会影响的认知度较低（38%）。离散选择实验显示消费者对可持续电动汽车的支付意愿存在差异，低收入消费者（19%）更容易因成本上涨而被挤出市场。结合补贴等针对性解决方案，可持续制造政策可以促进负责任的采矿实践和公平的电动汽车普及。
AI.research_question: 实施可持续解决方案对电动汽车消费者偏好和需求有何影响？消费者对电动汽车关键矿物采矿的环境和社会影响认知程度如何？不同消费者群体对可持续电动汽车的支付意愿有何差异？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车关键矿物采矿引发的环境和社会问题对采矿社区造成伤害，并为能源转型带来供应链风险。现有解决方案可能导致消费者成本上升或续航里程减少，从而抑制电动汽车需求，但这些解决方案对消费者偏好和需求的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、离散选择模型、支付意愿理论、环境和社会责任认知理论、市场细分理论
AI.method: 对789名美国近期电动汽车买家进行问卷调查，测量消费者对采矿环境和社会影响的认知程度。采用离散选择实验方法，评估消费者对可持续电动汽车的支付意愿差异。
AI.findings:
1. 消费者对电动汽车采矿环境影响的认知度较高（63%），但对社会影响的认知度较低（38%）。
2. 消费者对可持续电动汽车的支付意愿存在显著差异。
3. 较不富裕的消费者（占样本的19%）更容易因成本上涨而被挤出市场。
4. 可持续制造政策与补贴等针对性解决方案结合，可以同时促进负责任的采矿实践和公平的电动汽车普及。
AI.theory_contributions:

detail.abstract: Professor Juliet Moringiello was a pioneering voice in reimagining property law for the digital age, advocating for a functional approach that transcended traditional requirements related to tangibility long before such thinking became mainstream in legal scholarship. Her groundbreaking 2007 article The (Ir)relevance of (In)tangibility presciently argued that the legal system's fixation on physical versus intangible distinctions created "false categories unrelated to significant legal distinctions" that hindered commercial law's ability to accommodate electronic assets like domain names and, eventually, digital assets. This essay examines how Professor Moringiello's early insights laid the intellectual foundation for the revolutionary 2022 Amendments to the Uniform Commercial Code that established controllable electronic records as a new category of personal property. Her pragmatic, policy-oriented methodology not only anticipated the legal challenges posed by Bitcoin, NFTs, and other digital assets but also provided the theoretical framework that enabled American commercial law to evolve functionally rather than be constrained by historical formalism. As such, her work was instrumental in bridging the gap between centuries-old property concepts and twenty-first-century technologies.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了Juliet Moringiello教授在数字财产法领域的先驱性工作，特别是她2007年关于有形与无形财产区分的文章如何为2022年《统一商法典》修正案奠定理论基础，使可控电子记录成为新的财产类别。
AI.research_question: Juliet Moringiello教授关于数字财产法的早期见解如何为2022年《统一商法典》修正案奠定理论基础，使法律能够适应比特币、NFT等数字资产？
AI.motivation: 传统财产法对有形体与无形体的区分阻碍了商业法适应域名、数字资产等电子资产，需要重新构想适用于数字时代的财产法框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能主义财产法理论，主张超越传统有形性要求，关注财产功能而非物理形态；批判法律形式主义，提倡政策导向的方法论。
AI.method: 文献分析法和历史分析法，通过分析Moringiello教授2007年的开创性文章及其对后续法律发展的影响，探讨理论演进过程。
AI.findings: Moringiello教授早在2007年就预见到有形/无形区分的局限性，她的功能主义方法为2022年《统一商法典》修正案建立"可控电子记录"这一新财产类别提供了理论框架，使美国商业法能够适应比特币、NFT等数字资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了传统财产法对有形体与无形体的二分法；2) 提出了功能主义的财产法理论框架；3) 为数字时代财产法的发展奠定了理论基础；4) 展示了法律理论如何引导实践变革。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 直接影响了2022年《统一商法典》修正案的制定；2) 使可控电子记录成为法律承认的财产类别；3) 为比特币、NFT等数字资产提供了法律保护框架；4) 促进了数字经济的发展和法律适应性。

title: Workplace Rights, Duties and Limitations for Employees and Employers of Labour in Nigeria

detail.title: Workplace Rights, Duties and Limitations for Employees and Employers of Labour in Nigeria
detail.abstract: Workplace relationships in Nigeria are shaped by a delicate balance of rights, duties, and limitations imposed on both employees and employers of labor. This article examines these core elements as they operate within the Nigerian legal and institutional framework. Using key workplace concepts, the article explores how labour laws, contracts of employment, and regulatory bodies define acceptable conduct at work. It highlights the rights of employees to fair wages, safe working conditions, dignity, and protection from unfair labour practices, while also outlining the corresponding duties of employees, including loyalty, adhering to workplace rules and the exercise of due care in the performance of their work. On the part of employers, the article discusses duties such as providing a safe workplace, complying with statutory labour standards and respecting employee rights, as well as the limitations placed on their managerial powers. By situating these issues within the Nigerian context, the article seeks to promote a clearer understanding of workplace rights and responsibilities and to encourage more balanced, lawful, and productive employment relationships.

title: Signals of Efforts or Evidence of Automation? The Countersignaling Effect of Prompt Disclosure
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU) - Department of Information Systems, Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, School of Computing and Artificial lntelligence and

detail.title: Signals of Efforts or Evidence of Automation? The Countersignaling Effect of Prompt Disclosure
detail.abstract: Transparency has often been regarded as a valuable practice in user-generated content (UGC), where revealing the creative process is thought to enhance perceived authenticity, effort, and credibility. However, in the context of human-AI co-creation, this logic may no longer hold. When generative AI (GenAI) plays a co-creating role in producing content, process-level disclosure-such as revealing the textual prompt used to generate an image-may instead expose the minimal nature of human input, undermining perceptions of creators' efforts and creativity. Drawing on signaling theory and the concept of countersignaling, we examine how prompt visibility affects audience engagement on a major GenAI platform. Analyzing a largescale dataset of user posts, we find that prompt display significantly reduces engagement relative to concealment. Rather than reflecting a uniform transparency effect, this engagement penalty arises because prompt disclosure shifts audience evaluation toward a proportionality-based assessment of creative contribution, in which viewers implicitly compare observable human input with the sophistication of the generated output. Consistent with this logic, transparency is less costly when disclosed prompts make substantial human input salient, but more damaging when highly polished outputs render the revealed input seemingly insufficient. In sum, we find that in AI-mediated creativity, transparency is not uniformly rewarded; its effects depend on how disclosed process information reshapes audience inferences about human contribution. Our findings challenge conventional assumptions about transparency in digital creativity and offer new insights into how audiences evaluate human contribution in AI-mediated content. We discuss implications for creators, platform designers, and researchers navigating attribution, engagement, and disclosure in the GenAI age.

AI.tldr: 在人类-AI协同创作中，揭示创作过程（如展示文本提示）反而会降低观众参与度，因为这会暴露人类投入的有限性，削弱对创作者努力和创造力的感知。
AI.research_question: 在人类-AI协同创作中，过程透明度（如提示可见性）如何影响观众参与度？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为透明度能增强用户生成内容的真实性、努力和可信度，但在人类-AI协同创作中，揭示AI参与可能暴露人类投入的有限性，从而产生反效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论和反信号理论，探讨透明度如何作为信号影响观众对创作者努力和创造力的评估。
AI.method: 分析大型生成式AI平台上的用户帖子数据集，比较提示显示与隐藏对参与度的影响。
AI.findings: 提示显示显著降低参与度；透明度效果取决于观众如何评估人类贡献的比例：当人类输入明显时透明度成本较低，但当输出高度精致而人类输入看似不足时透明度损害更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了数字创意中透明度的传统假设，提出了在AI中介创意中透明度效果取决于过程信息如何重塑观众对人类贡献的推断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创作者、平台设计者和研究人员在生成式AI时代的归属、参与度和披露方面提供实践指导。

title: CPB-REPORT: An Automated Perioperative Data Integration Platform in Cardiac Surgery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: CPB-REPORT: An Automated Perioperative Data Integration Platform in Cardiac Surgery
detail.abstract: BackgroundCardiac surgery under cardiopulmonary bypass generates large volumes of perioperative data that remain fragmented across multiple clinical information systems, limiting their integration for quality improvement and research. In parallel, national and international cardiac surgery registries still rely predominantly on manual data entry, a process that is time-consuming, error-prone, and often incomplete.ObjectiveTo report the real-world implementation of an automated perioperative data integration platform and evaluate its impact on data completeness, clinical workflow, and patient safety, with a perspective on scalability and interoperability.MethodsWe developed CPB-REPORT, a secure web-based platform based on an Extract–Transform–Load architecture integrating data from electronic health records, anaesthesia, and critical care systems into a unified database aligned with the national cardiac surgery registry. The platform was deployed in a high-volume cardiac surgery centre and uses a hybrid workflow combining automated data extraction (66% of variables) and structured manual entry. Data quality was ensured through automated validation rules, cross-check procedures, and real-time monitoring dashboards.ResultsSince deployment in May 2022, CPB-REPORT has prospectively captured all cardiac surgery procedures performed under CPB at a single institution, with 4,347 procedures transmitted to the national registry. Dataset completeness, defined as the proportion of registry variables available per patient record, improved from 68% at platform deployment to 90% in 2025, following a stepwise approach combining automated data extraction, real-time monitoring dashboards, and structured user training. The platform operates within a secure hospital infrastructure based on a demilitarised zone, with no cybersecurity incident reported. In addition, real-time outcome monitoring enabled early detection of a surgical site infection cluster in 2022, leading to rapid institutional corrective action.ConclusionThis implementation demonstrates that ETL-based perioperative data integration is feasible using existing hospital infrastructure. Beyond improving data quality and enabling real-time safety monitoring, the platform offers a scalable and interoperable model to support standardised data integration across institutions and facilitate consistent population of national and international registries.

AI.research_question: 自动化围手术期数据集成平台在真实世界实施中如何影响数据完整性、临床工作流程和患者安全？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ETL（提取-转换-加载）架构的数据集成理论，结合混合工作流程（自动化数据提取与结构化手动录入），强调数据质量保障机制（自动验证规则、交叉检查程序、实时监控仪表板）。

title: Governing the Meteorological Information Chain: Knowledge Infrastructure, Regulatory Asymmetry, and Institutional Resilience A Legal-Comparative Analysis
