title: On Track but Too Slow? The Dynamics of EU Decarbonization
affiliations: and University of Milan-Bicocca, Italy - Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS)

detail.title: On Track but Too Slow? The Dynamics of EU Decarbonization

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 573
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite the strong commitment of European countries to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050, the extent to which key policies and drivers jointly shape emissions dynamics remains insufficiently investigated. To fill this gap, the study investigates the combined effects of the circular economy, energy transition, emissions trading systems, carbon tax, and digitalization on carbon reduction in the EU member states. Using annual data from 2000 to 2023, the analysis integrates causal discovery, time-varying dependence modeling, and machine learning methods to unravel system-level causal structure, dynamic connectedness, and future emission trajectories. The Directed Acyclic Graph method, especially the Fast Adjacency Skewness algorithm, identifies both contemporaneous and lagged causal relationships, in which resource productivity acts as a transmission channel within the system. Lagged disequilibrium shocks propagate from upstream circular economy factor (material footprint) and digitalization to midstream efficiency (resource productivity), and ultimately are transmitted to emissions. Time-varying copula models confirm significant heterogeneity and evolving dependence among key factors, highlighting the nature of the dynamic relationships. Forecasting results, based on a Support Vector Regression model under the European Union's 2030 climate policy target, indicate a persistently declining emission trajectory, however at an insufficient speed to meet the EU's 2030 target. Sensitivity analysis indicates that this gap does not reflect a policy failure but the need for accelerated policy adjustments.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用因果发现、时变依赖建模和机器学习方法，分析了欧盟成员国中循环经济、能源转型、排放交易体系、碳税和数字化对碳减排的联合影响。研究发现资源生产率是系统内的传导渠道，排放呈持续下降趋势但速度不足以实现欧盟2030年目标。
AI.research_question: 欧盟关键政策（循环经济、能源转型、排放交易体系、碳税、数字化）如何共同影响碳排放动态？这些因素之间的因果结构、动态关联和未来排放轨迹是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管欧洲国家承诺2050年实现净零排放，但关键政策和驱动因素如何共同塑造排放动态的研究仍不足。需要填补这一研究空白，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统因果结构理论、动态关联理论、政策协同效应理论。研究将循环经济、能源转型、排放交易、碳税和数字化视为相互关联的系统要素。
AI.method: 使用2000-2023年年度数据，整合因果发现（有向无环图方法，特别是快速邻接偏度算法）、时变依赖建模（时变copula模型）和机器学习方法（支持向量回归模型）。
AI.findings: 1. 资源生产率是系统内的传导渠道；2. 滞后非均衡冲击从上游循环经济因素（材料足迹）和数字化传导到中游效率（资源生产率），最终影响排放；3. 关键因素间存在显著异质性和演化的依赖关系；4. 排放呈持续下降趋势但速度不足以实现欧盟2030年目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了欧盟碳减排政策系统的因果结构；2. 识别了资源生产率作为传导渠道的作用机制；3. 提供了动态关联的实证证据；4. 发展了多政策协同效应的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，显示当前政策路径不足以实现2030年目标；2. 识别了需要加速调整的政策领域；3. 提供了敏感性分析支持政策优化；4. 强调了政策协同的重要性。

title: A Behavioral Analysis of UPI Usage and Its Impact on Impulsive Spending Among Students
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Behavioral Analysis of UPI Usage and Its Impact on Impulsive Spending Among Students

declarations.declarationOfInterest: THE author declares no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on voluntary survey responses.no personal or sensitive data was collected and all responses were anonymous .Therefore,formal ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the widespread adoption of UPI among students and examines its impact on impulsive spending behaviour. Using primary data collected from 48 respondents, the study combines descriptive statistical analysis with qualitative insights. The findings suggest that while UPI enhances convenience, it also significantly increases impulsive spending due to reduced psychological barriers and instant transaction capabilities.

AI.tldr: UPI在学生中的广泛采用显著增加了冲动性消费，虽然提升了支付便利性，但降低了心理障碍和即时交易能力导致了更多的非理性消费行为。
AI.research_question: UPI在学生群体中的广泛采用如何影响他们的冲动性消费行为？
AI.motivation: 随着数字支付平台UPI在学生中的普及，需要研究这种便捷支付方式是否会导致更多的冲动性消费行为，特别是在年轻消费群体中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学理论，特别是冲动消费理论、心理账户理论和即时满足理论，分析数字支付如何降低消费心理障碍。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，收集48名受访者的原始数据，结合描述性统计分析和定性洞察分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现UPI虽然提升了支付便利性，但显著增加了冲动性消费，主要原因是降低了心理障碍和提供了即时交易能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字支付与消费行为理论提供了实证支持，揭示了便捷支付技术如何通过心理机制影响消费决策过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构、家长和支付平台提供管理建议，帮助学生在享受数字支付便利的同时培养理性的消费习惯。

title: Banks as Stewards
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and Columbia Business School

detail.title: Banks as Stewards
detail.abstract: Banks may play a more active role in corporate finance than previously documented. We document that banks hire industry experts and then steward firms to undertake investments in expansion (new to the firm) sectors.  In supervisory data including detailed regulatory risk measures and granular loan-level industry attribution, expansion loans are double as likely to emerge in bank-firm potential pairs when the bank has precise industry specialization or higher degree experts. Results are robust to specifications that build off dynamic comparables strategies (Sun and Abraham, 2021), `within-firm' (Khwaja and Mian, 2008}) and `within-bank'  (Blickle et al., 2024) analyses, and fully saturated bank-firm-time models (Paravisini et al., 2023). Conceptualizing our setting, we frame that bank stewarding will be more prevalent where firms neglect expansion investment because of high discount rates. Empirically, the effect of bank expertise and specialization unlocking expansion loans is increasing in firms' short-termist discount rates.  Finally, we document the mechanism through loan pricing:  banks provide loans at 7-to-72 bps lower interest rates to induce loan volume, and thereby overcoming Kodak moments. Such expansion stewarding is likely most valuable in moments of transition for an industry.  We corroborate our general expansion evidence in the context of firm expansion investments from the energy transition.  Active bank stewarding moves the literature beyond the classic view of banks as mere credit providers.

AI.tldr: 银行通过雇佣行业专家来引导企业进行扩张性投资，特别是在企业因高折现率而忽视扩张时。银行通过提供更低的贷款利率（7-72个基点）来促进贷款规模，帮助企业克服"柯达时刻"的转型困境。
AI.research_question: 银行如何通过行业专业知识和专家资源来引导企业进行扩张性投资？这种银行引导机制在什么条件下更为有效？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将银行视为单纯的信贷提供者，但本文认为银行在企业融资中扮演更积极的角色。银行可能通过行业专业知识引导企业进行扩张投资，特别是在行业转型时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行引导理论、行业专业知识理论、企业投资决策中的折现率理论、柯达时刻转型理论
AI.method: 使用监管数据，包括详细的风险衡量指标和贷款级别的行业归属数据。采用动态可比策略、公司内部分析、银行内部分析以及完全饱和的银行-公司-时间模型等多种稳健性检验方法。
AI.findings: 1. 当银行具有精确的行业专业化或更高程度的专家资源时，扩张性贷款出现的可能性是原来的两倍；2. 银行专业知识和专业化对扩张性贷款的促进作用在企业短期主义折现率较高时更为明显；3. 银行通过提供7-72个基点的更低贷款利率来诱导贷款规模；4. 在能源转型背景下，银行引导企业进行扩张投资的效果得到验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了银行作为积极引导者的新理论框架；2. 将银行行业专业知识与企业投资决策联系起来；3. 解释了银行如何帮助企业克服转型时期的"柯达时刻"；4. 拓展了传统银行作为单纯信贷提供者的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行如何通过雇佣行业专家来创造价值提供实践指导；2. 为企业如何在行业转型时期获得银行支持提供启示；3. 为监管机构理解银行在企业投资中的角色提供新视角；4. 展示了银行在促进能源转型等重大经济转型中的作用。

title: Program Design and the Distributional Incidence of Housing Transfers. Evidence from a Universal Housing Allowance
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Program Design and the Distributional Incidence of Housing Transfers. Evidence from a Universal Housing Allowance
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first population-level distributional analysis of housing allowance incidence. Exploiting population-level data across 1,489 housing sub-markets, I estimate the effect of a universal housing allowance structured as a negative income tax on rents across the conditional distribution. Identification draws on a government communications campaign that increased claiming by 28 percent without altering the benefit formula. Quantile regressions reveal two distributional gradients. Within the recipient segment, allowance expenditure has no effect on lower quartile rents at any quantile from the 10th to the 90th percentile, while the poverty-concentration effect of take-up steepens monotonically, strongest where landlords have room to moderate rent growth. Across the full market, the take-up effect peaks at the 25th percentile where the recipient cohort is most concentrated, attenuating as higher-income renters dilute the signal. These gradients are the distributional signature of poverty, not demand. Comparative institutional analysis reveals that where allowances operate under the negative income tax formula without dollar-for-dollar rent coverage, indexation to rents, transparent subsidy communication, or dwelling quality conditionality, the result is a null incidence - consistent across the EHAP experiments, the Finnish allowance, and the present study. Where these features are present, positive effects emerge as the capture channel operates. Program design determines incidence.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对住房补贴的分布效应进行人口层面分析，发现负所得税结构的普遍住房补贴对租金分布产生两种梯度效应：在受助者群体内，补贴支出对低四分位租金无影响，而贫困集中效应随领取率增加而增强；在整个市场中，领取效应在受助者最集中的第25百分位达到峰值。制度比较分析显示，当补贴采用负所得税公式且不提供全额租金覆盖、租金指数化、透明补贴沟通或住房质量条件时，补贴效应为零。
AI.research_question: 普遍住房补贴（采用负所得税结构）如何影响租金的条件分布？补贴的制度设计特征如何决定其分布效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对住房补贴分布效应的系统性分析，特别是采用负所得税结构的普遍住房补贴如何在不同租金分位数上产生异质性影响。理解补贴的制度设计特征如何决定其分布效应对于政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负所得税理论、住房补贴经济学、租金分布理论、制度比较分析框架
AI.method: 利用政府宣传活动（使领取率提高28%但不改变福利公式）作为识别策略，使用1,489个住房子市场的人口层面数据，采用分位数回归分析补贴对租金条件分布的影响，并进行比较制度分析。
AI.findings: 1. 在受助者群体内：补贴支出对第10-90百分位的低四分位租金无影响；贫困集中效应随领取率增加而单调增强，在房东有空间调节租金增长的地方最强。2. 在整个市场中：领取效应在第25百分位（受助者最集中的地方）达到峰值，随着高收入租房者稀释信号而减弱。3. 这些梯度是贫困的分布特征，而非需求效应。4. 比较制度分析显示，当补贴采用负所得税公式且缺乏全额租金覆盖、租金指数化、透明沟通或住房质量条件时，补贴效应为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供了住房补贴分布效应的系统性分析框架。2. 区分了贫困集中效应与需求效应的分布特征。3. 建立了补贴制度设计特征与分布效应之间的理论联系。4. 扩展了负所得税理论在住房补贴领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了设计有效住房补贴制度的实证依据。2. 识别了避免补贴被房东捕获的关键制度特征。3. 提供了评估住房补贴分布效应的分析方法。4. 为EHAP实验、芬兰补贴和本研究的一致性发现提供了政策启示。

title: Portfolio Exposure as Rainbow Options: Fast and Noise-Free CVA and PFE Computation for Linear FX Portfolios

detail.title: Portfolio Exposure as Rainbow Options: Fast and Noise-Free CVA and PFE Computation for Linear FX Portfolios
detail.abstract: Fast and stable computation of counterparty credit risk metrics such as Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) and Potential Future Exposure (PFE) remains a central challenge in the pricing and risk management of derivative portfolios, particularly in real-time and incremental settings. Monte Carlo simulation, while flexible, is often computationally expensive and introduces noise that complicates sensitivity analysis and day-on-day P&L attribution. In this paper, we propose a semi-analytic framework for the efficient computation of exposure profiles for portfolios of linear foreign exchange (FX) instruments, including FX forwards and swaps. The key idea is to express the portfolio value as a linear combination of underlying FX rates and to approximate the resulting exposure distribution using tractable basket option representations. Expected Positive Exposure (EPE) is obtained via a spread option approximation, while PFE is computed through inversion of a corresponding digital spread formulation. The proposed approach delivers fast, stable, and noise-free estimates of both EPE and PFE, making it well suited to real-time applications and incremental risk calculations. The framework naturally extends to portfolios with linear exposure to equities and commodities, and is applicable to both real-time and end-of-day CVA and PFE calculations. In the latter setting, the methodology enables stable and noise-free day-on-day P&L attribution. Numerical results demonstrate strong agreement with benchmark Monte Carlo simulations while achieving significant gains in computational efficiency and numerical stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种半解析框架，用于高效计算线性外汇工具组合的风险敞口，通过篮子期权表示法快速、稳定地计算EPE和PFE，避免了蒙特卡洛模拟的计算成本和噪声问题。
AI.research_question: 如何高效、稳定地计算外汇衍生品组合的对手方信用风险指标（如CVA和PFE），特别是在实时和增量计算场景中？
AI.motivation: 蒙特卡洛模拟虽然灵活，但计算成本高且引入噪声，不利于敏感性分析和逐日损益归因，特别是在实时和增量风险计算场景中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于线性组合和篮子期权表示的理论框架，将投资组合价值表示为外汇汇率的线性组合，并使用可处理的篮子期权表示来近似风险敞口分布。
AI.method: 半解析方法：通过价差期权近似计算EPE，通过数字价差公式反演计算PFE，适用于线性外汇工具（如外汇远期和掉期）组合。
AI.findings: 该方法与基准蒙特卡洛模拟结果高度一致，同时在计算效率和数值稳定性方面取得显著提升，能够提供快速、稳定、无噪声的EPE和PFE估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个半解析框架，将投资组合风险敞口计算转化为可处理的篮子期权问题，为线性衍生品组合的风险计算提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法适用于实时和日终的CVA和PFE计算，支持稳定的逐日损益归因，并可扩展到具有线性敞口的股票和商品组合，具有实际应用价值。

title: Video Games and user Rights in Copyright Law
affiliations: University College London

detail.title: Video Games and user Rights in Copyright Law
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the evolving concept of users in the video game industry and its intersection with copyright law, particularly within the EU. Traditionally centred around individual players, the notion of users has expanded to include eSports athletes, streamers, influencers, cloners, modders, and fan fiction authors. These user categories have shifted from passive consumers to active contributors in the creative landscape of video games. This transformation brings forward legal implications, especially concerning "user rights" – a term rooted in EU copyright law. The chapter focuses on the challenges and opportunities of incorporating these evolving user practices into the EU legal framework, with occasional reference to U.S. copyright law. It outlines the historical development of video game users, discusses the scope and recognition of user rights, and highlights the complexity of aligning emerging user behaviours with existing legal structures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了电子游戏行业中"用户"概念的演变及其与欧盟版权法的交叉。传统上以个体玩家为中心的用户概念已扩展到包括电竞选手、主播、网红、克隆者、模组制作者和同人作者等群体。这些用户从被动消费者转变为游戏创意领域的积极贡献者，带来了"用户权利"相关的法律挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何将电子游戏行业中不断演变的用户实践（包括电竞选手、主播、模组制作者等新兴用户群体）纳入欧盟版权法律框架？
AI.motivation: 电子游戏行业的用户概念已从传统个体玩家扩展到包括电竞选手、主播、网红、克隆者、模制作者和同人作者等多种角色，这些用户从被动消费者转变为创意贡献者，带来了"用户权利"相关的法律挑战，需要探讨如何将这些新兴实践纳入现有法律框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟版权法中的"用户权利"概念，以及用户从被动消费者到主动贡献者的角色转变理论。
AI.method: 法律分析框架，结合历史发展分析、法律文本解释和比较法研究（偶尔参考美国版权法）。
AI.findings: 电子游戏用户概念已显著扩展，新兴用户群体在创意生态中扮演积极角色；将不断演变的用户实践纳入欧盟法律框架面临挑战和机遇；用户权利的范围和认可度需要重新评估；现有法律结构与新兴用户行为之间存在复杂关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"用户"概念在数字创意产业中的理论理解；深化了用户权利在版权法中的理论框架；为理解用户从消费者到贡献者的角色转变提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供将新兴游戏用户实践纳入法律框架的指导；帮助游戏行业利益相关者理解用户权利的法律边界；为法律从业者处理游戏相关版权问题提供分析框架。

title: Classification Cascades: Evidence from ICD Code Transitions in Healthcare Delivery and Spending

detail.title: Classification Cascades: Evidence from ICD Code Transitions in Healthcare Delivery and Spending

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available, de-identified administrative data (CMS PSPS Public Use Files and OECD aggregate statistics). No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Classification systems—standardized taxonomies such as the International Classification of Diseases (ICD), the Harmonized System (HS) for trade, and the Classification of Functions of Government (COFOG)—constitute foundational infrastructures of modern governance and economic measurement. This paper introduces the concept of classification cascades: the hypothesis that revisions to classification systems generate predictable, multi-stage disruptions that propagate from administrative coding through institutional processing to measurable behavioral and economic outcomes. I test this hypothesis using two complementary empirical strategies. First, I estimate event-study models exploiting staggered ICD adoption across 15 OECD countries (2005–2020), documenting discontinuities in pharmaceutical consumption consistent with cascade-induced shifts in recording and utilization at the point of classification revision. Second, I implement a difference-in-differences (DiD) design using U.S. Medicare claims data surrounding the ICD-9 to ICD-10 transition (October 1, 2015), comparing psychotherapy codes (treatment group) against evaluation and management codes (control group). The DiD estimates reveal a statistically significant increase in claim denial rates of +3.36 percentage points in the transition year (p = 0.004) and +2.99 percentage points in the post-transition year (p = 0.014). Descriptive evidence further documents a 6.9% decline in service volume and a 7.6% decline in Medicare payments by 2016 relative to the 2014 baseline. These findings are externally validated by Stewart et al. (2019), who document parallel disruptions in diagnosis recording across ten U.S. health systems. I argue that classification cascades represent a general class of administrative policy shock with implications extending beyond healthcare to international trade, public finance, and regulatory governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"分类级联"概念，指分类系统修订会引发可预测的多阶段连锁反应，从行政编码到制度处理再到可测量的行为和经济结果。通过ICD分类系统修订的实证研究，发现医疗索赔拒绝率显著上升、服务量和医保支付下降等系统性影响。
AI.research_question: 分类系统修订是否会产生可预测的多阶段连锁反应（分类级联），从行政编码层面传播到制度处理层面，最终影响可测量的行为和经济结果？
AI.motivation: 分类系统（如ICD、HS、COFOG）是现代治理和经济测量的基础基础设施，但对其修订如何影响实际行政流程和经济结果的研究不足。理解分类系统修订的系统性影响对政策制定和治理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分类级联理论：分类系统修订会引发可预测的多阶段连锁反应，从行政编码层面（一级）传播到制度处理层面（二级），最终影响可测量的行为和经济结果（三级）。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的实证策略：1）事件研究法，利用15个OECD国家ICD分类系统采用的时间差异（2005-2020）；2）双重差分法（DiD），使用美国Medicare索赔数据，分析ICD-9到ICD-10过渡期间心理治疗代码（处理组）与评估管理代码（对照组）的差异。
AI.findings: 1）ICD修订导致药品消费出现不连续性；2）ICD-9到ICD-10过渡期间，索赔拒绝率显著增加（过渡年+3.36个百分点，过渡后年+2.99个百分点）；3）服务量下降6.9%，Medicare支付下降7.6%（2016年相对于2014年基线）；4）外部验证支持这些发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"分类级联"这一新概念框架，将分类系统修订视为一类特殊的行政政策冲击，为理解分类系统修订的系统性影响提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了分类系统修订影响的实证证据；2）揭示了分类系统修订对医疗系统运营的实际影响；3）研究框架可应用于国际贸易、公共财政和监管治理等其他领域。

title: Rethinking Excise Incidence on Tobacco Products -Toward a Harm-Based Specific Tax

detail.title: Rethinking Excise Incidence on Tobacco Products -Toward a Harm-Based Specific Tax
detail.abstract: The European Commission's July 2025 proposal to revise the Tobacco Taxation Directive represents a welcome step forward, raising the EU minimum excise duty, and extending taxation to new products. However, the benefits and cost of the excise incidence requirement needs more careful analysis. Our empirical analysis of EU27 countries over 2016-2025 reveals that the excise incidence requirement itself-mandating that excise duties represent at least 60% of the Weighted Average Price (WAP) has not achieved its stated objectives of price harmonization and consumption reduction. Despite the 60% WAP rule remaining unchanged since 2011, crosscountry gaps in excise burdens and retail prices have widened rather than converged. In addition, panel regressions controlling for country and year fixed e!ects reveal that excise incidence is not a reliable predictor of retail prices, tax revenues, or consumption outcomes. Moreover, countries with restrictive regulations on alternative nicotine products experienced increases in smoking prevalence (as share of population), while countries with less restrictive approaches showed steady reductions. We propose an alternative framework based on harm-based specific taxation, indexed to inflation, which di!erentiates tax rates according to product-specific health risks. We theoretically demonstrate that for every uniform tax regime, there exists a harm-based tax that reduces public health costs while maintaining or increasing budget revenues.

AI.tldr: 欧盟烟草税指令修订提案虽进步，但现行60%加权平均价格(WAP)消费税要求未能实现价格协调和消费减少目标，反而加剧国家间差异。基于危害的差异化征税方案能更好平衡公共卫生和财政收入。
AI.research_question: 欧盟烟草消费税的加权平均价格(WAP)60%要求是否有效实现了价格协调和消费减少的目标？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会2025年7月修订烟草税指令的提案虽然提高了最低消费税并将征税范围扩大到新产品，但现行消费税要求的效益和成本需要更仔细分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 烟草税政策理论、价格协调理论、消费税效应理论、基于危害的差异化征税理论
AI.method: 对欧盟27国2016-2025年的实证分析，包括面板回归控制国家和年份固定效应
AI.findings: 1) 60% WAP规则自2011年未变，但国家间消费税负担和零售价格差距扩大而非收敛；2) 消费税发生率不能可靠预测零售价格、税收收入或消费结果；3) 对替代尼古丁产品监管严格的国家吸烟率上升，监管宽松的国家吸烟率稳定下降
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于危害的差异化征税理论框架，理论上证明对于任何统一税制，都存在一种基于危害的税收能减少公共卫生成本同时维持或增加预算收入
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟烟草税改革提供了替代方案：基于产品特定健康风险的差异化税率，并与通胀挂钩的基于危害的特定征税框架

title: One Substance, Multiple Legal Realities: Classification Cascades in the Psychedelic Medicine Transition

detail.title: One Substance, Multiple Legal Realities: Classification Cascades in the Psychedelic Medicine Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known conflicts of interest associated with this publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of publicly available aggregate data and clinical trial results. No original human subject research was conducted by the author; therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This paper analyzes data from registered clinical trials (e.g., COMP005, COMP006, and jRCTs031230351) conducted by third-party institutions as cited in the text.

detail.abstract: Psilocybin simultaneously holds six contradictory legal classifications across jurisdictions: Schedule I (US federal), Breakthrough Therapy (FDA), legal therapeutic use (Oregon, Colorado), Schedule 8 medical use (Australia), and pending rescheduling review (DEA/HHS). This regulatory fragmentation constitutes a classification cascade-a multi-stage disruption propagated through administrative, clinical, and economic channels when a single substance is reclassified unevenly across overlapping governance systems. Using four complementary empirical strategies, I document the cascade's progression: (i) a 21-country policy panel tracking 44 psychedelic regulatory events across 6 substance categories (1992-2025), revealing a sharp inflection at the 2018 FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation; (ii) PubMed publication data extracted via NCBI E-utilities API showing psilocybin-depression research growing at 58.6% compound annual growth rate (2015-2025)-the fastest in psychedelic medicine, with total psilocybin publications increasing 54-fold from 12 (2000) to 656 (2025); (iii) trade flow analysis using difference-indifferences designs showing that botanical pharmaceutical imports (HS 1211) diverge sharply from control commodities following cannabis/psychedelic policy reforms, with estimates ranging from +67% to +97% in liberalizing countries; and (iv) FDA pipeline analysis documenting COMP360's consecutive Phase 3 successes (MADRS-3.6 and-3.8 versus placebo, both p < 0.001) alongside simultaneous political vetoes. The findings demonstrate that classification cascades-previously documented in healthcare billing (Tamba 2026)-extend to substance regulation, where they generate measurable distortions in research output, trade flows, clinical access, and enforcement patterns. I introduce the concept of the classification split-a state in which a single entity simultaneously occupies contradictory 2 categories across overlapping governance systems-as a distinct and increasingly prevalent form of regulatory failure. As psilocybin approaches FDA approval (NDA expected Q4 2026), the cascade documented here is accelerating rather than resolving.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了赛洛西宾（psilocybin）在全球范围内同时拥有六种相互矛盾的法律分类的监管碎片化现象，提出了"分类级联"概念，通过四种实证方法追踪了这种监管不一致如何通过行政、临床和经济渠道传播，并创造了"分类分裂"这一新概念来描述单一实体在重叠治理系统中同时占据矛盾分类的监管失败状态。
AI.research_question: 赛洛西宾在全球范围内同时拥有六种相互矛盾的法律分类（如美国联邦一级管制、FDA突破性疗法、州级合法治疗使用等），这种监管碎片化如何构成"分类级联"，并通过行政、临床和经济渠道传播，对研究产出、贸易流动、临床获取和执法模式产生可测量的扭曲？
AI.motivation: 赛洛西宾作为一种物质同时拥有六种相互矛盾的法律分类，这种监管碎片化现象构成了一个独特的案例，揭示了当单一物质在重叠治理系统中被不一致地重新分类时，会如何通过行政、临床和经济渠道传播多阶段破坏。随着赛洛西宾接近FDA批准（预计2026年第四季度），这种级联正在加速而非解决，需要理论框架来解释这种监管失败。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 分类级联理论：借鉴Tamba（2026）在医疗账单领域提出的概念，扩展到物质监管领域，描述当单一物质在重叠治理系统中被不一致地重新分类时，通过行政、临床和经济渠道传播的多阶段破坏过程。
2. 分类分裂概念：引入的新概念，描述单一实体在重叠治理系统中同时占据矛盾分类的状态，作为一种独特且日益普遍的监管失败形式。
3. 监管碎片化理论：分析不同司法管辖区（联邦、州、国际）对同一物质采用矛盾分类时产生的系统性影响。
AI.method:
采用四种互补的实证策略：
1. 政策面板分析：追踪21个国家44个迷幻药监管事件（1992-2025年），涵盖6种物质类别，识别2018年FDA突破性疗法指定作为转折点。
2. 文献计量分析：使用NCBI E-utilities API提取PubMed出版物数据，分析赛洛西宾-抑郁症研究的复合年增长率（2015-2025年为58.6%），以及出版物总数从2000年的12篇增长到2025年的656篇（54倍增长）。
3. 贸易流动分析：使用双重差分设计，分析植物药品进口（HS 1211）在迷幻药政策改革后与控制商品的差异，发现在自由化国家增长67%至97%。
4. FDA管道分析：记录COMP360（赛洛西宾疗法）连续三期临床试验成功（MADRS评分改善3.6和3.8分 vs 安慰剂，p<0.001）与同时存在的政治否决。
AI.findings:
1. 监管事件分析显示2018年FDA突破性疗法指定是一个明显的转折点，加速了全球迷幻药监管变化。
2. 赛洛西宾-抑郁症研究以58.6%的复合年增长率增长，是迷幻药医学中最快的，出版物总数54倍增长。
3. 贸易流动分析显示，在迷幻药政策自由化国家，植物药品进口显著增加67-97%。
4. COMP360三期临床试验显示显著疗效（MADRS改善3.6-3.8分，p<0.001），但面临政治障碍。
5. 分类级联在物质监管领域产生可测量的扭曲，影响研究产出、贸易流动、临床获取和执法模式。
6. 随着赛洛西宾接近FDA批准，分类级联正在加速而非解决。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将分类级联理论从医疗账单领域扩展到物质监管领域，建立了跨领域的理论框架。
2. 引入了"分类分裂"这一新概念，作为描述单一实体在重叠治理系统中同时占据矛盾分类的监管失败状态。
3. 提供了分析监管碎片化如何通过行政、临床和经济渠道传播的系统性框架。
4. 为理解新兴治疗领域（如迷幻药医学）中的监管矛盾提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了识别和缓解分类级联的工具，特别是在迷幻药等新兴治疗领域。
2. 帮助研究人员和临床医生理解监管环境对研究产出和临床获取的影响。
3. 为企业（特别是制药和植物药品进口商）提供了贸易流动受监管变化影响的实证证据。
4. 为FDA和其他监管机构在审批赛洛西宾等物质时面临的矛盾提供了实证基础。
5. 强调了需要协调的监管方法，以避免分类分裂导致的系统性扭曲。

title: Pay For Performance - CEOs vs Baseball Players
affiliations: Shareholder Value Advisors, Inc.

detail.title: Pay For Performance - CEOs vs Baseball Players

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not a patient study nor a case study. No approval or consent is required.

detail.abstract: Corporate boards and baseball team owners face some common challenges in managing pay. Both try to create strong incentives for outstanding performance and both have to balance their desire for strong incentives with the need to retain key talent and control cost. In this paper, I present an analysis of relative pay vs relative performance that allows us to compare CEO and baseball player pay on four dimensions: pay leverage, pay alignment, the pay premium at average performance and relative pay risk. We can measure these pay dimensions at the individual level, the team or company level and the industry level. When we do so, we come to four surprising conclusions. First, the median baseball team has much more consistent pay leverage than the median S&P 1500 public company. Second, pay leverage is far more consistent across teams than across S&P 1500 companies. Third, baseball, as an industry, has higher pay leverage than 50 of the 58 GICS industries studied and higher pay alignment than every GICS industry. Fourth, baseball teams and boards both sacrifice incentive strength for retention, leading them to overpay for performance, but baseball teams are more discriminating about where they overpay and have smaller overpayments.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了CEO和棒球运动员薪酬的四个维度：薪酬杠杆、薪酬对齐、平均绩效的薪酬溢价和相对薪酬风险。研究发现棒球行业在薪酬激励设计上比大多数上市公司更一致、更有效。
AI.research_question: CEO薪酬与棒球运动员薪酬在激励设计上有何异同？棒球行业的薪酬激励设计是否比上市公司更有效？
AI.motivation: 公司董事会和棒球队老板在薪酬管理上面临相似挑战：既要创造强激励促进卓越表现，又要平衡人才保留和成本控制。通过比较这两个领域的薪酬实践，可以相互借鉴经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、激励理论和薪酬设计理论，重点关注薪酬与绩效的相对关系，包括薪酬杠杆、薪酬对齐等四个维度。
AI.method: 采用相对薪酬与相对绩效的分析方法，在个体、团队/公司、行业三个层面测量四个薪酬维度，比较S&P 1500上市公司和棒球行业的薪酬实践。
AI.findings: 1) 中位数棒球队的薪酬杠杆比中位数S&P 1500公司更一致；2) 棒球队间的薪酬杠杆一致性远高于上市公司；3) 棒球行业的薪酬杠杆高于58个GICS行业中的50个，薪酬对齐高于所有行业；4) 两者都为保留人才而牺牲激励强度，导致绩效过高支付，但棒球队更精准且支付溢价更小。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了薪酬激励设计的比较研究框架，提出了跨行业薪酬实践评估的四维度模型，为代理理论和激励理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上市公司董事会提供了棒球行业薪酬设计的可借鉴经验，特别是如何提高薪酬杠杆一致性和更精准地设计激励方案，避免过度支付绩效溢价。

title: Fiscal Costs and Benefits from Mexican Migrants in the Social Security & Welfare System of the U.S
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Fiscal Costs and Benefits from Mexican Migrants in the Social Security & Welfare System of the U.S

declarations.funderStatement: This was the third chapter of my PhD thesis at EL Colegio de México. Doctoral scholarship from the Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (SECIHTI)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the fiscal effects of Mexican migrants on the U.S. social security and welfare systems from 2007 to 2017. Using a dual-methodology approach-micro-level data from the Current Population Survey (CPS) and macro-level budgetary data from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO)-the analysis estimates the net fiscal balance of Mexican migrants compared to U.S. natives and other migrant groups. The findings reveal a persistent fiscal deficit among migrant groups, regardless of citizenship status, driven by structural disparities in legal status that limit tax contributions and benefit access. However, the results also show that time since arrival negatively correlates with welfare utilization, suggesting economic assimilation over time. The study underscores the need for policy frameworks that facilitate formal labor market integration to enhance migrant contributions and mitigate fiscal pressures.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2007-2017年间墨西哥移民对美国社保和福利体系的财政影响，发现移民群体存在持续的财政赤字，但随着时间的推移，福利使用率下降，表明经济融合效应。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥移民对美国社会保障和福利体系产生了怎样的财政影响？与本土美国公民和其他移民群体相比，墨西哥移民的净财政平衡状况如何？
AI.motivation: 移民政策辩论中经常讨论移民对公共财政的影响，但缺乏对特定群体（如墨西哥移民）长期财政效应的实证分析。了解移民的财政贡献和福利使用模式对制定合理的移民政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移民经济学和财政社会学理论，关注移民的财政平衡、经济融合过程以及制度性障碍（如法律地位）对税收贡献和福利获取的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重方法：微观层面使用当前人口调查（CPS）数据，宏观层面使用国会预算办公室（CBO）预算数据，比较墨西哥移民与美国本土公民及其他移民群体的净财政平衡。
AI.findings: 1. 移民群体（无论公民身份）存在持续的财政赤字；2. 结构性法律地位差异限制了税收贡献和福利获取；3. 到达时间与福利使用率呈负相关，表明经济融合效应；4. 墨西哥移民的财政表现与其他移民群体存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了移民财政影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了法律地位作为结构性障碍的作用机制；3. 验证了经济融合理论在财政维度的时间效应；4. 丰富了移民经济学中关于群体差异的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为移民政策制定提供数据支持；2. 强调促进正规劳动力市场融合的政策必要性；3. 帮助缓解财政压力；4. 为移民改革辩论提供实证依据。

title: Policy Capacity and Institutional Reform for Social Work in Southeast Asia
affiliations: Google and Universitas Bhayangkara Jakarta Raya

detail.title: Policy Capacity and Institutional Reform for Social Work in Southeast Asia
detail.abstract: In Southeast Asia, social work has emerged as a critical profession for addressing complex social issues including poverty, rapid urbanization, labor migration, population aging, child protection, and mental health. Even with increasing demand, social work policy frameworks remain uneven, under-institutionalized, and under-professionalized in the region. As a representative and strategically critical paper, the authors have attempted to examine how social work policy can be strengthened in Southeast Asia. Through comparative regional analysis, policy documents, and academic literature, the paper analyzes how social work evolved. It also examines existing governance and regulatory gaps, non-governmental organizations, international cooperation, and emerging best practices. Despite achievements in formal recognition, workforce development, and service expansion, Southeast Asian social work policy trajectory remains challenging due to fragmented governance, limited professional autonomy, and uneven service quality. Reforms across legislation, education, workforce regulation, financing, and intersectoral collaboration are needed to strengthen social work policy. In conclusion, a multilevel policy framework is proposed to advance professionalization, institutional capacity, and social protection outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过比较区域分析，探讨了东南亚社会工作政策的现状、挑战及强化路径，提出了多层次政策框架以推进专业化、制度能力和社会保护成果。
AI.research_question: 如何加强东南亚地区的社会工作政策？
AI.motivation: 东南亚地区社会工作在应对贫困、快速城市化、劳动力迁移、人口老龄化、儿童保护和心理健康等复杂社会问题中日益重要，但该地区社会工作政策框架不均衡、制度化不足且专业化程度低，需要系统分析以强化政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较区域分析框架，结合政策分析、治理理论和专业发展理论，探讨社会工作政策的演进路径和制度构建。
AI.method: 采用比较区域分析方法，结合政策文件分析和学术文献综述，考察社会工作的发展历程、治理与监管缺口、非政府组织作用、国际合作以及新兴最佳实践。
AI.findings: 尽管在正式认可、劳动力发展和服务扩展方面取得成就，但东南亚社会工作政策发展仍面临治理碎片化、专业自主权有限和服务质量不均等挑战。需要在立法、教育、劳动力监管、资金和跨部门协作等方面进行改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于东南亚地区的多层次社会工作政策分析框架，丰富了发展中国家社会工作专业化和制度化的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东南亚各国政府、非政府组织和国际机构提供了具体的政策改革建议，包括立法完善、教育体系强化、专业监管机制建立、资金保障和跨部门协作机制，以提升社会工作政策效能和社会保护成果。

title: Category Theory as a Unifying Language for Artificial Intelligence: Functors, Monads, Parametric Maps, String Diagrams, and Toposes
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Category Theory as a Unifying Language for Artificial Intelligence: Functors, Monads, Parametric Maps, String Diagrams, and Toposes
detail.abstract: Two recent programmes independently converge on category theory as the right language for artificial intelligence. Noguer i Alonso [2026] organises the feedback loop between ideal mathematics and computational practice into ten pillars-computability, complexity, approximation, optimisation, statistical learning, numerical analysis, differential equations, path signatures, geometry, and mathematical physics-and proposes adjoint functor pairs F ⊣ G as the unifying structure, with the transformer as a central case study. Gavranović et al. [2024] establishes that equivariant layers are monad algebra homomorphisms, that recurrent and recursive networks arise as lax algebras for free parametric monads in the 2-category Para, and that weight tying is a comonoid structure (their Theorem G.10). The present paper aligns and extends both frameworks. Its main contributions are three modest observations. First, the group action monad and the Giry probability monad share structural features through Dirac-supported embeddings, clarifying an analogy between equivariance and probabilistic semantics. Second, every parametric map f : P × A → B in Para is a coKleisli morphism for the product comonad W P = P ×-, which gives a clean categorical reading of weight tying as the cartesian diagonal ∆ P : P → P × P. Third, in-context learning admits a presheaf-topos interpretation: forcing at stage k captures stable posterior concentration on a hypothesis, monotonicity is the sheaf condition, and emergence corresponds to a Heyting-algebra phase transition. A synthesis table maps each pillar to its categorical structure, and four open problems are identified.

AI.tldr: 本文整合了两个独立发展的范畴论AI框架，提出了三个核心观察：1）群作用单子与概率单子的结构相似性；2）参数化映射的余Kleisli解释；3）上下文学习的预层-拓扑斯解释。建立了十个AI支柱与范畴结构的对应关系。
AI.research_question: 如何统一和扩展两个独立的范畴论人工智能框架？范畴论如何为人工智能的不同支柱提供统一的数学语言？
AI.motivation: 两个独立的研究项目（Noguer i Alonso [2026]和Gavranović et al. [2024]）都发现范畴论是人工智能的合适语言，但采用不同方法。本文旨在整合这两个框架，提供更统一的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范畴论，特别是伴随函子对、单子理论、余Kleisli范畴、预层理论和拓扑斯理论。关键概念包括：伴随函子对F ⊣ G、单子代数同态、参数化单子、余Kleisli映射、预层和拓扑斯条件。
AI.method: 理论整合与扩展方法：通过范畴论分析对齐两个框架，提出三个核心观察，建立十个AI支柱与范畴结构的对应表，识别开放问题。
AI.findings: 三个主要发现：1）群作用单子与Giry概率单子通过Dirac支撑嵌入共享结构特征；2）Para中的参数化映射是乘积余单子的余Kleisli态射；3）上下文学习具有预层-拓扑斯解释，其中涌现对应Heyting代数相变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）统一了两个独立的范畴论AI框架；2）揭示了不同AI概念之间的深层范畴联系；3）提供了上下文学习的拓扑斯理论解释；4）建立了AI支柱与范畴结构的系统对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为AI系统设计提供统一的数学框架；2）帮助理解transformer等架构的范畴本质；3）为权重绑定等实践问题提供理论解释；4）识别了四个开放问题指导未来研究。

title: FlowPulse: A Flow-Based Liquidity Factor Framework for Corporate Bond Markets

detail.title: FlowPulse: A Flow-Based Liquidity Factor Framework for Corporate Bond Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed as an E-Trading Division Manager at SEQ Technology LLC. This research was conducted independently using the author's own resources and does not represent the views, products, or endorsement of the author's employer. No proprietary client data or employer resources were used. The author may seek to commercialize aspects of the framework described in this paper.

detail.abstract:
Corporate bond markets are characterized by fragmented liquidity, dealer-intermediated trading, and limited real-time transparency into supply and demand dynamics. Traditional valuation frameworks rely primarily on historical spread relationships, macroeconomic variables, and issuer fundamentals, while largely ignoring the informational content embedded in trading flows themselves. This paper introduces FlowPulse, a flow-based analytical framework designed to quantify directional liquidity pressure in corporate bond markets using aggregated institutional trading activity. The framework transforms transaction-level flow information into structured indicators of sector-level and security-level demand imbalances across issuers, sectors, and maturity buckets, constructing a systematic measure of market-wide liquidity pressure interpretable as a flow-based liquidity factor.

FlowPulse integrates three analytical layers: (1) a flow aggregation engine consolidating institutional trading activity—including both pre-trade dealer interest data and TRACE-reported executed trades—to identify directional buying and selling pressure; (2) a valuation layer comparing observed bond spreads with Ridge-regression-estimated fair-value spreads to identify relative-value dislocations; and (3) a predictive modeling layer incorporating Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks, Ridge regression, and mean-reversion signals trained on 12 features across a 70/30 rolling train-test framework with weekly retraining.

The framework has been implemented as a research prototype analytics platform designed for institutional fixed-income trading workflows. This paper presents the framework architecture, mathematical factor definitions, feature construction methodology, and proposed empirical specifications for evaluating the FlowPulse factors against credit spread dynamics. Prototype extensions to cryptocurrency and options markets are also presented, demonstrating the cross-asset applicability of the dual-stream flow aggregation approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowPulse框架，利用机构交易活动数据量化公司债券市场的流动性压力，通过三层分析（流量聚合、估值比较、预测建模）构建基于流量的流动性因子，并展示其在加密货币和期权市场的跨资产应用潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机构交易活动数据构建系统性的流动性压力指标，以更好地理解和预测公司债券市场的信用利差动态？
AI.motivation: 公司债券市场存在流动性碎片化、交易商中介化、实时透明度有限等问题，传统估值框架主要依赖历史利差关系、宏观经济变量和发行人基本面，而忽视了交易流量本身的信息内容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，强调交易流量信息在资产定价中的重要性；结合流动性因子理论和相对价值分析框架。
AI.method: 三层分析框架：1) 流量聚合引擎整合机构交易活动；2) 估值层使用岭回归估计公允价值利差；3) 预测建模层采用LSTM神经网络、岭回归和均值回归信号，基于12个特征在70/30滚动训练测试框架中进行周度再训练。
AI.findings: FlowPulse框架能够将交易级流量信息转化为结构化指标，量化部门级和证券级的需求失衡，构建可解释为基于流量的流动性因子的系统性市场流动性压力度量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统性的流量分析框架，将交易流量信息纳入公司债券估值体系；发展了基于机构交易活动的流动性压力量化方法；扩展了流动性因子理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了研究原型分析平台，适用于机构固定收益交易工作流程；提供了跨资产应用（加密货币和期权市场）的扩展；为交易员和投资组合经理提供了新的流动性压力监控和相对价值分析工具。

title: What the UAE Can Teach the US About Pharmaceutical Waste
affiliations: De Montfort University

detail.title: What the UAE Can Teach the US About Pharmaceutical Waste

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This paper is based on independent MBA research conducted at De Montfort University. No funding was received from any pharmaceutical, healthcare, or technology organisation in connection with this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a practitioner commentary based on secondary data sources, published regulatory frameworks, and independent desk research. No primary data collection involving human participants was conducted. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently as part of an MBA dissertation at De Montfort University, Dubai campus, self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Pharmaceutical waste represents a significant and structurally underaddressed cost burden across healthcare systems globally, with upstream causes — over-prescribing, inappropriate dispensing quantities, and supply chain inefficiencies — receiving far less policy attention than downstream disposal and remediation. This paper draws on MBA research conducted at De Montfort University examining the feasibility of an AI-driven pharmaceutical waste reduction framework in the UAE healthcare context, and explores its implications for the US healthcare system. The UAE's centralised regulatory architecture, encompassing the Dubai Health Authority, the Department of Health Abu Dhabi, and the federal Ministry of Health and Prevention, combined with a maturing national health data infrastructure including the Riayati unified medical records platform, NABIDH, and Malaffi, provides an unusually tractable environment for developing and testing upstream intervention models. The framework integrates three data streams — prescribing pattern analysis, patient adherence modelling, and inventory management optimisation — into a unified clinical decision support interface. While the UAE and US health systems differ significantly in structure, the analytical logic underpinning the framework is transferable. The US regulatory environment, including NIH SBIR funding programmes and EPA pharmaceutical contamination priorities, provides complementary policy infrastructure to advance what the UAE context has helped establish conceptually.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在阿联酋医疗系统中开发AI驱动的药品浪费减少框架的可行性，并分析了该框架对美国医疗系统的适用性。研究利用阿联酋集中化监管架构和医疗数据基础设施，通过整合处方模式分析、患者依从性建模和库存管理优化三个数据流来减少药品浪费。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的药品浪费减少框架在阿联酋医疗系统中的可行性如何？该框架对美国医疗系统有何借鉴意义？
AI.motivation: 药品浪费是全球医疗系统的重大成本负担，但上游原因（过度处方、不当配药量、供应链低效）相比下游处置和修复得到的政策关注要少得多。阿联酋的集中化监管架构和成熟的国家健康数据基础设施为开发和测试上游干预模型提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗系统分析框架、数据驱动决策支持理论、供应链优化理论，以及跨系统政策转移理论。研究结合了临床决策支持系统、行为经济学和医疗管理理论。
AI.method: 采用MBA研究方法，在De Montfort大学进行的研究，分析阿联酋医疗系统的可行性。研究整合三个数据流：处方模式分析、患者依从性建模和库存管理优化，形成统一的临床决策支持界面。通过比较分析阿联酋和美国医疗系统的结构和政策环境。
AI.findings: 阿联酋的集中化监管架构（迪拜卫生局、阿布扎比卫生部、联邦卫生和预防部）和成熟的国家健康数据基础设施（Riayati统一医疗记录平台、NABIDH、Malaffi）为开发和测试上游干预模型提供了特别有利的环境。虽然阿联酋和美国医疗系统结构差异显著，但支撑该框架的分析逻辑具有可转移性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了跨医疗系统的AI驱动药品浪费减少框架的理论模型；2) 发展了医疗数据整合和临床决策支持的理论框架；3) 贡献了政策转移理论在医疗管理领域的应用；4) 建立了上游干预模型的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为阿联酋医疗系统提供了具体的药品浪费减少实施方案；2) 展示了AI技术在医疗资源优化中的实际应用；3) 为美国医疗系统提供了可借鉴的框架；4) 识别了美国现有的政策基础设施（NIH SBIR资助项目、EPA药品污染优先事项）可以支持该框架的实施；5) 为其他国家的医疗系统提供了减少药品浪费的参考模型。

title: What Gets Funded Depends on How Intent Is Translated: Translation Dynamics in Funding Systems (ERC, Novo Nordisk Foundation, Gates Foundation)

detail.title: What Gets Funded Depends on How Intent Is Translated: Translation Dynamics in Funding Systems (ERC, Novo Nordisk Foundation, Gates Foundation)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available data and did not require ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how institutional intent becomes the basis on which funding decisions are made. It shows that allocation does not operate directly on abstract institutional concepts such as excellence, impact, or innovation, but on the decision-relevant representations into which these concepts are translated within governance artefacts. Using three funding systems—the European Research Council (ERC), the Novo Nordisk Foundation (NNF), and the Gates Foundation—the paper traces how concepts articulated in founding mandates and programme frameworks are transformed into criteria, programme structures, and decision signals that enable evaluation, comparison, and selection. The analysis applies a minimal, rule-based, and replicable method that follows a small set of semantic anchors across publicly available artefacts, selecting the first formulation in each artefact where the concept defines a decision condition. Across the three cases, a consistent pattern is observed: concepts are progressively specified, structured, and operationalised into forms that make proposals comparable and selectable. However, the location and form of this translation differ across funding architectures—occurring through standardised evaluation criteria (ERC), programme-specific criteria (NNF), or the prior definition of problem domains and acceptable solution models (Gates Foundation). The contribution is methodological and empirical. The paper demonstrates that translation dynamics can be made directly observable in ordinary governance artefacts and provides a replicable approach for tracing how institutional intent becomes decision-relevant. By shifting the object of analysis from outcomes to the formation of allocation criteria and signals, the paper makes visible the representations on which funding decisions actually operate. This paper is part of the Coherence Programme on institutional decision systems.

AI.tldr: 论文研究机构意图如何通过治理工具转化为资助决策依据，揭示了资助分配并非直接基于抽象概念，而是基于这些概念在治理工具中被转化成的决策相关表征。
AI.research_question: 机构意图如何成为资助决策的基础？抽象的制度概念（如卓越、影响力、创新）如何通过治理工具转化为决策相关的表征？
AI.motivation: 理解资助分配的实际运作机制，揭示决策过程如何从抽象概念转化为具体可操作的评估标准，填补对机构决策系统内部运作机制的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、决策理论、治理工具理论、概念转化理论、资助分配机制
AI.method: 采用基于规则、可复制的最小化方法，追踪语义锚点在公开治理工具中的转化过程，分析三个资助系统（欧洲研究委员会、诺和诺德基金会、盖茨基金会）的案例
AI.findings: 概念通过治理工具逐步具体化、结构化、可操作化，使提案具有可比性和可选择性；不同资助架构中转化发生的位置和形式不同：ERC通过标准化评估标准，NNF通过项目特定标准，盖茨基金会通过预先定义问题领域和可接受的解决方案模型
AI.theory_contributions: 方法论贡献：展示转化动态可直接在普通治理工具中观察，提供可复制的方法追踪机构意图如何成为决策相关；理论贡献：将分析对象从结果转向分配标准和信号的形成过程，使资助决策实际运作的表征变得可见
AI.practical_contributions: 为资助机构提供透明化决策过程的工具，帮助申请人理解评估标准如何形成，为政策制定者改进资助系统设计提供实证依据

title: Incentive Design in the Nonprofit Sector: Determinants, Discretion, and Organizational Outcomes
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business, University of California, Riverside (UCR) - School of Business Administration and Arizona State University (ASU) - School of Accountancy

detail.title: Incentive Design in the Nonprofit Sector: Determinants, Discretion, and Organizational Outcomes
detail.abstract: We examine how agency problems and performance measurement shape nonprofit executive compensation structure, and how this structure affects organizational outcomes. Analyzing 136,764 organization-year observations of Section 501(c)(3) nonprofits from 2018 to 2023, we distinguish between fixed, discretionary, and formula-based nonfixed bonus compensation, dimensions largely absent from prior research. We find that the likelihood of nonfixed and discretionary bonus compensation increases with external monitoring, compensation design oversight, labor market competition, and performance measurability. Discretionary bonus compensation specifically, not bonus compensation in general, drives future direct donations and program service expenses. Charity Navigator star ratings, however, improve with all forms of bonus compensation. Discretionary and nonfixed bonuses also increase pay-performance sensitivity based on both financial and mission-related performance. Our findings demonstrate that carefully designed bonus compensation, especially discretionary bonuses, can mitigate agency conflicts and enhance organizational performance in mission-driven organizations.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了非营利组织高管薪酬结构如何受代理问题和绩效衡量影响，以及这种结构如何影响组织成果。研究发现，特别是酌情奖金（而非一般奖金）能够增加未来直接捐赠和项目服务支出，所有形式的奖金都能提升慈善导航评级，酌情和非固定奖金还能增强基于财务和使命相关绩效的薪酬-绩效敏感性。
AI.research_question: 代理问题和绩效衡量如何塑造非营利组织高管薪酬结构？这种薪酬结构又如何影响组织成果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对非营利组织高管薪酬结构的关注不足，特别是对固定、酌情和公式化非固定奖金补偿的区分不够。理解这些薪酬维度如何影响非营利组织的代理问题和组织绩效具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、绩效衡量理论、薪酬设计理论，特别关注非营利组织中的代理冲突和激励问题。
AI.method: 使用2018-2023年间136,764个501(c)(3)非营利组织的年度观察数据，区分固定、酌情和公式化非固定奖金补偿，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 非固定和酌情奖金补偿的可能性随外部监督、薪酬设计监督、劳动力市场竞争和绩效可衡量性增加而增加；2. 特别是酌情奖金（而非一般奖金）驱动未来直接捐赠和项目服务支出；3. 所有形式的奖金补偿都能改善慈善导航星级评级；4. 酌情和非固定奖金增加基于财务和使命相关绩效的薪酬-绩效敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了非营利组织薪酬结构理论，特别关注酌情和公式化奖金维度；2. 深化了代理理论在使命驱动组织中的应用；3. 提供了绩效衡量与薪酬设计相互作用的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非营利组织董事会设计有效薪酬结构提供指导；2. 帮助监管机构理解不同奖金类型对组织绩效的影响；3. 为捐赠者评估非营利组织治理质量提供参考；4. 为政策制定者优化非营利部门监管提供实证依据。

title: From Risk Registers to Control Systems: The Inverse Risk Register and Objective-First ERM

detail.title: From Risk Registers to Control Systems: The Inverse Risk Register and Objective-First ERM
detail.abstract: Risk registers remain the dominant operational instrument of enterprise risk management (ERM), yet persistent evidence suggests they fail to influence strategic decision-making or real-time organizational response. This paper argues that the limitation is structural rather than procedural: traditional risk registers organize information around risk events rather than organizational objectives, creating an open-loop system in environments that require continuous, signal-driven adaptation. Drawing on ERM frameworks (COSO, ISO 31000), objective-centric management literature (OKRs), and closed-loop control systems theory, this paper introduces the Inverse Risk Register (IRR)-a novel objective-first framework that redefines risk as a derivative of performance variance relative to strategic intent. The IRR repositions the objective as the primary index of risk information and structures risk management as a continuous feedback loop consisting of performance metrics, variance signals, causal drivers, and conditional response levers. The framework is operationalized through a five-step methodology and a formal mapping to closed-loop control system architecture, demonstrating how existing monitoring infrastructure can be repurposed for real-time risk detection and response. The IRR is proposed not as a replacement for existing frameworks, but as an operational mechanism to realize their longstanding objective-integration mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出逆向风险登记册（IRR），这是一种以目标为中心的风险管理框架，将风险重新定义为相对于战略意图的绩效偏差，通过闭环控制系统实现实时风险检测和响应。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种风险管理系统，能够有效影响战略决策和实时组织响应，克服传统风险登记册的结构性局限？
AI.motivation: 传统风险登记册围绕风险事件而非组织目标组织信息，在需要持续、信号驱动适应的环境中形成开环系统，无法有效影响战略决策或实时响应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了企业风险管理框架（COSO、ISO 31000）、以目标为中心的管理文献（OKRs）和闭环控制系统理论。
AI.method: 提出逆向风险登记册（IRR）框架，包含五步方法论，并将其正式映射到闭环控制系统架构，展示如何重新利用现有监控基础设施。
AI.findings: IRR框架将目标作为风险信息的主要索引，将风险管理构建为包含绩效指标、偏差信号、因果驱动因素和条件响应杠杆的连续反馈循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 将风险重新定义为相对于战略意图的绩效偏差的衍生概念，提出结构性而非程序性的风险管理创新，整合了目标管理和控制系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的五步方法论，展示如何利用现有监控基础设施实现实时风险检测和响应，作为实现现有框架集成目标的运行机制而非替代方案。

title: Operationalizing The Brown Theory of Experiential Intelligence™ in Institutional and Community Systems
affiliations: and The Brown School of Experiential Leadership™

detail.title: Operationalizing The Brown Theory of Experiential Intelligence™ in Institutional and Community Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The Brown Theory of Experiential Intelligence™ (Brown, 2026) established that intelligence can be developed through lived experience as a structured, interpretable, and measurable process-producing not only knowledge but architectural thinking, leadership systems, and generational impact. This paper advances that foundational contribution into the domain of institutional application. Co-authored by the theory's originator, Donna M. Brown, and institutional development specialist Jonique P. Williams, this study examines how experiential intelligence can be operationalized within nonprofit organizations, higher education systems, and community-based environments. Drawing on the four proprietary models introduced in Brown (2026)-the KE Learning Model™, the Brown Experiential Architecture Model of Learning™, the Brown Experiential Intelligence Pyramid™, and the Experiential Framework Builder Model™-this paper introduces an applied implementation framework that translates theory into curriculum development, leadership pipelines, organizational infrastructure, and institutional policy. Case application is drawn from the Brown School of Experiential Leadership™. The paper further identifies funding mechanisms, partnership strategies, and a multi-phase institutional engagement model designed to support adoption at scale. Findings suggest that when experiential intelligence is formally recognized and systematically developed within institutional contexts, the result is more inclusive leadership, stronger community responsiveness, and sustainable systems change.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Brown体验智能理论，探讨如何在非营利组织、高等教育系统和社区环境中实施体验智能，提出了应用实施框架，将理论转化为课程开发、领导力管道、组织基础设施和机构政策。
AI.research_question: 体验智能如何在机构环境中（包括非营利组织、高等教育系统和社区环境）被操作化和实施？
AI.motivation: Brown体验智能理论已确立智能可以通过生活经验发展，但该理论在机构应用领域尚未充分探索。本文旨在将该理论从基础贡献推进到机构应用领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: Brown体验智能理论（Brown, 2026）及其四个专有模型：KE学习模型™、Brown体验学习架构模型™、Brown体验智能金字塔™和体验框架构建模型™。
AI.method: 基于Brown体验领导力学院的案例应用，引入应用实施框架，将理论转化为课程开发、领导力管道、组织基础设施和机构政策，并识别资助机制、合作伙伴策略和多阶段机构参与模型。
AI.findings: 当体验智能在机构环境中得到正式认可和系统发展时，会产生更包容的领导力、更强的社区响应能力和可持续的系统变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Brown体验智能理论从理论层面扩展到机构应用领域，建立了理论与实践之间的桥梁，丰富了该理论在组织发展中的应用维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的实施框架、资助机制、合作伙伴策略和多阶段机构参与模型，帮助非营利组织、高等教育系统和社区环境系统性地发展体验智能，促进包容性领导力和可持续变革。

title: A Regime Switching Approach for Mortality Modeling in Presence of Climate Change and Pandemic Effects
affiliations: Western University, Canada, Oregon State University and Western University

detail.title: A Regime Switching Approach for Mortality Modeling in Presence of Climate Change and Pandemic Effects
detail.abstract: Understanding and forecasting mortality trends is critical, especially in the face of extreme events such as pandemics and the growing influence of climate change. While the former introduces abrupt and transitory shocks to mortality, the latter imposes gradual but potentially persistent effects, particularly at older ages. In this study, we extend the classical Lee-Carter model by incorporating a climate-sensitive component that modulates the period effect, allowing the model to better capture temperature-related mortality fluctuations. To enhance the forecasting feature, we depart from the standard multivariate random walk with drift commonly used for forecasting the Lee-Carter time index. Instead, we adopt a regime-switching framework that accounts for structural changes in mortality trends, including recovery dynamics after periods of higher mortality. We apply our proposed model to U.S. mortality data and compare its in-sample and out-of-sample performance against several competing models from the literature. Our results show that the extended model not only offers a more realistic representation of age-specific mortality during climate extremes and mortality shocks, but also delivers improved forecasting accuracy in terms of multiple evaluation metrics. The framework thus provides a valuable tool for policy planning in the context of ongoing demographic and environmental change.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了经典的Lee-Carter死亡率模型，通过加入气候敏感组件来捕捉温度相关的死亡率波动，并采用制度转换框架来考虑死亡率趋势的结构性变化，提高了在极端气候和死亡率冲击下的预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何改进传统的Lee-Carter死亡率模型，使其能够更好地捕捉气候变化的渐进影响和疫情等极端事件的突发冲击，从而提高死亡率预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 在面临疫情等突发冲击和气候变化长期影响的背景下，传统的死亡率预测模型难以同时捕捉这两种不同类型的死亡率变化模式，需要开发更灵活的建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lee-Carter死亡率模型，引入气候敏感组件来调节时期效应，并采用制度转换框架替代传统的多元随机游走漂移预测方法。
AI.method: 将扩展的Lee-Carter模型应用于美国死亡率数据，通过样本内和样本外性能评估，与文献中的多个竞争模型进行比较。
AI.findings: 扩展模型不仅能在气候极端事件和死亡率冲击期间更真实地反映年龄特异性死亡率，还在多个评估指标上表现出更好的预测准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）将气候因素整合到经典的死亡率模型中；2）引入制度转换框架来捕捉死亡率趋势的结构性变化；3）提供了同时处理突发冲击和渐进影响的建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为政策规划提供了有价值的工具，特别是在持续的人口和环境变化背景下，能够更好地支持公共卫生、社会保障和风险管理决策。

title: The Pied Piper of Crypto: Influencer Finance, Regulatory Failure, and the Risks of Youth-Oriented Digital Assets
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Pied Piper of Crypto: Influencer Finance, Regulatory Failure, and the Risks of Youth-Oriented Digital Assets
detail.abstract: The integration of cryptocurrency into youth-oriented financial platforms presents a significant and underexamined risk within modern financial systems. This paper analyzes the convergence of influencer culture, financial technology innovation, and regulatory fragmentation through the case of Beast Industries' acquisition of Step, a mobile banking application designed for minors. Drawing on regulatory enforcement actions, agency reports, and evidence from the 2024 collapse of Synapse Financial Technologies, the paper argues that existing oversight mechanisms are structurally inadequate to protect minors from speculative financial exposure. Specifically, the combination of parasocial influence, gamified financial interfaces, and fragmented jurisdiction across regulatory bodies creates a pathway through which high-risk financial products can be normalized and distributed to underage users with limited scrutiny. The analysis demonstrates that current frameworks, which rely heavily on disclosure and post hoc enforcement, fail to address the unique risks posed by influencer-mediated financial promotion. The paper concludes by proposing targeted regulatory reforms, including restrictions on the marketing of high-risk assets to minors and enhanced accountability within fintech-bank partnership models.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了加密货币通过影响者文化和金融科技平台向未成年人传播的风险，以Beast Industries收购青少年银行应用Step为案例，揭示了当前监管框架在保护未成年人免受高风险金融产品影响方面的结构性不足。
AI.research_question: 现有监管机制如何有效保护未成年人免受通过影响者文化和金融科技平台传播的高风险加密货币产品的风险？
AI.motivation: 加密货币与青少年金融平台的结合在现代金融体系中构成了重大但研究不足的风险，特别是通过影响者文化、金融科技创新和监管碎片化的结合，可能使高风险金融产品在未成年人中正常化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管理论、金融科技风险框架、影响者营销理论、未成年人保护理论、金融监管碎片化理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（Beast Industries收购Step应用）、监管执法行动分析、机构报告分析、2024年Synapse Financial Technologies倒闭事件证据分析
AI.findings: 当前监管框架在结构上不足以保护未成年人免受投机性金融风险；准社会影响、游戏化金融界面和跨监管机构的碎片化管辖权相结合，为高风险金融产品向未成年用户正常化和分发创造了途径；依赖披露和事后执法的现有机制无法有效应对影响者介导的金融推广带来的独特风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了影响者文化、金融科技创新和监管碎片化三者结合的风险理论框架；发展了未成年人金融保护的新理论视角；为金融科技监管理论提供了实证案例支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出针对性监管改革建议：限制向未成年人营销高风险资产；加强金融科技-银行合作模式中的问责制；改进监管协调机制以应对跨机构管辖权碎片化问题。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Monetary Policy: A Framework and Perspective on Cyclical Transmission, Structural Transition, and Financial Stability

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Monetary Policy: A Framework and Perspective on Cyclical Transmission, Structural Transition, and Financial Stability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No relationship
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply
declarations.funderStatement: No institution or person has funded this piece

detail.abstract: I develop a framework analyzing how artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes monetary policy through three interrelated channels: cyclical transmission, structural transition, and financial stability. In the short run, AI can alter inflation dynamics by changing how supply and demand disturbances map into prices-through shifts in production technologies, pricing behavior, cost pass-through, and expectations-even when conventional measures of economic slack are unchanged. Over longer horizons, AI may shift the natural benchmarks around which policy is calibrated, including potential output and the natural rate of interest. For financial stability, AI may improve credit allocation and risk assessment, but can also heighten systemic vulnerabilities through inflated expectation-driven asset valuations and model monocultures. A particular risk arises at the intersection of these channels: if AI initially depresses realized efficiency through adoption frictions while simultaneously fueling elevated asset valuations, the economy may face cost-push inflation and financial fragility at once-an AI-specific stagflation risk that the interest rate instrument alone is ill-suited to address. I argue that AI does not call for a redefinition of central banks' objectives, but it does require a recalibration of existing frameworks: its diffusion blurs the distinction between cyclical fluctuations and structural shifts, raising the value of cost-side diagnostics and robust policy strategies over exclusive reliance on reduced-form inflation-gap relationships.

AI.tldr: AI通过三个相互关联的渠道重塑货币政策：周期性传导、结构性转型和金融稳定。短期AI改变通胀动态，长期改变政策校准基准，金融稳定方面既有改善信贷分配的好处，也有加剧系统性风险的可能。AI不要求重新定义央行目标，但需要重新校准现有框架。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过周期性传导、结构性转型和金融稳定这三个相互关联的渠道重塑货币政策？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，其对经济体系和货币政策的影响日益显著，需要系统分析AI如何改变通胀动态、政策校准基准和金融稳定，为货币政策制定提供新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI通过三个渠道影响货币政策的框架：1)周期性传导渠道（短期通胀动态变化）；2)结构性转型渠道（长期政策基准变化）；3)金融稳定渠道（信贷分配改善与系统性风险）。
AI.method: 理论框架分析，通过构建概念性框架分析AI对货币政策三个渠道的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1)短期AI改变通胀动态，即使传统经济闲置指标不变；2)长期AI改变潜在产出和自然利率等政策基准；3)金融稳定方面AI既改善信贷分配又加剧系统性风险；4)AI特有的滞胀风险：初期效率下降与资产估值上升并存。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI重塑货币政策的三渠道分析框架，识别了AI特有的滞胀风险，指出AI模糊了周期性波动与结构性转变的界限，强调成本侧诊断的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定者提供应对AI影响的实用框架，建议重新校准现有政策框架而非重新定义目标，强调需要超越简化的通胀缺口关系，采用更稳健的政策策略。

title: Competitive Hardening Dynamics in Viscoplastic Materials with Evolving Threshold Stress
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Competitive Hardening Dynamics in Viscoplastic Materials with Evolving Threshold Stress
detail.abstract: Conventional viscoplasticity frameworks treat the threshold stress as either a material constant or a quantity evolving solely with accumulated plastic strain. Since microstructural evolution — whether precipitation, phase transformation, or solute redistribution—may proceed concurrently with deformation, such a treatment is often inadequate. The present work formulates a constitutive framework, derived from the Clausius–Duhem inequality and Perzyna-type overstress viscoplasticity, in which the threshold stress evolves autonomously with physical time through microstructural kinetics, independently of accumulated strain. Modified Armstrong–Frederick kinematic hardening with static recovery is incorporated, so that back stress develops only during active inelastic flow. The interaction between timedriven threshold evolution and strain-driven back-stress development gives rise to three behavioural regimes: (I) a purely elastic response, (II) flow arrest, in which inelastic flow initiates but subsequently ceases as the threshold overtakes the effective stress, and (III) continuous flow. A constructive Lyapunov function is employed to prove that flow arrest is asymptotically stable, a result not previously established at the material-point level in the viscoplastic creep literature. It is further shown that back-stress development reduces the time to arrest through a kinematic hardening acceleration effect. A physics-informed neural network employing smooth Macaulay bracket approximation with curriculum learning resolves all three regimes within a single trained surrogate. The framework is validated against experimental data using the creep-ageing and back-stress test (CABT), which provides independent measurements of inelastic strain and back-stress evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的粘塑性本构框架，其中阈值应力通过微观结构动力学随时间自主演化，与累积应变无关。该框架结合了修正的Armstrong-Frederick运动硬化，揭示了三种行为机制：纯弹性响应、流动停止和连续流动。通过Lyapunov函数证明了流动停止的渐近稳定性，并开发了基于物理信息的神经网络代理模型。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个粘塑性本构框架，使阈值应力能够通过微观结构动力学随时间自主演化，独立于累积应变，并描述由此产生的材料行为机制？
AI.motivation: 传统的粘塑性框架将阈值应力视为材料常数或仅随累积塑性应变演化的量，但微观结构演化（如沉淀、相变或溶质再分布）可能与变形同时发生，这种处理方式往往不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Clausius-Duhem不等式和Perzyna型过应力粘塑性理论；2. 修正的Armstrong-Frederick运动硬化理论（含静态恢复）；3. Lyapunov稳定性理论；4. 物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架。
AI.method: 1. 建立基于热力学一致性的本构框架；2. 理论分析三种行为机制；3. 使用Lyapunov函数证明流动停止的渐近稳定性；4. 开发基于物理信息的神经网络代理模型（采用平滑Macaulay括号近似和课程学习）；5. 通过蠕变时效和背应力测试（CABT）实验数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出三种行为机制：纯弹性响应、流动停止和连续流动；2. 证明了流动停止在材料点水平上是渐近稳定的；3. 发现背应力发展通过运动硬化加速效应减少了停止时间；4. 开发的PINN代理模型能够准确捕捉所有三种机制；5. 框架与CABT实验数据吻合良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了阈值应力随时间自主演化的新本构框架；2. 首次在粘塑性蠕变文献中证明了流动停止在材料点水平的渐近稳定性；3. 揭示了时间驱动阈值演化与应变驱动背应力发展之间的相互作用机制；4. 建立了运动硬化加速效应的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了更准确的微观结构演化与变形耦合的建模工具；2. 开发的PINN代理模型能够高效预测复杂材料行为；3. 框架可用于优化材料加工工艺（如蠕变时效成形）；4. CABT测试方法为材料表征提供了新手段。

title: Free-Energy–Driven Quantum-Enhanced Pneumonia Triage from Chest X-Ray Images
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Alfaisal University and National College Of Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: Free-Energy–Driven Quantum-Enhanced Pneumonia Triage from Chest X-Ray Images
detail.abstract: Reliable medical AI requires not only accurate classification, but also decision mechanisms that explicitly account for uncertainty when determining whether predictions should be accepted or deferred. Although deep learning methods have shown strong performance in chest X-ray analysis, many remain detection-centered and rely on confidence estimates that are not directly optimized for selective clinical decision-making. This paper proposes a decision-centric framework for pneumonia triage that combines compact latent representation learning, hybrid quantum-enhanced feature transformation, uncertainty-aware inference, and free-energy–based decision modeling. A convolutional encoder first maps chest X-ray images into a low-dimensional latent space, after which a quantum variational module enriches latent correlations through structured nonlinear transformation. Monte Carlo dropout is then used to estimate predictive uncertainty, and a free-energy criterion is introduced to govern triage by jointly incorporating predictive loss and uncertainty rather than relying on entropy alone.Experiments on a benchmark pneumonia chest X-ray dataset show that the latent–quantum hybrid model improves overall discrimination relative to the baseline, achieving higher test accuracy, F1-score, and AUC, while also producing a more structured latent-space organization. More importantly, the proposed free-energy decision rule yields more reliable selective prediction behavior than entropy-based triage at identical coverage. For the baseline model, free-energy triage reduces covered-case risk and improves accepted-case accuracy relative to entropy. For the latent–quantum hybrid model, free-energy triage further strengthens decision reliability and achieves perfect accuracy on the accepted subset at the same coverage level in the reported experimental setting. Latent-space visualization and case-based uncertainty analysis further show that the hybrid transformation reshapes the geometry of the representation and improves the separation of ambiguous from confident cases.These results demonstrate that the main contribution of the proposed framework lies not only in predictive modeling, but in its ability to support principled and clinically meaningful decision-making under uncertainty. By integratingPreprint submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine April 13, 2026latent representation learning, hybrid quantum processing, uncertainty estimation, and free-energy–based triage within a unified formulation, the proposed approach advances pneumonia analysis from detection-focused classification toward reliable and defer-capable medical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于肺炎分诊的决策中心框架，结合了紧凑潜在表示学习、混合量子增强特征变换、不确定性感知推理和基于自由能的决策建模。该框架不仅提高了预测性能，更重要的是通过自由能决策规则实现了更可靠的选择性预测行为，支持在不确定性下的临床决策。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够支持在不确定性下进行原则性临床决策的医学AI框架，特别是针对肺炎胸片分析的分诊任务？
AI.motivation: 可靠的医学AI不仅需要准确的分类，还需要决策机制能够明确考虑不确定性，以决定预测是否应该被接受或推迟。尽管深度学习方法在胸片分析中表现出色，但许多方法仍以检测为中心，依赖未直接针对选择性临床决策优化的置信度估计。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 潜在表示学习理论：通过卷积编码器将胸片图像映射到低维潜在空间
2. 量子计算理论：量子变分模块通过结构化非线性变换丰富潜在相关性
3. 不确定性估计理论：蒙特卡洛dropout用于估计预测不确定性
4. 决策理论：基于自由能的决策标准，联合考虑预测损失和不确定性，而非仅依赖熵
AI.method:
1. 卷积编码器将胸片图像映射到低维潜在空间
2. 量子变分模块对潜在特征进行增强变换
3. 蒙特卡洛dropout估计预测不确定性
4. 引入自由能标准进行分诊决策，综合考虑预测损失和不确定性
5. 在基准肺炎胸片数据集上进行实验评估
AI.findings:
1. 潜在-量子混合模型相比基线提高了整体判别能力，获得更高的测试准确率、F1分数和AUC
2. 模型产生了更结构化的潜在空间组织
3. 自由能决策规则在相同覆盖率下比基于熵的分诊产生更可靠的选择性预测行为
4. 对于基线模型，自由能分诊降低了覆盖病例风险，提高了接受病例的准确率
5. 对于潜在-量子混合模型，自由能分诊进一步增强了决策可靠性，在相同覆盖率下实现了接受子集的完美准确率
6. 潜在空间可视化和基于病例的不确定性分析显示，混合变换重塑了表示几何，改善了模糊病例与置信病例的分离
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个统一的决策中心框架，将潜在表示学习、混合量子处理、不确定性估计和基于自由能的分诊整合在一起
2. 引入了基于自由能的决策标准，联合考虑预测损失和不确定性，而非仅依赖熵
3. 展示了量子增强特征变换如何改善潜在空间结构和不确定性分离
4. 将肺炎分析从以检测为中心的分类推进到可靠且可延迟的医学决策支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了一个实际可用的肺炎分诊系统，支持临床决策
2. 提供了更可靠的选择性预测机制，帮助医生决定何时接受AI预测，何时需要人工审查
3. 通过潜在空间可视化工具，增强了模型的可解释性
4. 为医学AI系统提供了不确定性感知决策的实践框架，可推广到其他医学影像分析任务

title: MammoInsight: A Unified Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Mammography Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: MammoInsight: A Unified Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Mammography Analysis
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: Mammography interpretation requires simultaneous assessment of multiple clinical attributes such as cancer status, breast density, BI-RADS score, abnormality type, and molecular subtype. The MammoBench2 and MammoInsighty address these tasks in isolation, limiting clinical utility and generalizability.Methods: We present MammoInsight, a unified multi-task deep learning framework built on the MedImageInsight foundation model backbone, incorporating SAM-Med2D-guided region-of-interest pooling, cross-view attention fusion across both standard mammography views, weighted ordinal regression for ordered clinical labels, DHN-NCE contrastive regularisation, and homoscedastic uncertainty weighting for automatic task balancing. MammoInsight is trained and evaluated on ~65K images collated from nine geographically diverse resources, and compared against four large-scale foundation model baselines, viz., MedImageInsight, BiomedCLIP, MedGemma-4B, and MedGemma-27B, under a unified linear probing protocol. We also propose MammoBench2, a curated multi-task mammography dataset comprising 16,010 images with harmonised annotations for five clinical tasks and lesion segmentation, providing a robust benchmark for training AI models.Results: MammoInsight achieves state-of-the-art performance on cancer status prediction (Accuracy=0.800, weighted F1=0.787), breast density classification (Accuracy=0.767, weighted F1=0.765), BI-RADS scoring (Accuracy=0.661, weighted F1=0.646, the only model exceeding 0.6 on this six-class task), and lesion segmentation (DSC=0.804, IoU=0.786), a significant improvement over a fine-tuned single-task baseline using an architecturally identical decoder, while achieving a comparable accuracy (0.752) and weighted F1 (0.757) on abnormality classification.Conclusions: A unified multi-task framework trained with ordinal regression and joint segmentation supervision achieves comparable or superior performance across all five mammography clinical tasks compared to foundation models that are ~74 larger in parameter count, while simultaneously localising lesions with state-of-the-art accuracy. MammoBench2 and MammoInsight together provide the first open benchmark and unified framework for comprehensive multi-task mammography AI evaluation.​

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MammoInsight，一个基于MedImageInsight基础模型的多任务深度学习框架，用于同时处理乳腺X线摄影的多个临床任务（癌症状态、乳腺密度、BI-RADS评分、异常类型和分子亚型），并提出了MammoBench2数据集作为基准测试。该框架在多个任务上实现了最先进的性能，同时使用更少的参数。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个统一的多任务深度学习框架，能够同时准确处理乳腺X线摄影的多个临床属性评估任务，并超越现有基础模型的性能？
AI.motivation: 现有的乳腺X线摄影AI系统（如MammoBench2和MammoInsighty）通常孤立地处理各个临床任务，限制了临床实用性和泛化能力。临床实践中需要同时评估多个属性，因此需要开发一个统一的多任务框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于MedImageInsight基础模型，结合SAM-Med2D引导的感兴趣区域池化、跨视图注意力融合、加权序数回归（用于有序临床标签）、DHN-NCE对比正则化和同方差不确定性加权（用于自动任务平衡）。
AI.method: 1. 构建MammoInsight统一多任务深度学习框架；2. 使用SAM-Med2D引导的ROI池化；3. 跨标准乳腺X线摄影视图的跨视图注意力融合；4. 加权序数回归处理有序标签；5. DHN-NCE对比正则化；6. 同方差不确定性加权实现自动任务平衡；7. 在9个地理多样性资源收集的约65K图像上训练和评估；8. 与4个大规模基础模型（MedImageInsight、BiomedCLIP、MedGemma-4B、MedGemma-27B）进行统一线性探测协议比较；9. 提出MammoBench2数据集（16,010张图像，包含5个临床任务和病灶分割的协调标注）。
AI.findings: MammoInsight在多个任务上实现了最先进的性能：癌症状态预测（准确率0.800，加权F1 0.787）、乳腺密度分类（准确率0.767，加权F1 0.765）、BI-RADS评分（准确率0.661，加权F1 0.646，是唯一在六分类任务上超过0.6的模型）、病灶分割（DSC 0.804，IoU 0.786）。相比参数数量约74倍大的基础模型，该框架在所有五个乳腺X线摄影临床任务上实现了相当或更优的性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了首个统一的多任务乳腺X线摄影AI框架；2. 开发了结合序数回归和联合分割监督的训练方法；3. 证明了多任务学习在医学影像分析中的有效性；4. 提供了自动任务平衡的解决方案；5. 展示了小参数模型可以超越大规模基础模型的性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. MammoInsight框架可用于临床实践中的多属性乳腺X线摄影评估；2. MammoBench2数据集为AI模型训练提供了标准化基准；3. 该框架能够同时定位病灶并评估多个临床属性，提高诊断效率；4. 为乳腺X线摄影AI研究提供了开源基准和统一框架；5. 减少了计算资源需求，使部署更加可行。

title: Central Bank Communication and CBDC Implementation
affiliations: University of Oxford - Department of Economics

detail.title: Central Bank Communication and CBDC Implementation
detail.abstract: CBDC issuance remains rare even though central banks discuss it extensively. Using 37,814 speeches from 134 jurisdictions and a scored 2015-2025 sample of 15,906 speeches from 122 jurisdictions, the analysis builds country-year measures of CBDC commitment, technology salience, and stated constraints. Public commitment tracks agenda participation but adds little information about subsequent advancement beyond research once prior project stage is controlled for. More open capital accounts and, less consistently, greater central bank independence are negatively associated with advancement beyond research. Legal-regulatory concerns are the most consistently negative speech-based correlate.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了央行数字货币（CBDC）发行的决定因素，发现公开承诺主要反映议程参与度，但对研究阶段后的实际推进预测能力有限。资本账户开放度和央行独立性较高与CBDC推进呈负相关，法律监管担忧是最一致的负面预测因素。
AI.research_question: 什么因素影响央行数字货币（CBDC）从研究阶段向实际推进阶段的过渡？公开承诺、制度特征和演讲中提到的约束如何预测CBDC的实际进展？
AI.motivation: 尽管各国央行广泛讨论CBDC，但实际发行仍然罕见。需要理解为什么有些国家在CBDC研究后继续推进，而其他国家则停滞不前，以及公开承诺是否真正反映实际进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学和央行行为理论，考察央行独立性、资本账户开放度等制度特征对CBDC推进的影响。同时分析公开承诺与实际行动之间的差距。
AI.method: 使用37,814篇来自134个司法管辖区的央行演讲，以及2015-2025年期间15,906篇来自122个司法管辖区的评分样本，构建国家年度层面的CBDC承诺度、技术关注度和约束陈述指标。
AI.findings: 1. 公开承诺主要反映议程参与度，但在控制前期项目阶段后，对研究阶段后的实际推进预测能力有限；2. 资本账户开放度较高与CBDC推进呈负相关；3. 央行独立性（一致性较弱）与CBDC推进呈负相关；4. 法律监管担忧是演讲中最一致的负面预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了CBDC公开承诺与实际进展之间的差距；2. 识别了影响CBDC推进的制度障碍因素；3. 提供了央行数字货币采纳决策的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了CBDC推进的现实预测指标；2. 强调了法律监管框架在CBDC实施中的关键作用；3. 帮助央行评估CBDC项目的可行性。

title: The Effects of Early Center-based Childcare on Non-cognitive Skills: Evidence from the UKHLS

detail.title: The Effects of Early Center-based Childcare on Non-cognitive Skills: Evidence from the UKHLS
detail.abstract: Early childhood non-cognitive development is known to enhance children's educational achievements and adult-life outcomes. Drawing on a longitudinal sample of children from the UK Household Longitudinal Study (UKHLS), this paper provides new evidence on the short-run effects of early centre-based childcare attendance-measured between ages one and two-on children's adaptive behaviour and socio-emotional skills at age three. Our selection-on-observables strategy exploits a rich set of child and maternal background characteristics, as well as temporal and geographical variation in the availability of early centre-based childcare providers. To reduce potential bias, we combine Entropy Balancing and Inverse Probability Weighting with linear parametric analysis. Results indicate that early centre-based childcare attendance has strong and positive effect on children's adaptive behavioural scale and socio-emotional development. Effects are particularly pronounced among children of low-educated mothers.

AI.tldr: 本文使用英国纵向家庭研究数据，发现1-2岁参加托儿中心对3岁儿童的适应行为和社会情感技能有显著正向影响，特别是对低教育程度母亲的子女效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 早期托儿中心参与（1-2岁）对3岁儿童适应行为和社会情感技能发展的短期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 早期非认知能力发展对儿童教育成就和成年生活结果有重要影响，但关于早期托儿中心参与对儿童发展的短期效应缺乏充分证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童发展理论，特别是早期干预对非认知能力发展的影响；选择偏差理论，使用观测变量选择策略。
AI.method: 使用英国纵向家庭研究（UKHLS）数据，结合熵平衡和逆概率加权与线性参数分析，利用儿童和母亲背景特征以及托儿中心时空可用性变化来减少选择偏差。
AI.findings: 早期托儿中心参与对儿童的适应行为量表和社会情感发展有强烈正向影响，对低教育程度母亲的子女影响尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为早期托儿中心参与对儿童非认知能力发展的短期效应提供了新证据，验证了早期干预的重要性，特别是对弱势群体的效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了支持早期托儿中心扩展的证据，特别是针对低教育程度家庭儿童的针对性支持政策。

title: Cross-Country Comparison of Macroeconomic Indicators of the Labor Market
affiliations: MGIMO University of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation

detail.title: Cross-Country Comparison of Macroeconomic Indicators of the Labor Market
detail.abstract: The global pandemic triggered a global economic recession, resulting in high unemployment and labor market imbalances, which were reflected in changes in macroeconomic indicators in the US, Japan, and Russia. While the timing and scale of job losses and post-pandemic recovery varied significantly across these economies, they also shared some common characteristics. The aim of the work is to analyze macroeconomic indicators of the labor market in the USA, Japan and Russia using the Beveridge curve, which shows changes in unemployment and vacancies during the phases of the economic cycle and the impossibility of a simultaneous reduction in the number of vacancies and job seekers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用贝弗里奇曲线分析美国、日本和俄罗斯在疫情期间劳动力市场的宏观经济指标，探讨失业与职位空缺的动态关系及经济周期影响。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情如何影响美国、日本和俄罗斯劳动力市场的宏观经济指标？这些经济体在失业与职位空缺关系上表现出哪些异同？
AI.motivation: 全球疫情引发经济衰退，导致高失业率和劳动力市场失衡，不同经济体在就业损失和复苏方面存在显著差异，需要系统分析比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝弗里奇曲线理论，该曲线描述了失业率与职位空缺率之间的负相关关系，反映了劳动力市场的匹配效率和结构性变化。
AI.method: 使用贝弗里奇曲线分析方法，比较美国、日本和俄罗斯的宏观经济指标，考察失业与职位空缺在疫情不同阶段的变化模式。
AI.findings: 三国在失业损失时间和规模上差异显著，但在失业与职位空缺关系上存在共同特征；贝弗里奇曲线揭示了劳动力市场失衡的动态变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了贝弗里奇曲线在不同经济体和危机情境下的应用，深化了对劳动力市场动态调整机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供跨国比较视角，帮助识别劳动力市场失衡的共性和特性，为制定针对性就业政策提供依据。
