declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: This paper attempts to analyze the engagement of faculty members in a higher educational institution. An education system considering quality and competent faculty undoubtedly enhances the overall success of an institution. Therefore, the study investigates the impact of factors of the Utrecht Work Engagement Scale (UWES) on faculty engagement by using an adapted scale in Rajasthan, an Indian context. The aim of this research is to discover a descriptive explanation related to vigor, dedication, and absorption and engagement of faculty members. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) was used to evaluate the structural validity of the instruments, and internal consistency was also examined. For this study, the data collected required was secondary data, which was collected from journals and magazines, while primary data was collected from faculty members of Public Universities and Private Universities). However, this study confirms that UWES is valid in Rajasthan's Indian context and is supported by a theoretical framework and discussions. Therefore, Public and Private Universities may take the necessary steps to improve overall engagement among the faculty members.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用乌特勒支工作投入量表(UWES)分析印度拉贾斯坦邦高等教育机构教师的敬业度，验证了UWES在该文化背景下的有效性，并探讨活力、奉献、专注三个维度对教师敬业度的影响。
AI.research_question: UWES量表中的活力、奉献、专注三个因素如何影响印度拉贾斯坦邦高等教育机构教师的敬业度？UWES量表在该文化背景下是否有效？
AI.motivation: 拥有高质量和称职的教师队伍对教育机构的整体成功至关重要，因此需要了解影响教师敬业度的因素，特别是在印度拉贾斯坦邦的特定文化背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乌特勒支工作投入量表(UWES)理论框架，包含活力、奉献、专注三个核心维度。
AI.method: 采用验证性因子分析(CFA)评估工具的结构效度，并检验内部一致性。数据收集包括二手数据（期刊杂志）和一手数据（公立和私立大学教师）。
AI.findings: 研究证实UWES量表在印度拉贾斯坦邦背景下是有效的，活力、奉献、专注三个维度对教师敬业度有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了UWES量表在印度文化背景下的适用性和有效性，扩展了该理论框架在高等教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公立和私立大学提供了改善教师敬业度的具体方向，建议学校采取必要措施提升教师在活力、奉献、专注三个维度的表现。

title: Information Structure and Motivated Beliefs
affiliations: DoorDash Inc

detail.title: Information Structure and Motivated Beliefs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of Brown University. All participants provided informed consent electronically prior to participation.
declarations.funderStatement: Orlando Bravo Center for Economic Research

detail.abstract: This paper studies the emergence of motivated beliefs in response to different information structures. I employ a simple urn-draw framework for belief elicitation, randomizing whether past ball draws provide information about future utility-relevant draws. In an additional treatment arm, I increase the payoff per rewarded ball to explore the effect of stake size on belief distortions. The study finds no evidence of motivated beliefs: Participants' beliefs are, on average, the same across the treatment and control groups. Nor do the distributions of participants' beliefs differ between control and treatment. These results hold both conditional and unconditional on the ball color in the first round. Finally, a higher payoff of a future ball draw does not induce belief distortions, either.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过随机化信息结构来检验动机性信念的形成，发现参与者信念在不同信息结构和高回报条件下均无显著差异，不支持动机性信念的存在。
AI.research_question: 不同信息结构是否会导致动机性信念的形成？高回报是否会影响信念扭曲？
AI.motivation: 动机性信念理论认为人们会形成符合自身利益的信念，但这一现象在不同信息结构下的实证证据有限，需要检验其普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动机性信念理论、信息结构对信念形成的影响、期望效用理论
AI.method: 采用简单的抽球框架进行信念诱导，随机化过去抽球是否提供未来效用相关信息；增加高回报处理组检验回报大小对信念扭曲的影响
AI.findings: 未发现动机性信念的证据：参与者的信念在处理组和对照组之间平均相同；信念分布也无差异；这些结果在第一轮球颜色的条件下和条件下均成立；更高的未来抽球回报也未诱导信念扭曲
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了动机性信念理论的普遍性，表明在某些信息结构下动机性信念可能不会出现；为信念形成理论提供了边界条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供参考：在某些情境下，信息结构的变化可能不会导致系统性信念扭曲；对激励机制设计有启示意义

title: Tariff by US: A Study on mitigation of Tariff Risk in E-Commerce in Indian Economy
affiliations: Shri Venkateshwara University, Shri Venkateshwara University, Shri Venkateshwara University and Shri Venkateshwara University

detail.title: Tariff by US: A Study on mitigation of Tariff Risk in E-Commerce in Indian Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: In today's volatile trade environment, global tariff risk mitigation is a critical priority for businesses engaged in international commerce. Recent developments, such as the United States imposing a 10% universal tariff on imports and imposing higher rates on major trading partners, have introduced significant market uncertainty and supply chain disruptions. Companies must deal with a complex web of tariffs, with some Chinese goods facing rates as high as 145%. Effective global tariff risk mitigation strategies are essential to protect profit margins, maintain competitive pricing, and ensure supply chain resilience in this challenging landscape. The United States Trade Representative (USTR) source indicates that although the Indian government has pursued ongoing economic reform efforts, US exporters continue to face significant tariff and non-tariff barriers that hinder imports of US products into India. The World Trade Organization estimates that the most favored nation import duty imposed on India is 13.8 percent, the highest among any major economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在当今波动的贸易环境中，企业如何实施有效的全球关税风险缓解策略，以应对美国普遍关税政策、中国商品高关税（高达145%）以及印度高关税壁垒（13.8%）等挑战，保护利润空间和供应链韧性。
AI.research_question: 在当今波动的贸易环境中，企业如何设计和实施有效的全球关税风险缓解策略来应对复杂的关税网络、市场不确定性和供应链中断？
AI.motivation: 当前贸易环境高度波动，美国实施10%普遍关税并对主要贸易伙伴征收更高税率，中国商品面临高达145%的关税，印度作为主要经济体实施13.8%的最高最惠国关税，这些因素共同造成了显著的市场不确定性和供应链中断，企业迫切需要有效的关税风险缓解策略来保护利润、维持竞争力和确保供应链韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易风险管理理论、供应链韧性理论、关税规避策略理论、全球贸易政策分析框架、风险管理与成本优化理论。
AI.method: 基于美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）和世界贸易组织（WTO）的官方数据，结合案例分析方法，分析美国、中国和印度的关税政策及其对企业的影响，提出系统的关税风险缓解策略框架。
AI.findings: 1. 美国普遍关税政策导致全球贸易环境高度不确定；2. 中国商品面临极端高关税（高达145%）；3. 印度实施13.8%的最高最惠国关税，成为主要经济体中关税壁垒最高的国家；4. 美国出口商在印度面临显著的关税和非关税壁垒；5. 企业需要综合性的关税风险缓解策略来应对这些挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了国际贸易风险管理理论，特别关注高波动性环境下的关税风险；2. 发展了多国关税政策比较分析框架；3. 提出了针对极端关税环境的风险缓解策略理论模型；4. 丰富了供应链韧性与关税风险管理的交叉理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供应对美国、中国、印度等关键市场关税风险的实用策略；2. 帮助企业管理层制定有效的关税规避和成本优化方案；3. 为供应链管理者提供增强供应链韧性的具体建议；4. 为国际贸易从业者提供政策变化应对指南；5. 为企业保护利润空间和维持竞争力提供可操作框架。

title: Time Well Spent? Data Engagement and Predictive Behavior
affiliations: DoorDash Inc

detail.title: Time Well Spent? Data Engagement and Predictive Behavior

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of Brown University. All participants provided informed consent electronically prior to participation.
declarations.funderStatement: Orlando Bravo Center for Economic Research

detail.abstract: Is a longer response time in multifactor predictive problems relevant to the respondent's beliefs associated with greater prediction accuracy? This paper designs and implements an online experiment in which participants observe data generated from a bivariate linear model with asymmetrically correlated exogenous variables and predict new data points. Participants' predictions are, on average, consistent with their recognizing patterns in the data: 70.33% of them directly or indirectly inferred positive correlations, while 47.97% inferred negative correlations. Endogenous response time is not correlated with higher prediction accuracy. However, with a longer response time, participants' identification of the effect of the positively correlated exogenous variable on the outcome is, on average, more accurate. The same, however, does not hold for the negatively correlated exogenous variable. Further, an exogenous increase in the time required to complete the predictive task does not improve respondents' prediction accuracy or inference of correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在线实验研究响应时间与预测准确性的关系，发现内生响应时间与整体预测准确性无关，但较长的响应时间能提高对正相关外生变量影响的识别准确性，对负相关变量则无此效果。外生增加响应时间对预测准确性无改善。
AI.research_question: 在多元预测问题中，较长的响应时间是否与受访者信念相关的更高预测准确性相关？
AI.motivation: 理解在复杂预测任务中，响应时间如何影响预测准确性，特别是在存在不对称相关外生变量的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知心理学和决策理论，探讨响应时间与预测准确性之间的关系，特别是在模式识别和变量相关性推断方面的作用。
AI.method: 设计并实施在线实验，参与者观察来自具有不对称相关外生变量的二元线性模型生成的数据，并预测新数据点。测量响应时间、预测准确性和相关性推断。
AI.findings: 1. 70.33%的参与者直接或间接推断出正相关，47.97%推断出负相关；2. 内生响应时间与整体预测准确性无关；3. 较长的响应时间能提高对正相关外生变量影响的识别准确性；4. 对负相关外生变量无此效果；5. 外生增加响应时间对预测准确性无改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了响应时间与预测准确性关系的复杂性：内生响应时间对整体准确性无影响，但对特定类型变量（正相关）的识别有积极作用，挑战了"思考时间越长越准确"的简单假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计预测任务和决策支持系统提供指导：单纯增加响应时间不一定提高准确性，需要针对不同类型变量采取不同策略。对培训和教育中如何优化学习过程有启示。

title: Impact and Access of Russia and Ukraine Conflict on Asian Economy: A Study on Indian Financial Market
affiliations: Shri Venkateshwara University, Shri Venkateshwara University and Shri Venkateshwara University

detail.title: Impact and Access of Russia and Ukraine Conflict on Asian Economy: A Study on Indian Financial Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NO
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicalbe
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicalbe

detail.abstract: This paper examines the implications of the Russia-Ukraine conflict that arose in 2022 on the economies of various Asian nations. The primary focus will be on the economic repercussions concerning specific commodities, including fuel, food, trade etc. Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 22, 2022, was a significant shock not only to the global economy but also to Asia, significantly affecting the economies of various Asian nations. This qualitative analysis examines the repercussions of the war on essential economic factors such as trade, energy supply, inflation, and foreign investment in Asian countries including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal. Through an examination of news reports and expert interviews, the study aims to grasp the multifaceted effects of the war on these economies, utilizing data gathered from secondary sources like government publications, economic surveys, news articles, and expert discussions. The findings indicate that Asian nations are grappling with rising energy costs, disrupted supply chains, and inflation. Furthermore, the conflict has not only posed severe economic challenges but has also created opportunities for strategic economic reforms and enhanced resilience. Ultimately, the study seeks to offer valuable insights into the financial market of Asian nations, their implications for development and stability, and to provide a more nuanced understanding of the risks and challenges these countries face, particularly in the context of global uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性分析探讨2022年俄乌冲突对亚洲国家（印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、尼泊尔）的经济影响，重点关注能源成本、供应链中断、通胀等问题，并分析冲突带来的挑战与改革机遇。
AI.research_question: 俄乌冲突对亚洲国家（特别是印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、尼泊尔）的经济影响是什么？这些影响如何体现在贸易、能源供应、通胀和外国投资等关键经济因素上？
AI.motivation: 2022年2月22日俄罗斯入侵乌克兰不仅对全球经济造成重大冲击，也对亚洲经济产生显著影响。冲突对亚洲国家的经济影响尚未得到充分研究，特别是对特定商品（燃料、食品、贸易等）的具体影响需要深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于地缘政治冲击对经济影响的理论框架，结合全球供应链理论、通胀传导机制和国际贸易理论，分析冲突对亚洲经济体的多维影响。
AI.method: 采用定性分析方法，通过新闻报告和专家访谈收集数据，利用政府出版物、经济调查报告、新闻报道和专家讨论等二手资料，对印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、尼泊尔等亚洲国家进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现亚洲国家面临能源成本上升、供应链中断和通胀压力等挑战。同时，冲突也为这些国家带来了战略经济改革和增强经济韧性的机会。具体影响包括贸易受阻、能源供应不稳定、通胀加剧和外国投资波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）深化了地缘政治冲突对发展中经济体影响的理解；2）扩展了全球供应链中断对区域经济影响的理论框架；3）提供了危机情境下经济韧性建设的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为亚洲国家政策制定者提供应对地缘政治冲击的政策建议；2）帮助企业理解供应链风险并制定应对策略；3）为投资者提供亚洲金融市场风险评估的参考；4）促进区域经济合作和危机应对机制的建立。

title: Impact of Global Economic Crisis Raises in Middle East Asia War: A Critical Study on Indian Financial Market
affiliations: Shri Venkateshwara University, Shri Venkateshwara University and Shri Venkateshwara University

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No

detail.abstract: The study examines the impact of the Israel-Iran crisis on the Indian financial market. We Sourced that the intensifying crisis between Israel and Iran had the potential to greatly affect the growth momentum of finances everywhere, including India. According to our research, the ongoing crisis would hurt the world's economy and trade since it might keep the important Red Sea shipping route closed. We added that the rising cost of crude oil would be one of India's biggest problems in the near future, since the country imported the majority of its petrol and oil. A surge in the price of crude oil, they explained, would affect economic growth in addition to causing inflation. The authors observed that as tensions escalated, the implications for Indiaan emerging player in the global market-were becoming increasingly significant. Furthermore, they pointed out that India's energy security was also expected to be at risk to a certain extent as the likelihood of a full-scale conflict between Israel and Iran intensified. Crucial gas and oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz could be disrupted by the fighting, raising energy prices, causing inflation, and destabilizing the Indian economy. Finally, they concluded that the purpose of their article was to analyze how the Israel-Iran crisis would affect the Indian financial market.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了以色列-伊朗危机对印度金融市场的影响，重点关注油价上涨、能源安全风险、通胀压力和经济稳定等方面。
AI.research_question: 以色列-伊朗危机如何影响印度金融市场？
AI.motivation: 以色列-伊朗危机升级可能严重影响全球经济增长势头，特别是对印度这样的新兴市场国家。红海航运路线可能关闭、原油价格上涨、能源安全风险增加等因素都可能对印度经济和金融市场造成冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险对金融市场影响理论、能源安全理论、国际贸易与航运中断理论、新兴市场脆弱性理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和理论推演的研究方法，通过分析地缘政治危机对能源价格、航运路线、贸易流动的影响，推断其对印度金融市场的潜在影响。
AI.findings: 1. 以色列-伊朗危机可能导致红海航运路线关闭，影响全球贸易；2. 原油价格上涨是印度面临的主要问题，可能引发通胀并影响经济增长；3. 霍尔木兹海峡的油气运输可能中断，威胁印度能源安全；4. 危机可能通过能源价格上涨、通胀压力和贸易中断等多渠道影响印度金融市场稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了地缘政治风险对新兴市场金融市场影响的理论框架；2. 提供了能源安全与金融市场稳定性的关联分析；3. 拓展了国际贸易中断对特定国家金融影响的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度政策制定者提供危机应对参考；2. 帮助投资者理解地缘政治风险对印度市场的潜在影响；3. 为印度能源安全战略提供分析依据；4. 为金融机构风险管理提供地缘政治因素考量。

title: Digital Search Behaviour and the Housing Credit Cycle: Evidence From South Africa

detail.title: Digital Search Behaviour and the Housing Credit Cycle: Evidence From South Africa
detail.abstract: Monitoring vulnerabilities in housing markets relies primarily on backwardlooking indicators such as mortgage approvals and house price indices. This paper develops a Search Behaviour Index (SBI) using monthly Google Search data (2010-2025) to capture shifts in housing-related attention and credit demand in South Africa. The index is constructed using a multidimensional principal component framework and examined within a vector autoregression (VAR) model alongside mortgage advances, building activity, and house prices. The results indicate that search behaviour contains statistically significant leading information for mortgage credit growth, with effects transmitting to construction activity and prices over subsequent months. Robustness checks using alternative specifications, sub-indices, and sample periods confirm the stability of this relationship. The findings suggest that digital behavioural signals may serve as a complementary macroprudential monitoring tool for the housing credit cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2025年南非的谷歌搜索数据构建了搜索行为指数(SBI)，发现该指数对抵押贷款增长具有显著的领先预测能力，并能传导至建筑活动和房价，可作为住房信贷周期的补充宏观审慎监测工具。
AI.research_question: 数字行为信号（特别是谷歌搜索数据）能否作为住房市场脆弱性的领先指标，预测抵押贷款增长、建筑活动和房价变化？
AI.motivation: 当前住房市场监测主要依赖滞后的传统指标（如抵押贷款批准和房价指数），需要开发更及时、前瞻性的监测工具来捕捉市场变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力理论和行为经济学，认为搜索行为反映了潜在购房者的关注度和信贷需求，可作为市场情绪的代理变量。
AI.method: 使用多维主成分分析构建搜索行为指数(SBI)，然后通过向量自回归(VAR)模型分析SBI与抵押贷款、建筑活动、房价之间的动态关系，并进行多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 搜索行为对抵押贷款增长具有统计显著的领先预测能力，这种影响会在后续月份传导至建筑活动和房价；该关系在不同模型设定、子指数和样本期间均保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字行为信号引入住房市场监测框架，扩展了注意力理论和行为经济学在宏观金融监测中的应用，为理解信息搜索与信贷决策的关联提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了基于搜索数据的实时监测工具，可作为传统宏观审慎指标的补充，帮助更早识别住房信贷周期变化和潜在风险。

title: Crash Risk and Market Resilience in Retail-Dominated Markets
affiliations: University of Oxford - Oxford-Man Institute of Quantitative Finance

detail.title: Crash Risk and Market Resilience in Retail-Dominated Markets
detail.abstract: I exploit a regulatory shock that eliminated short-selling capacity to study how binding shortsale constraints affect crash risk in a retail-dominated market. Using a difference-indifferences design comparing stocks most versus least affected by the ban, I find that removing short sellers reduced future crash risk-contrary to canonical bad-news-hoarding predictions. Aggregate investor attention does not explain this stabilisation. Brokerage-level trading data, however, reveal investor-type heterogeneity in the mechanism: retail herd trading is associated with lower crash risk, consistent with liquidity provision, while speculative hot-money trading is associated with higher crash risk. These findings indicate that crash risk consequences of short-selling bans depend critically on who provides marginal liquidity in their absence, with direct implications for the many emerging markets with similar investor structures.

AI.tldr: 研究利用禁止卖空的政策冲击，发现在散户主导的市场中，卖空限制反而降低了崩盘风险，这与传统"坏消息囤积"理论相反。机制分析显示散户跟风交易提供流动性降低风险，而投机性热钱交易增加风险。
AI.research_question: 卖空限制如何影响散户主导市场的崩盘风险？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为卖空限制会增加崩盘风险（坏消息囤积假说），但这一理论主要基于机构主导市场。在散户主导的新兴市场中，卖空限制的影响机制可能不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 坏消息囤积假说（传统理论）、流动性提供理论、投资者异质性理论
AI.method: 利用禁止卖空的监管冲击作为自然实验，采用双重差分法，比较受影响最大和最小的股票。使用券商层面的交易数据分析投资者类型异质性。
AI.findings: 1. 卖空限制降低了未来崩盘风险（与传统理论相反）；2. 总体投资者注意力无法解释这种稳定效应；3. 散户跟风交易提供流动性降低风险，投机性热钱交易增加风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战传统坏消息囤积假说在散户市场的适用性；2. 提出投资者类型异质性在卖空限制影响机制中的关键作用；3. 为新兴市场金融监管提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴市场监管者提供政策启示：卖空限制的效果取决于替代流动性提供者的类型；2. 帮助投资者理解不同交易行为对市场稳定的影响；3. 为类似投资者结构的市场提供监管参考。

title: The Resource Standard: A Real-Resource Anchor for Sovereign Currency in the Fiat Era

detail.title: The Resource Standard: A Real-Resource Anchor for Sovereign Currency in the Fiat Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical and policy-oriented research work and does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Resource Standard, a framework in which the value of currency is anchored not to commodities or reserves but to real resources, including human labour, revealing an operational structure implicit in sovereign fiat monetary systems that has not yet been explicitly formalized. Under commodity standards, currency value was expressed in terms of a fixed quantity of gold, and the availability of gold reserves therefore constrained government spending. Fiat currency does not possess intrinsic value; its value is expressed in terms of the goods and services it purchases. The sovereign government is the sole supplier of currency, so the prices paid through government spending introduce the absolute value of the currency. The moment at which sovereign spending assigns prices to labour and goods is therefore the moment at which the value of currency is operationally established. The requirement that taxes be paid in the sovereign currency ensures demand for the currency, but the prices paid in sovereign spending determine what that currency is worth in real terms. Under a fiat monetary system, the effective limit to sovereign spending is therefore not financial but real: the availability of goods and services for sale in the currency, particularly labour. The value of currency in real terms is realized through the production of those goods and services. When available resources remain idle, part of the potential value of currency remains unrealized. Sovereign spending introduces the absolute value of currency, while the deployment of real productive capacity determines the cumulative value realized within the economy. The Resource Standard therefore proposes that the cumulative value of a sovereign currency is maximized when all available real productive capacity, especially labour, is deployed. The paper demonstrates that unemployment, idle capacity, and persistent poverty are violations of this standard, arising from insufficient sovereign spending relative to imposed tax liabilities and private saving preferences. It further introduces the Anchor Mechanism, a governance corollary in which the sovereign temporarily intervenes as a price-setting buyer and seller of essential goods during inflationary episodes, stabilizing the price level without austerity, interest-rate manipulation, or output suppression. By replacing commodity backing with a real-resource anchor, the Resource Standard clarifies the operational foundations of fiat money and establishes full employment as a systemic requirement rather than a discretionary policy choice. The framework provides a coherent basis for price stability, universal employment, and sustained abundance in sovereign currency systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了资源标准框架，将货币价值锚定于真实资源（特别是劳动力），而非商品或储备。该框架揭示了主权法定货币体系中隐含的操作结构，指出主权支出通过为劳动和商品定价来确立货币的绝对价值，而货币的累积价值则通过实际生产能力的部署来实现。失业和闲置产能被视为违反该标准的现象，源于主权支出相对于税收和私人储蓄偏好的不足。框架还引入锚定机制，通过主权干预稳定价格水平。
AI.research_question: 主权法定货币体系的操作基础是什么？如何通过资源锚定而非商品储备来确立货币价值？主权支出、税收和实际生产能力部署如何共同决定货币的累积价值？
AI.motivation: 现有货币理论未能明确形式化主权法定货币体系的操作结构。商品标准时代货币价值由黄金储备决定，而法定货币缺乏内在价值，其价值确立机制尚未被充分阐明。理解主权支出如何为货币建立绝对价值，以及实际资源（特别是劳动力）如何决定货币的累积价值，对于解决失业、闲置产能和贫困问题至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源标准框架、现代货币理论（MMT）基础、主权货币理论、价格形成理论、就业与生产能力理论。框架核心是将货币价值锚定于真实资源而非商品储备，强调主权支出在确立货币绝对价值中的关键作用。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建、逻辑演绎推理、操作结构形式化。通过对比商品标准与法定货币体系的差异，推导出主权支出为劳动和商品定价的操作机制，并建立资源标准与货币价值实现之间的理论联系。
AI.findings: 1. 主权支出通过为劳动和商品定价确立货币的绝对价值；2. 税收创造货币需求但不决定其实际价值；3. 主权支出的实际限制是可用商品和服务的可获得性，特别是劳动力；4. 货币的累积价值通过实际生产能力的部署实现；5. 失业、闲置产能和贫困源于主权支出相对于税收和私人储蓄的不足；6. 锚定机制可通过主权价格干预稳定通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次明确形式化了主权法定货币体系的操作结构；2. 提出资源标准作为货币价值的新锚定机制；3. 建立了主权支出、税收与实际生产能力部署之间的理论联系；4. 将充分就业重新定义为系统性要求而非政策选择；5. 为价格稳定提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了实现充分就业和价格稳定的操作框架；2. 锚定机制为应对通胀提供了非紧缩性政策工具；3. 明确了主权支出在激活闲置资源中的关键作用；4. 为消除贫困和实现经济繁荣提供了系统性解决方案；5. 挑战了传统财政约束观念，强调实际资源限制的重要性。

title: Factors or Fake? A New Look at Anomalies
affiliations: , City University of Hong Kong (CityU) and

detail.title: Factors or Fake? A New Look at Anomalies
detail.abstract: Based on the insight that declaring an anomaly as not spanned requires knowledge of the true stochastic discount factor (SDF), we reverse conventional testing and suppose that, under the alternative, the anomaly is spanned. Under this novel framework, we formulate a procedure that computes posterior probabilities for single anomalies, pairs, and larger sets, integrating over the distribution of possible SDFs, while controlling the expected false discovery rate at each stage. In the U.S. data, 132 of 153 anomalies are classified as spanned. The evidence highlights redundancy and masking in the anomaly zoo.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的检验框架，假设异常收益被随机折现因子（SDF）所解释，通过计算后验概率来识别真正未被解释的异常，发现153个异常中有132个被归类为已被解释。
AI.research_question: 在金融市场中，哪些所谓的"异常收益"实际上是能够被随机折现因子（SDF）所解释的，而不是真正的定价异常？
AI.motivation: 传统异常检验方法需要知道真实的SDF，但SDF本身是未知的。现有研究发现了大量"异常动物园"，但其中许多可能只是冗余或相互掩盖的，需要新的方法来区分真正未被解释的异常。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论中的随机折现因子（SDF）框架，提出逆向检验方法：假设异常被SDF所解释（即被定价因子所覆盖），然后检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 开发了一种计算后验概率的程序，针对单个异常、异常对和更大集合，同时对可能的SDF分布进行积分，并在每个阶段控制期望错误发现率。
AI.findings: 在美国数据中，153个异常中有132个被分类为已被SDF解释（即被定价因子所覆盖）。证据表明异常动物园中存在大量冗余和掩盖现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了逆向检验框架，避免了传统方法需要知道真实SDF的问题；2）发展了控制错误发现率的后验概率计算方法；3）为理解异常冗余和掩盖现象提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）帮助研究人员和投资者识别真正未被解释的异常；2）减少对冗余异常的研究资源浪费；3）为资产定价实践提供更可靠的异常筛选方法。

title: High-Dimensional and Univariate Approaches to Real-Time Inflation Forecast in Nicaragua with Machine Learning and Conformal Prediction
affiliations: Universidad Americana

detail.title: High-Dimensional and Univariate Approaches to Real-Time Inflation Forecast in Nicaragua with Machine Learning and Conformal Prediction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Accurate inflation forecasts are crucial for monetary policy, yet emerging economies face heightened volatility and data limitations that challenge conventional models. This paper develops a unified real-time forecasting framework for monthly CPI inflation in Nicaragua (2016-2023), combining high-dimensional machine-learning (ML) methods, disaggregated univariate models, robust model selection, forecast combination, and probabilistic inference. We implement five forecasting strategies from ML learners with realistic information sets to bottom-up aggregation of twelve CPI subindices and apply the Model Confidence Set to isolate superior models at each horizon. Simple OLS combinations of these superior set forecasts further reduce root-mean-square errors by up to 40% relative to a driftless random walk and pass Diebold-Mariano and unbiasedness tests. Notably, bottom-up AutoETS delivers the lowest errors (RMSE ratios 0.684 at one month, 0.501 at twelve months) and remains the only model yielding rational errors across all horizons. Feature-importance and SHAP analyses confirm that global policy uncertainty and short-run inertia drive inflation dynamics, while conformal prediction methods produce well-calibrated 90% intervals without parametric assumptions. Our findings demonstrate that (i) careful information timing reduces artificial performance gains, (ii) parsimonious bottom-up schemes can outperform complex ML under realtime constraints, (iii) simple combinations yield robust, unbiased forecasts, and (iv) conformal inference provides reliable uncertainty quantification offering central banks a practical toolkit for inflation monitoring in volatile, data-scarce settings.

AI.tldr: 本文为尼加拉瓜开发了一个实时通胀预测框架，结合机器学习、分解模型和预测组合，在数据有限的新兴经济体中实现了比随机游走模型高达40%的预测精度提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据有限、波动性高的新兴经济体中开发有效的实时月度CPI通胀预测框架？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体面临通胀波动性高、数据有限等挑战，传统预测模型效果不佳，需要开发适应实时约束的稳健预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合高维机器学习方法、分解单变量模型、稳健模型选择、预测组合和概率推断的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用五种预测策略：从具有现实信息集的机器学习学习器到12个CPI子指数的自下而上聚合，应用模型置信集筛选每个预测期限的优越模型，并通过简单OLS组合进一步优化。
AI.findings: 1) 自下而上的AutoETS模型误差最低（RMSE比率：1个月0.684，12个月0.501）；2) 简单组合使RMSE相对无漂移随机游走降低达40%；3) 全球政策不确定性和短期惯性驱动通胀动态；4) 保形预测方法产生校准良好的90%区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明在实时约束下，简约的自下而上方案可以胜过复杂机器学习；2) 展示简单组合能产生稳健、无偏预测；3) 提供保形推断作为可靠的区间预测方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供实用的通胀监测工具包，包括：1) 通过仔细信息定时减少人为性能增益；2) 自下而上预测方案；3) 简单组合方法；4) 可靠的不确定性量化工具。

title: Binocular Directional Forecasting: A Cross-Attention Fusion Approach
affiliations: Peking University HSBC Business School and

detail.title: Binocular Directional Forecasting: A Cross-Attention Fusion Approach
detail.abstract: We develop a binocular directional forecasting framework that jointly leverages information from equity and option markets through a multimodal deep learning architecture. Realized price and trading dynamics, together with option-implied volatility information, are encoded as twodimensional images and processed using convolutional neural networks (CNNs), then integrated through a cross-attention mechanism with an adaptive gating network. This design enables bidirectional information flow across markets and state-dependent weighting of heterogeneous signals. Using U.S. equity and option daily data from 1996 to 2023, we show that the binocular model significantly outperforms stock-only benchmarks in out-of-sample directional prediction at both monthly and quarterly horizons. Trading strategies based on the fused forecasts achieve higher Sharpe ratios and lower turnover than traditional momentum and reversal strategies. Performance gains are most pronounced during periods of elevated market uncertainty and weak historical predictability, highlighting the incremental value of forward-looking option-implied expectations. Overall, our findings demonstrate that cross-attention provides an effective and scalable approach for integrating realized and expectations-based information in financial forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个双重视角预测框架，通过多模态深度学习架构联合利用股票和期权市场信息，使用CNN处理价格、交易动态和期权隐含波动率信息，并通过跨注意力机制与自适应门控网络整合，显著提升了方向性预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过联合利用股票和期权市场信息，构建一个有效的多模态深度学习框架来提升股票方向性预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统股票预测模型通常只使用历史价格数据，忽略了期权市场蕴含的前瞻性信息。期权隐含波动率反映了市场对未来不确定性的预期，将这两个市场的信息有效整合可以提升预测性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态深度学习、跨注意力机制、自适应门控网络、卷积神经网络、市场信息整合理论
AI.method: 将股票价格和交易动态以及期权隐含波动率信息编码为二维图像，使用CNN处理，通过跨注意力机制和自适应门控网络整合两个市场的信息，构建双重视角预测模型。
AI.findings: 双重视角模型在月度、季度预测中显著优于仅使用股票信息的基准模型；基于融合预测的交易策略获得更高的夏普比率和更低的换手率；在市场不确定性高、历史可预测性弱的时期表现尤为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个有效的跨市场信息整合框架；证明了跨注意力机制在金融预测中的有效性；展示了前瞻性期权信息对预测的增量价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的股票方向性预测工具；开发了基于多市场信息的交易策略；在市场不确定性时期提供了更好的风险管理工具。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive personal clinical data; it is an algorithmic and statistical analysis of financial market data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This research note introduces a reciprocal approach to Model Risk Management (MRM) that pairs high-performance quantitative modeling with large language model (LLM) augmentation. Using a Medallion architecture in Databricks, the project develops a production-ready GJR-GARCH pipeline for volatility forecasting. To address the documentation bottleneck inherent in regulatory compliance (SR 11-7), the model implements a LangChain-orchestrated, Gemini-driven agentic workflow that utilizes In-Context Learning (ICL) to ingest pipeline metadata, statistical backtesting results (e.g., Kupiec and Christoffersen tests), and code artifacts to generate an automated model validation report (AMVR). By utilizing this AMVR as a challenger to a human-authored champion report, the workflow establishes a robust cross-check mechanism that identifies discrepancies in model assumptions and statistical interpretations. Although primarily focused on finance, this hybrid framework demonstrates a significant reduction in compliance latency and the model-to-production lifecycle while maintaining the rigorous standards required for the second line of defense (2LoD) in the banking industry and quality and regulatory oversight in the healthcare sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合高性能量化模型与LLM增强的互惠式模型风险管理方法，通过自动化模型验证报告与人工报告对比，显著降低合规延迟和模型投产周期。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合高性能量化模型与大语言模型增强，建立有效的互惠式模型风险管理框架，以解决监管合规中的文档瓶颈问题？
AI.motivation: 传统模型风险管理面临监管合规（特别是SR 11-7）中的文档瓶颈问题，导致合规延迟和模型投产周期延长，需要创新方法提高效率同时保持严格标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互惠式模型风险管理理论、模型验证理论（冠军-挑战者框架）、监管合规理论（SR 11-7）、大语言模型增强理论。
AI.method: 采用Databricks中的Medallion架构开发GJR-GARCH波动率预测管道，结合LangChain编排的Gemini驱动代理工作流，利用上下文学习生成自动化模型验证报告，并与人工报告进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 该混合框架显著降低了合规延迟和模型投产周期，同时保持了银行业第二道防线和医疗行业质量监管所需的严格标准，通过自动化与人工报告的交叉检查机制有效识别模型假设和统计解释的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了互惠式模型风险管理的新理论框架，将高性能量化模型与LLM增强相结合，扩展了冠军-挑战者模型验证理论在自动化环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了生产就绪的GJR-GARCH管道和自动化模型验证报告系统，为金融和医疗行业提供了可操作的合规解决方案，显著提高了模型风险管理效率。

title: Tariffs and Turbulence, Canada's Economic Crossroads
affiliations: Szymon Zephan Capital (SZC Group), Szymon Zephan Capital (SZC Group) and Szymon Zephan Capital (SZC Group)

detail.title: Tariffs and Turbulence, Canada's Economic Crossroads
detail.abstract:
This report analyzes the economic impact of the 2025 tariff escalation between Canada and the United States, marking a structural shift in North America’s most important trade relationship. Following broad U.S. tariff measures and Canadian retaliation, the study examines how tariffs transmit through the economy via cost-push inflation, supply chain disruptions, retaliatory effects, and exchange rate adjustments.

We assess macroeconomic consequences for GDP growth, inflation, household purchasing power, and sectoral performance—particularly in automotive, metals, energy, and agriculture—within the integrated framework of the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement. The report concludes that while tariffs may offer short-term protection, prolonged trade conflict risks permanent output losses, higher inflation persistence, and greater economic fragmentation, requiring coordinated policy responses to safeguard competitiveness and long-term resilience.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了2025年加美关税升级的经济影响，认为虽然关税在短期内可能提供保护，但长期贸易冲突会导致永久性产出损失、通胀持续和经济碎片化。
AI.research_question: 2025年加美关税升级如何通过成本推动通胀、供应链中断、报复效应和汇率调整等渠道影响经济？
AI.motivation: 北美最重要贸易关系发生结构性转变，需要评估关税升级对宏观经济和关键行业的影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、关税传导机制、成本推动通胀理论、供应链经济学、汇率调整理论。
AI.method: 在《加拿大-美国-墨西哥协定》综合框架下，采用宏观经济模型分析关税对GDP增长、通胀、家庭购买力和行业表现的影响。
AI.findings: 关税通过成本推动通胀、供应链中断、报复效应和汇率调整等渠道传导；虽然短期可能提供保护，但长期贸易冲突会导致永久性产出损失、更高通胀持续性和经济碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对现代贸易冲突传导机制的理解，特别是在北美自由贸易协定框架下的关税影响分析，为国际贸易理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供协调政策回应的建议，以保护竞争力和长期韧性；为汽车、金属、能源和农业等关键行业提供风险管理指导。

title: Design Choices in Low-Latency C++ Systems: Empirical Insights With Applications to High-Frequency Trading

detail.title: Design Choices in Low-Latency C++ Systems: Empirical Insights With Applications to High-Frequency Trading

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: High-frequency trading (HFT) systems operate under extreme latency constraints, where microseconds can determine profitability. While prior work often focuses on isolated optimizations, achieving consistently low latency in practice requires coordinated design across the entire software stack. This preprint presents a comprehensive empirical study of low-latency system design from a software-centric perspective, evaluating optimizations across five key layers: system tuning, C++ language features, compiler optimizations, programming techniques, and networking. Through systematic benchmarking on commodity hardware, we quantify the latency impact of a wide range of techniques, including scheduler policies, memory management strategies, compile-time abstractions, cache-aware designs, lock-free concurrency, and kernel-bypass networking via AF XDP. Our results demonstrate that latency behavior is governed not by any single optimization, but by the interaction between layers, with factors such as kernel involvement, memory access patterns, and control-flow predictability playing dominant roles. While absolute performance gains vary across environments, the study surfaces consistent principles for reducing latency and improving determinism. By unifying insights across traditionally siloed areas, this work provides a structured framework for reasoning about low-latency system design and bridges the gap between academic exploration and real-world high-performance trading systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对高频交易系统的低延迟设计进行了全面的实证研究，从软件角度评估了系统调优、C++语言特性、编译器优化、编程技术和网络五个关键层次的优化策略，揭示了延迟行为由各层次交互而非单一优化决定。
AI.research_question: 在高频交易系统的极端延迟约束下，如何通过跨软件栈的协调设计实现持续低延迟？不同层次的优化技术（系统调优、C++特性、编译器优化、编程技术、网络）如何交互影响整体延迟性能？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注孤立优化，但在实践中实现持续低延迟需要整个软件栈的协调设计。微秒级的延迟差异就能决定高频交易的盈利能力，因此需要系统性的设计框架来指导实际高性能交易系统的开发。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件中心视角的低延迟系统设计框架，涵盖五个关键层次：系统调优、C++语言特性、编译器优化、编程技术、网络。强调各层次间的交互作用而非单一优化。
AI.method: 在商用硬件上进行系统性基准测试，量化评估多种技术的延迟影响，包括调度器策略、内存管理策略、编译时抽象、缓存感知设计、无锁并发、通过AF XDP的内核旁路网络等。
AI.findings: 延迟行为不由单一优化决定，而是由各层次间的交互作用主导，其中内核参与度、内存访问模式和控制流可预测性起关键作用。虽然绝对性能增益因环境而异，但研究揭示了减少延迟和提高确定性的通用原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了结构化框架来推理低延迟系统设计，统一了传统上孤立领域的见解，弥合了学术探索与真实世界高性能交易系统之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频交易系统开发者提供了具体的优化指导原则，包括如何协调不同软件层次的设计决策，以及如何在实际环境中实现微秒级的延迟改进。

title: Liquidity Provision and Price Impact Under Asymmetric Information: A Structural Microstructure Analysis

detail.title: Liquidity Provision and Price Impact Under Asymmetric Information: A Structural Microstructure Analysis
detail.abstract:
In modern financial markets, price formation is not frictionless but arises from strategic interactions under provision of asymmetric information. Financial markets are fundamentally structured around the interaction between two primary participants: market makers, who supply liquidity, and traders, who demand it, thereby driving price discovery. Within a specific financial market, there are  traders with private information about the asset’s true value and uniformed traders who are driven by liquidity and lack private information with respect to the true value of the market assets. The market makers who act as trading intermediaries are unable to distinguish between informed and uniformed traders trying to make a profit. These market makers face adverse selection risk, where they make a blind risk and set a stochastic value to the asset. 

To effectively avoid the adverse selection risk and financial loss the market makers utilise the observed sequence and composition of incoming orders (market orders, limit orders, cancellations) known as order flow to assign a value for the price of the asset/stock. 

This paper examines how market makers assign asset value and provide liquidity under asymmetric information and adverse selection risk. And how the process of Bayesian price formation generates price impacts. The paper follows a structural microstructure framework to effectively study concepts of order flow and price impacts while explaining the mechanism through which market makers update bids–ask quotes in response to order flow, thereby mitigating adverse selection risk posed by informed traders. Driven by the Kyle (1985) model and Glosten-Milgrom (1985) model this paper argues that price impact is endogenous and resulted by informed asymmetry and market liquidity. 

By proficiently identifying the relation between information asymmetry, market liquidity and price impact with respect to the Bayesian price formation, Kyle (1985) model and Glosten-Milgrom (1985) model, this research advances the theoretical understanding market structures and real-world price movements with the link of trading activity to volatility and liquidity changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了做市商在信息不对称和逆向选择风险下如何确定资产价值并提供流动性，以及贝叶斯价格形成过程如何产生价格影响。基于Kyle(1985)和Glosten-Milgrom(1985)模型，论文认为价格影响是内生的，源于信息不对称和市场流动性。
AI.research_question: 做市商如何在信息不对称和逆向选择风险下确定资产价值并提供流动性？贝叶斯价格形成过程如何产生价格影响？
AI.motivation: 现代金融市场中价格形成并非无摩擦，而是在信息不对称下的战略互动中产生。做市商面临逆向选择风险，无法区分知情交易者和非知情交易者，需要通过订单流信息来定价以避免损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kyle(1985)模型和Glosten-Milgrom(1985)模型的结构性微观结构框架，研究信息不对称、市场流动性和价格影响之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用结构性微观结构框架，分析订单流和价格影响的概念，解释做市商如何根据订单流更新买卖报价以缓解逆向选择风险。
AI.findings: 价格影响是内生的，源于信息不对称和市场流动性。做市商通过观察订单流（市场订单、限价订单、取消订单）来更新报价，从而缓解知情交易者带来的逆向选择风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过识别信息不对称、市场流动性和价格影响之间的关系，基于贝叶斯价格形成理论，深化了对市场结构和实际价格变动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解交易活动与波动性和流动性变化之间的联系提供了理论框架，有助于市场参与者更好地管理风险和制定交易策略。

title: Budget Efficiency Alpha in Formula 1: A Dominance Structure Framework and Budget Efficiency Index for Competitive Analysis Under the FIA Cost Cap

detail.title: Budget Efficiency Alpha in Formula 1: A Dominance Structure Framework and Budget Efficiency Index for Competitive Analysis Under the FIA Cost Cap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study examines the structural effects of the FIA Financial Regulations (cost cap) on competitive dynamics in Formula 1 from 2010 to 2025. We introduce two analytical contributions. First, a four-metric \textit{Dominance Structure Framework} (DSF) --- comprising the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index, rank persistence, performance volatility, and rank mobility --- applied across three regulatory eras: the baseline dominance era (2010--2015), the hybrid consolidation era (2016--2020), and the cost cap era (2021--2025). Second, a novel \textit{Budget Efficiency Index} (BEI), defined as the ratio of a constructor's points share to its estimated resource share, which measures performance generated per unit of resource allocation --- analogous to alpha in asset management. DSF results indicate that the cost rank mobility increased by 53 percent in the cost cap era relative to the baseline era, while modestly reducing concentration, consistent with greater competitive fluidity. BEI analysis reveals that Red Bull Racing (1.865) and Mercedes (1.826) generate the highest average efficiency across the full sample, while McLaren exhibits the largest BEI improvement under the cost cap era (rising to 2.39 in 2025), suggesting that financial constraints have redistributed efficiency gains toward historically mid-tier constructors. These results have implications for the design of financial regulations in professional motorsport and contribute to the broader literature on competitive balance under binding resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了FIA财务法规（成本上限）对2010-2025年F1竞争动态的结构性影响，提出了主导结构框架和预算效率指数两个分析工具，发现成本上限时代提高了竞争流动性，并将效率收益重新分配给中游车队。
AI.research_question: FIA财务法规（成本上限）如何影响F1的竞争动态和车队效率？
AI.motivation: 理解财务约束对职业赛车运动竞争平衡的影响，为财务法规设计提供实证依据，并丰富资源约束下竞争平衡的文献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主导结构框架（DSF）包含四个指标：赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数、排名持续性、表现波动性和排名流动性；预算效率指数（BEI）定义为车队积分份额与估计资源份额的比率，类似于资产管理中的阿尔法系数。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，将2010-2025年分为三个监管时代：基准主导时代（2010-2015）、混合整合时代（2016-2020）、成本上限时代（2021-2025），应用DSF和BEI进行跨时代比较。
AI.findings: 成本上限时代排名流动性比基准时代提高了53%，适度降低了集中度；红牛（1.865）和梅赛德斯（1.826）在整个样本中平均效率最高，迈凯伦在成本上限时代BEI提升最大（2025年达到2.39），表明财务约束将效率收益重新分配给历史中游车队。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了主导结构框架和预算效率指数两个新的分析工具，丰富了资源约束下竞争平衡的理论框架，为体育经济学和战略管理提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为F1和其他职业赛车运动的财务法规设计提供了实证依据，帮助车队管理者在成本约束下优化资源配置，为监管机构评估政策效果提供了量化工具。

title: Why You Watched That: Evidence from 1.2 Billion Views on the Economics of Short-Form Attention

detail.title: Why You Watched That: Evidence from 1.2 Billion Views on the Economics of Short-Form Attention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator and operator of the YouTube channel analyzed in this paper. All data is from the author's own channel analytics.

detail.abstract: Using 340 YouTube Shorts from a single channel with over 1.2 billion views, this paper argues that short-form video attention operates in two phases: a discovery phase where the viewer evaluates the promise, and a continuation phase where the viewer checks whether the promise is real and then evaluates the payoff. Two metrics YouTube provides, the retention curve and the swipe decision (Stayed to Watch), capture largely independent dimensions of performance, and several content features that improve one margin actively hurt the other. Participatory formats such as challenges and puzzles are unusual because they are especially strong on continuation and appear less exposed to the usual confirmation-window penalty. In the pooled cross-section, the strongest correlate of total reach is not the opening hook but what happens at 10-20% of the runtime; however, this relationship is heavily confounded by time period and became stronger in later years as competition increased. Predictable scripts retain ten percentage points more than unpredictable ones. The primary evidence comes from retention curves and transcripts, while the discovery proxy is noisy but suggestive. This is a case study on a single creator with descriptive findings and no causal identification.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析单个YouTube频道340个短视频发现，短视频注意力分为两个阶段：发现阶段（评估视频承诺）和延续阶段（验证承诺并评估回报）。YouTube提供的留存曲线和滑动决策（继续观看）捕捉了基本独立的性能维度，某些内容特征改善一个维度时会损害另一个维度。参与式格式（如挑战和谜题）在延续阶段表现特别强，且较少受确认窗口惩罚影响。
AI.research_question: 短视频注意力如何运作？哪些内容特征影响短视频的发现和延续阶段表现？
AI.motivation: 理解短视频平台（如YouTube Shorts）上用户注意力的动态机制，以及内容创作者如何优化短视频表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 短视频注意力两阶段模型：发现阶段（评估承诺）和延续阶段（验证承诺并评估回报）。
AI.method: 案例研究：分析单个YouTube频道（超过12亿次观看）的340个短视频，使用YouTube提供的留存曲线和滑动决策数据，结合转录文本分析。
AI.findings: 1. 留存曲线和滑动决策捕捉独立维度；2. 某些内容特征改善一个维度会损害另一个；3. 参与式格式在延续阶段表现强；4. 视频10-20%时段内容与总覆盖相关性最强；5. 可预测脚本比不可预测脚本多保留10个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出短视频注意力两阶段模型，区分发现和延续阶段的不同机制，为短视频内容分析提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为内容创作者提供优化建议：关注视频10-20%时段内容质量，使用可预测脚本结构，考虑参与式格式以增强延续阶段表现。

title: Factor-Adjusted Multiple Testing for High-Dimensional Individual Mediation Effects
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Data Science, Fudan University - School of Data Science and New York University Shanghai

detail.title: Factor-Adjusted Multiple Testing for High-Dimensional Individual Mediation Effects
detail.abstract: Identifying individual mediators is a central goal of high-dimensional mediation analysis, yet pervasive dependence among mediators can invalidate standard debiased inference and lead to substantial false discovery rate (FDR) inflation. We propose a Factor-Adjusted Debiased Mediation Testing (FADMT) framework that enables large-scale inference for individual mediation effects with FDR control under complex dependence structures. Our approach posits an approximate factor structure on the unobserved errors of the mediator model, extracts common latent factors, and constructs decorrelated pseudo-mediators for the subsequent inferential procedure. We establish the asymptotic normality of the debiased estimator and develop a multiple testing procedure with theoretical FDR control under mild high-dimensional conditions. By adjusting for latent factor induced dependence, FADMT also improves robustness to spurious associations driven by shared latent variation in observational studies. Extensive simulations demonstrate the superior finite-sample performance across a wide range of correlation structures. Applications to TCGA-BRCA multiomics data and to China's stock connect study further illustrate the practical utility of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种因子调整的去偏置中介检验框架（FADMT），用于在高维中介分析中控制错误发现率，特别适用于存在复杂依赖结构的情况。
AI.research_question: 在高维中介分析中，如何有效识别个体中介效应，并在存在复杂依赖结构的情况下控制错误发现率？
AI.motivation: 传统的高维中介分析方法在处理普遍存在的中介变量依赖时，会导致去偏置推断失效和错误发现率大幅膨胀，需要新的方法来应对复杂依赖结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于近似因子结构理论，假设中介模型中的未观测误差具有近似因子结构，通过提取共同潜在因子来调整依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出因子调整的去偏置中介检验框架（FADMT）：1）在中介模型中假设近似因子结构；2）提取共同潜在因子；3）构建去相关的伪中介变量；4）进行后续推断程序。
AI.findings: 1）建立了去偏置估计量的渐近正态性；2）开发了具有理论FDR控制的多重检验程序；3）通过调整潜在因子诱导的依赖，提高了对观察研究中共享潜在变异驱动的虚假关联的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了处理高维中介分析中复杂依赖结构的新理论框架；2）建立了在温和高维条件下的渐近理论保证；3）提供了理论上的FDR控制保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了实用的FADMT方法；2）在TCGA-BRCA多组学数据和中国的股票互联研究中展示了实际应用价值；3）通过广泛模拟验证了在各种相关结构下的优越有限样本性能。

title: Biodiversity: An Overview
affiliations: and Department of College Education, Government of Rajasthan

detail.title: Biodiversity: An Overview
detail.abstract: Biodiversity, encompassing genetic diversity, species, populations, communities and ecosystems, and landscapes and regions, provides countless benefits to humans at all these scales. It is not just an accumulation of species; instead, it is the existence of species in situ with all of their complex ecological and evolutionary interactions. Despite being in limelight for decades, still the concept as well as the essence of biodiversity is a poorly understood but valuable natural resource, which is being lost and in many regions having attained the status of extinction. The present book is one among the many sincere efforts to bridge this yawning gap by presenting a broad overview of biodiversity. This overview is just not a documentation but also an interpretation of intrinsic benefits that need to be perceived which is far important than the economic underpinnings that the human mind tends to realize.

AI.tldr: 本书提供了对生物多样性的全面概述，强调其不仅是物种的累积，更是物种在自然栖息地中复杂的生态和进化相互作用，并探讨了超越经济价值的本质重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何更好地理解和诠释生物多样性的本质、价值及其多层次意义，超越单纯的经济评估？
AI.motivation: 尽管生物多样性已被关注数十年，但其概念和本质仍未被充分理解，同时生物多样性正在快速丧失，许多地区已达到灭绝状态，需要弥合这一认知差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多层次生物多样性框架（遗传多样性、物种、种群、群落和生态系统、景观和区域），强调生物多样性的生态和进化相互作用本质。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析，通过文献梳理和理论阐释，提供生物多样性的全面概述和深度解读。
AI.findings: 生物多样性提供多层次的人类福祉，其本质重要性超越经济价值，需要从生态和进化相互作用的角度理解其内在价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对生物多样性本质的理解，强调其作为复杂生态和进化系统的内在价值，超越了传统的物种累积观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、保护实践者和公众提供了理解生物多样性重要性的框架，强调保护行动需要基于对其本质价值的认识，而不仅仅是经济考量。

title: Passive moral hazard in weather index insurance
affiliations: University of Florida, International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) and International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI)

detail.title: Passive moral hazard in weather index insurance
detail.abstract: Using a cluster randomized controlled trial in Odisha, India, we evaluate the effects of drought-tolerant rice (DT) cultivars and a bundled intervention combining DT with weather-index insurance (WII), which is designed to complement DT and provide a low-cost risk management solution. WII is widely promoted as eliminating moral hazard because payouts depend on external weather measurements rather than farm-level losses that farmers could affect. We challenge this conventional view by documenting a behavioral response we term “passive” moral hazard: farmers receiving the DT-WII bundle significantly reduced expenditures on agricultural inputs. This effect is concentrated among farmers who perceiveddrought conditions on their farms. Among those experiencing drought correctly detected by the index, reduced input use appears consistent with anticipation of insurance payouts. More concerningly, among farmers who perceived drought conditions that the index failed to capture, input reductions reflect moral hazard induced by real or perceived basis risk, as farmers reduced investments expecting compensation that never materialized. Hence, basis risk not only lowers the value of index insurance but also induces behavioral responses that leave farmers worse off, with important implications for the design of bundled technological and financial risk-management interventions.

AI.tldr: 通过印度奥里萨邦的随机对照试验，研究发现将抗旱水稻品种与天气指数保险捆绑提供时，农民会减少农业投入，出现"被动道德风险"。这种效应在感知到干旱但指数未能捕捉到的农民中尤为严重，导致他们因预期补偿而减少投资，但最终未获赔付。
AI.research_question: 抗旱水稻品种与天气指数保险的捆绑干预对农民投入决策有何影响？天气指数保险是否真的能消除道德风险？
AI.motivation: 天气指数保险被广泛推广为能消除道德风险的低成本风险管理工具，但本文挑战这一传统观点，探讨捆绑技术干预与金融工具可能引发的行为反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德风险理论、指数保险理论、行为经济学、风险感知与决策理论
AI.method: 印度奥里萨邦的集群随机对照试验，评估抗旱水稻品种单独使用及与天气指数保险捆绑使用的效果
AI.findings: 1. 接受DT-WII捆绑干预的农民显著减少农业投入支出；2. 这种效应集中在感知到农场干旱条件的农民中；3. 在指数正确检测到干旱的情况下，投入减少与预期保险赔付一致；4. 在指数未能捕捉到干旱感知的情况下，投入减少反映由基差风险引发的道德风险
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"被动道德风险"概念，挑战天气指数保险能消除道德风险的传统观点；2. 揭示基差风险不仅降低指数保险价值，还会引发使农民处境更糟的行为反应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为捆绑技术和金融风险管理干预的设计提供重要启示；2. 指出需要重新评估天气指数保险的实际效果；3. 强调在推广农业保险时需要考虑农民的风险感知和行为反应

title: Whole Genome Sequencing for Klebsiella pneumoniae Tunisian Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance System: Micro-Costing, Pragmatic Cost-Effectiveness, and Budget Impact Evaluation
affiliations: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, University of Oxford, University of Tunis and

detail.title: Whole Genome Sequencing for Klebsiella pneumoniae Tunisian Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance System: Micro-Costing, Pragmatic Cost-Effectiveness, and Budget Impact Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was granted by the Ministry of Health (MOH) in Tunisia (Authorization No. 0000021-080000-20-2023), the internationally recognized Ethics Committee of Charles Nicolle University Hospital (FWA00032748 and IORG0011243), and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM) Observational/Interventions Research Ethics Committee (Ref: 26901). Informed consent was waived as the study used anonymized, pre-existing surveillance data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.

detail.abstract:
​Background: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is a major public health threat in Africa, yet surveillance systems often rely on phenotypic and low-resolution technologies. Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) can support infection prevention and control (IPC) through its ability to infer transmission and detect and refute outbreaks. Despite its added value, the economic case in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) remains rare. We evaluated the cost-effectiveness and affordability of WGS for third-generation cephalosporin-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (3GCRKpn) within the Tunisian AMR surveillance system (TARSS). 

Methods: We conducted a micro-costing at the National Reference Laboratory of AMR (NRL) (2022), a pragmatic cost-effectiveness analysis from a hospital perspective (2018–2021), and a budget impact analysis across TARSS (hospital, NRL, and system levels). Outcomes included infection averted, cost per infection averted (CPIA), bed-days avoided, WGS net costs, and program affordability. One-way sensitivity (OWSA) and probabilistic analysis (PSA) were performed. 

Results: WGS costs $232 per test ($255 with 10% overhead), largely driven by consumables (57%). In the base case, WGS averted 3.3 infections and 16.5 bed-days, yielding $1,202 and a cost per-bed day avoided of $240. Cost-effectiveness was driven by operational (turnaround time and batch efficiency), transmission (cluster size and cluster-positive yield), and IPC effectiveness. In PSA, WGS was cost-effective in 63% and 87% of simulations at 1- and 2x Tunisia’s GDP per capita. Across all scenarios, WGS net costs remained <1% of annual budgets across all levels.

Conclusions: WGS is affordable and cost-effective for AMR surveillance in LMICs, particularly when the data is acted upon. Our findings support phased integration, prioritising rapid turnaround time, effective IPC responses, targeted deployment in high-transmission settings, and centralised financing to align incentives across the health system.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了全基因组测序（WGS）在突尼斯抗菌素耐药性监测系统中用于第三代头孢菌素耐药肺炎克雷伯菌监测的成本效益和可负担性，发现WGS具有成本效益且可负担，特别是在数据得到有效利用的情况下。
AI.research_question: 全基因组测序（WGS）在低收入和中等收入国家（如突尼斯）的抗菌素耐药性监测系统中是否具有成本效益和可负担性？
AI.motivation: 抗菌素耐药性（AMR）是非洲主要的公共卫生威胁，但现有监测系统通常依赖表型和低分辨率技术。WGS能够通过推断传播和检测/排除疫情来支持感染预防和控制，但在低收入和中等收入国家中，其经济合理性证据仍然缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架，包括微观成本核算、成本效益分析和预算影响分析，从医院、国家参考实验室和系统层面进行评估。
AI.method: 1）在国家AMR参考实验室进行微观成本核算（2022年）；2）从医院角度进行实用成本效益分析（2018-2021年）；3）在TARSS各层面（医院、NRL和系统层面）进行预算影响分析；4）进行单向敏感性分析和概率分析。
AI.findings: WGS每次测试成本为232美元（含10%间接费用为255美元），主要受耗材驱动（57%）。在基准情况下，WGS避免了3.3例感染和16.5个住院日，成本效益比为1,202美元，每个避免的住院日成本为240美元。成本效益受操作因素（周转时间和批次效率）、传播因素（集群规模和集群阳性率）以及IPC有效性影响。在概率分析中，WGS在63%（1倍人均GDP）和87%（2倍人均GDP）的模拟中具有成本效益。在所有情景中，WGS净成本均低于各层面年度预算的1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为低收入和中等收入国家中WGS用于AMR监测的经济评估提供了实证框架和方法学参考，填补了该领域研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持WGS在低收入和中等收入国家AMR监测系统中的分阶段整合，建议优先考虑快速周转时间、有效的IPC响应、在高传播环境中的针对性部署以及集中融资以协调卫生系统激励。

title: Pandemics, Inclusive Growth, and the Role of Public Health Expenditure: Evidence from Local Projections

detail.title: Pandemics, Inclusive Growth, and the Role of Public Health Expenditure: Evidence from Local Projections
detail.abstract: Pandemics cause severe shocks that hit vulnerable groups the hardest, yet there is still limited research on how public health spending can help mitigate these unequal impacts. This paper investigates the dynamic impact of pandemic shocks on inclusive growth (conceptualized through GDP per capita, disposable-income inequality, and household consumption) across low and high public health spending environments. Using the local projections method on a balanced panel of 114 countries from 2000 to 2019 our findings reveal that pandemics trigger significant and persistent losses in output and consumption, particularly in low-income economies. While disposable-income inequality shows no significant response, this stability itself is substantively meaningful: pandemic shocks compress incomes broadly across the distribution while automatic stabilizers partially cushion the lower tail, leaving the Gini unchanged even as absolute welfare deteriorates. Sharp declines in household consumption reveal this welfare deterioration, capturing dimensions of welfare loss that aggregate income metrics miss. Crucially, state-dependent local projections demonstrate that high public health expenditure acts as a critical automatic stabilizer. Countries with robust health financing exhibit minimal economic scarring, whereas low-spending regimes suffer deep, lasting contractions. These results position public health expenditure as a strategic investment in economic resilience rather than a mere social cost.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公共卫生支出是应对疫情冲击的关键自动稳定器，高支出国家经济受损轻微，而低支出国家则遭受深度持久的经济收缩。
AI.research_question: 公共卫生支出如何调节疫情冲击对包容性增长（人均GDP、可支配收入不平等、家庭消费）的动态影响？
AI.motivation: 疫情对弱势群体冲击最严重，但关于公共卫生支出如何缓解这种不平等影响的研究仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性增长理论、自动稳定器理论、公共卫生投资的经济韧性框架
AI.method: 使用局部投影法分析2000-2019年114个国家的平衡面板数据
AI.findings: 1. 疫情导致显著持久的产出和消费损失，低收入经济体尤为严重；2. 可支配收入不平等无显著变化，但这是收入普遍压缩与自动稳定器部分缓冲的综合结果；3. 家庭消费大幅下降揭示福利恶化；4. 高公共卫生支出国家经济受损轻微，低支出国家则遭受深度持久收缩
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共卫生支出重新定位为经济韧性的战略投资而非单纯社会成本，拓展了自动稳定器理论在公共卫生领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据支持增加公共卫生支出，特别是在低收入国家，以增强经济韧性并缓解疫情的不平等影响

title: The Participation Penalty: How High Structural Costs Exclude People and Firms From the Economy Paper 4 in the A-Series: The Participation Penalty

detail.title: The Participation Penalty: How High Structural Costs Exclude People and Firms From the Economy Paper 4 in the A-Series: The Participation Penalty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could be perceived to have influenced the analysis, arguments, or conclusions presented in this paper. The research was conducted independently and without any commercial, institutional, or political pressure. No personal relationships, advisory roles, or financial arrangements exist with organisations or individuals who might benefit from the findings or framing of this work. All interpretations and positions expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical interventions, or experimental procedures. It is a conceptual and structural analysis based on publicly available economic data, institutional reports, and secondary research. As such, formal ethics approval was not required. No personal or sensitive data were collected, processed, or analysed in the preparation of this work.

It was undertaken independently as part of the author’s ongoing work within the Capability Infrastructure Field and the Global Structure Network. No public, private, or philanthropic organisation provided financial support, and no funding body had any role in shaping the research design, analysis, or conclusions.

detail.abstract:
The Participation Penalty has become one of the most powerful — and least recognised — determinants of national competitiveness. It is the structural force that suppresses capability, slows economic velocity, and constrains the ability of households and firms to contribute to national strength. Participation is the quiet engine of every economy. It is the mechanism that converts capability into contribution, ambition into mobility, and human potential into national strength. Yet participation is increasingly constrained by the structural costs embedded in modern life. When these costs rise faster than incomes, faster than capabilities, and faster than the systems designed to support people and firms, participation collapses. What emerges is a participation penalty: a structural exclusion that narrows who can enter, remain in, and move through the economy.

 

The participation penalty is not a behavioural failure but a systemic one. Evidence from the OECD, IMF, and World Bank shows that stagnating youth participation, high SME capital costs, and administrative complexity suppress economic engagement more effectively than taxation or regulation alone. These are not failures of motivation; they are failures of affordability.

 

Participation is shaped by the cost of entry, the cost of risk, and the cost of staying in the system. When housing consumes half of income, workers cannot relocate for opportunity. When childcare costs exceed wages, parents — particularly women — exit the labour force. When capital costs are punitive, SMEs cannot invest or scale. When time costs are high, people avoid retraining. When systems are complex, people withdraw. Participation becomes a privilege rather than a baseline.

 

This paper argues that the participation penalty is now one of the most significant — and least understood — drivers of inequality, stagnation, and declining national competitiveness. It is the mechanism through which structural costs become structural exclusion. It explains why productivity gaps persist, why social mobility stalls, and why economies struggle to convert human capability into economic output.

 

Reducing the participation penalty is not a social intervention; it is a strategic intervention. Nations that lower the cost of participation expand their labour force, accelerate SME formation, increase innovation, and strengthen resilience. Nations that ignore it drift into low‑mobility, low‑trust, low‑growth equilibria.

 

Participation is not merely an economic variable; it is a civic one. The participation penalty erodes belonging, weakens confidence, and constrains capability. Affordability is the architecture of belonging, and belonging is the foundation of a competitive, resilient, and future‑ready economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"参与惩罚"概念，指结构性成本（住房、托儿、资本成本等）阻碍个人和企业参与经济，导致能力无法转化为贡献，成为国家竞争力的关键制约因素。
AI.research_question: 参与惩罚如何成为影响国家竞争力、不平等和经济停滞的关键结构性力量？
AI.motivation: 传统政策关注税收和监管，但忽视了结构性成本（住房、托儿、资本成本、行政复杂性）对经济参与的系统性抑制，这些成本增长快于收入和能力增长，导致参与崩溃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参与惩罚理论：将参与视为经济引擎，强调参与成本（进入成本、风险成本、维持成本）的结构性约束，以及从能力到贡献的转化机制受阻。
AI.method: 基于OECD、IMF和世界银行的证据分析，考察青年参与停滞、中小企业资本成本高、行政复杂性等系统性因素对经济参与的影响。
AI.findings: 参与惩罚是系统性而非行为性失败；结构性成本（住房占收入50%、托儿成本超过工资、高资本成本、时间成本、系统复杂性）导致经济参与从基线变为特权；这解释了生产率差距持续、社会流动性停滞、能力无法转化为产出的现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"参与惩罚"作为新的分析框架，将结构性成本与系统性排斥联系起来；重新定义参与不仅是经济变量也是公民变量；强调可负担性是归属感的架构，归属感是竞争力的基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 降低参与成本是战略干预而非社会干预；扩大劳动力、加速中小企业形成、增加创新、增强韧性；忽视参与惩罚会导致低流动性、低信任、低增长的均衡状态。

title: Affordability as Economic Infrastructure: Why Breathing Room Must Be Matched With Architecture

detail.title: Affordability as Economic Infrastructure: Why Breathing Room Must Be Matched With Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organisational conflicts of interest related to the development of this paper or the Capability Infrastructure Field.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper does not involve human participants, clinical data, or experimental research requiring ethics approval.

detail.abstract:
Affordability is not a price point. It is the upstream determinant of agency, bandwidth, and participation. In traditional economics, affordability is treated as a cost‑of‑living issue — a social concern, not a structural one. This paper reframes affordability as economic infrastructure: the precondition for mobility, the enabler of capability, and the first lever of national competitiveness.

When affordability collapses, households lose bandwidth, SMEs lose risk tolerance, and economies lose adaptive capacity. When affordability is strong, people move, firms innovate, and capability compounds across generations. Yet breathing room alone is insufficient. Without architecture, affordability dissipates into relief rather than transformation.

This paper introduces the doctrinal foundation of the Affordability Series within the Capability Infrastructure Field. It argues that affordability is a sovereign capability issue — the foundation upon which capability formation, mobility, and resilience depend. It shows why affordability must be matched with structural architecture, and why SMEs, households, and national economies cannot express capability without it.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义"可负担性"为经济基础设施，而非单纯的价格问题。它认为可负担性是能力形成、流动性和韧性的基础，当可负担性崩溃时，家庭、中小企业和整个经济都会失去适应能力。
AI.research_question: 如何将可负担性重新概念化为经济基础设施，以及它如何影响个人能力、企业创新和国家竞争力？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学将可负担性视为生活成本问题（社会关切而非结构性问题），这种观点忽略了可负担性作为经济基础设施的关键作用。需要重新框架化可负担性，以理解其对能力形成、流动性和国家竞争力的基础性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力基础设施领域理论、主权能力理论、经济基础设施理论、社会流动性理论
AI.method: 概念性分析、理论框架构建、文献综述、跨学科整合
AI.findings:
1. 可负担性不是价格点，而是决定能动性、带宽和参与度的上游因素
2. 可负担性崩溃导致家庭失去带宽、中小企业失去风险承受能力、经济失去适应能力
3. 可负担性需要结构性架构支持，否则会消散为救济而非转型
4. 可负担性是主权能力问题，是能力形成、流动性和韧性的基础
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将可负担性从生活成本问题重新概念化为经济基础设施
2. 建立了"可负担性系列"的教义基础
3. 发展了能力基础设施领域理论
4. 提出了可负担性与结构性架构的匹配理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了重新思考可负担性政策的框架
2. 帮助企业理解可负担性对创新和风险承受能力的影响
3. 为国家竞争力战略提供了新的视角
4. 为中小企业和家庭能力发展提供了理论基础

title: Principled Inference-Time Scaling: A Unified Framework for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Industrial Engineering & Operations Research (IEOR) and City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Management Sciences

detail.title: Principled Inference-Time Scaling: A Unified Framework for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising tool for automated optimization modeling. To provide a flexible and easy-to-deploy approach to LLM-based optimization modeling, we propose Exploration-Correction Optimization (ECO), a zero-shot framework that leverages hybrid inference-time scaling without requiring model fine-tuning. We develop a unified mathematical framework that formulates the LLM generation-evaluation pipeline as a stochastic process. This framework enables quantitative analysis of LLM behavior and informs the design of ECO. In a pilot study, we identify systematic behavioral differences across base LLMs, suggesting that effective inference-time scaling strategies depend on both model type and task characteristics. Guided by this analysis, we evaluate ECO on six representative opensource datasets using four representative base LLMs. For each experimental setting, the scaling structure is determined using a robust optimization criterion based on parameter estimates from the pilot study. The results show that ECO is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing methods, particularly on complex industrial-scale instances. Overall, our findings suggest that effective inference-time scaling can substantially improve automated optimization modeling with LLMs without fine-tuning. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ECO-LLM4OR-2025/ECO-2025.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECO框架，一种无需微调的零样本方法，通过混合推理时间缩放提升LLM在优化建模中的性能，在复杂工业实例上表现优异。
AI.research_question: 如何设计无需微调的有效推理时间缩放策略，以提升LLM在自动化优化建模中的性能？
AI.motivation: LLM在自动化优化建模中显示出潜力，但需要灵活易部署的方法。现有方法通常需要微调，限制了实际应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出统一的数学框架，将LLM生成-评估流程建模为随机过程，支持定量分析和ECO设计。
AI.method: 提出探索-校正优化（ECO）框架，采用混合推理时间缩放策略，基于试点研究确定缩放结构，使用鲁棒优化准则。
AI.findings: ECO在六个开源数据集和四个代表性LLM上表现优异，常优于现有方法，尤其在复杂工业实例上；试点研究发现LLM行为存在系统性差异，有效缩放策略取决于模型类型和任务特性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出将LLM生成-评估流程建模为随机过程的统一数学框架；2）为推理时间缩放策略设计提供理论指导；3）揭示了LLM在优化建模中的系统性行为差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供无需微调的灵活易部署的ECO框架；2）开源代码和数据集促进研究；3）在复杂工业实例上展示优越性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: Does Risk Type Determine AI Model Fit?

detail.title: Does Risk Type Determine AI Model Fit?
detail.abstract: We examine whether the data generating process (DGP) of insurance risk-rather than model complexity-determines the optimal AI model family for risk detection. Using two structurally distinct datasets, we compare statistical, classical machine learning, and deep learning models across a nine-model complexity spectrum. Dataset A reconstructs 34 quarters of Thailand non-life insurance market data (2016Q1-2024Q2), incorporating the COVID-19 solvency crisis that led to the regulatory revocation of four insurers and THB 60 billion in Insurance Guarantee Fund claims. Dataset B comprises 1,000 individual US insurance claims labelled for fraud. We find that in the Thailand systemic solvency setting, Logistic Regression with sequential input achieves identical performance (Recall = 1.000, F₁ = 0.917) to GRU and LSTM architectures with 15-25 times fewer parameters, with the performance ceiling determined by sequential feature engineering rather than architectural complexity. In the US fraud setting, Logistic Regression outperforms all classical ML models (AUC = 0.603 versus XGBoost 0.564), and SMOTE oversampling systematically degrades performance across five of six model configurations (ΔAUC =-0.003 to-0.045). SHAP analysis reveals orthogonal signal structures: Thai solvency risk is a momentum problem concentrated in claims velocity, while US fraud is a multi-dimensional crosssectional problem (Gini concentration index = 0.29). These results support a DGP-model fit hypothesis: systemic macro-shock risks require sequential input preservation; idiosyncratic micro-fraud risks are linearly separable and resist synthetic oversampling. We discuss implications for AI-based insurance regulation in emerging versus mature markets.

AI.tldr: 研究发现保险风险的数据生成过程（而非模型复杂度）决定了最优AI模型选择。在泰国系统性偿付能力危机中，逻辑回归与复杂深度学习模型表现相当但参数少15-25倍；在美国欺诈检测中，逻辑回归优于其他机器学习模型，且SMOTE过采样会降低性能。
AI.research_question: 保险风险的数据生成过程（而非模型复杂度）是否决定了风险检测的最优AI模型家族选择？
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型选择往往关注模型复杂度，但忽略了数据生成过程对模型性能的决定性作用。特别是在保险风险检测领域，不同风险类型（系统性偿付能力危机 vs. 个体欺诈）可能需要不同的模型方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: DGP-模型匹配假说：数据生成过程决定最优模型选择。系统性宏观冲击风险需要序列输入保留，而特异性微观欺诈风险是线性可分的且抵抗合成过采样。
AI.method: 使用两个结构不同的数据集：1）泰国34个季度的非寿险市场数据（包含COVID-19偿付能力危机）；2）1000个标记的美国保险欺诈索赔。比较统计模型、经典机器学习和深度学习模型，涵盖9个模型复杂度谱系，使用SHAP进行特征重要性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 泰国系统性偿付能力场景中，带序列输入的逻辑回归与GRU/LSTM表现相同（召回率=1.000，F₁=0.917），但参数少15-25倍；2. 美国欺诈检测中，逻辑回归优于所有经典ML模型（AUC=0.603 vs XGBoost 0.564）；3. SMOTE过采样在5/6模型配置中系统性降低性能；4. SHAP显示正交信号结构：泰国偿付能力是集中于索赔速度的动量问题，美国欺诈是多维横截面问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DGP-模型匹配假说，挑战了"模型复杂度越高性能越好"的传统观念，强调数据生成过程的决定性作用，为AI模型选择提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为保险公司提供模型选择指导：系统性风险用简单序列模型，欺诈风险用线性模型；2. 警告SMOTE过采样的潜在危害；3. 为新兴市场与成熟市场的AI保险监管提供差异化建议。

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Doctrine of Doctrinal Formation, a structural framework for understanding how legitimate intellectual systems are formed, sustained, and evaluated under conditions of temporal compression and artificial amplification. The doctrine advances a central claim: that doctrinal integrity is not a function of output alone, but of the alignment between knowledge expansion, judgment refinement, moral responsibility, physiological constraint, and author formation.

The analysis distinguishes between production and formation, demonstrating that while artificial intelligence increases the speed and scale of intellectual output, it does not alter the underlying requirements of authorship. Judgment, responsibility, and the formation of coherent frameworks remain inherently human processes. Accordingly, the paper establishes the Non-Transferability Principle, which holds that responsibility for doctrinal origination cannot be delegated to artificial systems.

Building on this foundation, the paper develops an integrated system model in which knowledge expands, judgment refines, moral burden anchors responsibility, strain operates as a structural constraint, and author formation provides the capacity necessary to sustain coherence. Within this model, artificial intelligence functions as an amplification layer—accelerating processing and iteration without assuming authorship, responsibility, or moral burden.

The doctrine further identifies the Coherence–Strain Tradeoff, demonstrating that systems capable of high-coherence output reduce coordination costs while concentrating cognitive and physiological strain within the author. This relationship is refined through a distinction between single-domain and multi-domain coherence, establishing that integrative complexity increases non-linearly as domains expand.

The paper concludes by positioning doctrinal formation as a necessary precondition for
intellectual sovereignty. It argues that as systems of production accelerate, the preservation of
formation becomes essential to maintaining legitimacy, accountability, and coherence. The
doctrine therefore serves both as an analytical framework and as a temporal anchor, enabling
future intellectual output to be evaluated against the presence or absence of formation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"教义形成学说"，这是一个理解在时间压缩和人工放大条件下合法知识体系如何形成、维持和评估的结构框架。核心主张是：教义的完整性不仅取决于产出，还取决于知识扩展、判断精炼、道德责任、生理约束和作者形成之间的协调。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能加速知识产出的时代，合法知识体系如何形成、维持和评估？人工智能能否承担教义起源的责任？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能加速知识生产，需要理解在时间压缩和人工放大条件下，合法知识体系的形成机制，以维护知识主权、问责制和连贯性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教义形成学说、非转移性原则（责任不能委托给人工系统）、连贯性-压力权衡、单域与多域连贯性区分、集成系统模型（知识扩展、判断精炼、道德负担、压力约束、作者形成）。
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，通过理论论证区分生产与形成，建立结构模型分析各要素间关系。
AI.findings: 1. 人工智能加速产出但不改变作者身份的基本要求；2. 责任不可转移给人工系统；3. 高连贯性产出降低协调成本但集中认知生理压力于作者；4. 多域整合复杂性随领域扩展非线性增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了教义形成学说作为分析框架，建立了非转移性原则和连贯性-压力权衡理论，区分了单域与多域连贯性，为知识主权理论提供了新基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估人工智能时代的知识产出提供了分析工具，帮助维护知识体系的合法性、问责制和连贯性，为政策制定和教育实践提供指导。

detail.abstract: We leverage a quasi-natural experiment from India on introduction of free bus schemes for women across five states to study its impact on women's workforce participation. We use two rounds of the representative Time Use Survey (2019 and 2024) and a triple difference estimation strategy, complemented by an event study framework to identify the causal relationship of interest. Findings reveal that the bus scheme was successful in improving women's paid work participation and duration of employment. We confirm that these results are not merely a continuation of prior trends. The scheme's effects are concentrated among early adopters like Punjab and Tamil Nadu, two states with historically different levels of women's workforce participation. We also find disproportionately higher effects for women residing in more patriarchal districts with higher mobility restrictions. We argue that the scheme works through easing of non-financial binding constraints, which lowers barriers to women's mobility and workforce participation.

AI.tldr: 印度五个邦推出女性免费公交计划，通过三重差分法和事件研究法发现该政策显著提高了女性有偿工作参与率和就业时长，特别是在父权制较强、流动性限制较多的地区效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 女性免费公交计划对女性劳动力参与率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究女性流动性限制如何影响劳动力市场参与，探索非财务约束在性别就业差距中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性约束理论、性别与劳动力市场理论、非财务约束对女性就业的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用印度五个邦引入女性免费公交计划的准自然实验，采用2019年和2024年两轮时间使用调查数据，运用三重差分估计策略和事件研究框架进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 1. 免费公交计划显著提高了女性有偿工作参与率和就业时长；2. 效果在早期采纳邦（旁遮普邦和泰米尔纳德邦）更为集中；3. 在父权制较强、流动性限制较多的地区效果更明显；4. 结果不是先前趋势的延续。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了非财务约束对女性劳动力参与的重要性；2. 揭示了流动性限制在性别就业差距中的关键作用；3. 为政策干预缓解女性就业障碍提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府设计促进女性就业的政策提供实证依据；2. 表明交通补贴等非财务干预可以有效提高女性劳动力参与；3. 为其他发展中国家解决性别就业差距提供政策参考。

detail.abstract: Ethiopia's artificial intelligence (AI) policy represents a significant step forward in national digital governance; our study has, however, identified gaps in areas such as linguistic justice and AI safeguards. We investigate the performance of large language models in detecting hate speech in Ethiopian languages-Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Tigrigna-and their amenability to produce hate speech. Large language models are less effective at detecting hate speech in non-English contexts and can be easily manipulated to create hate speech, raising serious online safety concerns. Upon careful analysis of the policy, we propose ASPIRE, a series of recommendations for updating the policy to address these concerns: adapting policy to the digital sphere, strengthening linguistic inclusivity, preventing AI misuse, improving infrastructure, resourcing media literacy and training, and emphasising overlaps with hate speech governance. Failure to recognize online harms as integral to AI development leaves a policy vacuum that could undermine long-term development goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了埃塞俄比亚AI政策在语言正义和AI安全方面的不足，测试了大语言模型在埃塞俄比亚语言（阿姆哈拉语、奥罗莫语、提格里尼亚语）中检测和生成仇恨言论的能力，发现模型在非英语语境下效果较差且易被操纵产生仇恨言论，提出了ASPIRE政策更新建议。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在埃塞俄比亚语言（阿姆哈拉语、奥罗莫语、提格里尼亚语）中检测和生成仇恨言论的能力如何？埃塞俄比亚AI政策应如何更新以解决语言正义和AI安全方面的不足？
AI.motivation: 埃塞俄比亚的AI政策在数字治理方面迈出了重要步伐，但存在语言正义和AI安全方面的不足。大语言模型在非英语语境下检测仇恨言论效果较差，且易被操纵生成仇恨言论，这引发了严重的在线安全问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字治理理论、语言正义理论、AI伦理与安全框架、仇恨言论治理理论。
AI.method: 对埃塞俄比亚AI政策的文本分析；测试大语言模型在三种埃塞俄比亚语言（阿姆哈拉语、奥罗莫语、提格里尼亚语）中检测和生成仇恨言论的性能评估。
AI.findings: 1. 大语言模型在非英语语境下检测仇恨言论效果较差；2. 大语言模型容易被操纵生成仇恨言论；3. 埃塞俄比亚AI政策存在语言正义和AI安全方面的政策真空。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了AI伦理和语言正义理论在非英语多语言环境中的应用；2. 提出了数字治理与仇恨言论治理的交叉理论框架；3. 丰富了发展中国家AI政策评估的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了ASPIRE政策建议：适应数字领域、加强语言包容性、防止AI滥用、改善基础设施、提供媒体素养培训资源、强调与仇恨言论治理的重叠。这些建议有助于填补政策真空，支持埃塞俄比亚的长期发展目标。

detail.abstract:
This executive institutional brief analyzes federal findings and remediation economics across four major banking cases: Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Capital One, and TD Bank. The paper argues that these cases do not primarily reflect isolated AML/BSA failures, but instead reveal a deeper financial-crimes operating-model breakdown: failure to reliably convert customer knowledge into risk understanding, risk understanding into monitoring, monitoring into investigation, investigation into reporting, reporting into governance, and governance into proof.


Drawing on publicly available enforcement materials and bank-disclosed financial information, the brief identifies a shared pattern of weak customer-risk understanding, weak suspicious-activity monitoring, weak monitoring-to-reporting conversion, weak governance and independent challenge, weak workflow and data infrastructure, and weak proof that the program functioned effectively over time. It further distinguishes between direct documented burden, disclosed cost reservoirs, hidden but validated cost categories, and conservative modeled savings.


The paper concludes that the real opportunity is not patchwork compliance repair, but redesign of the financial-crimes conversion chain itself. It frames the problem as one of legibility, defensibility, and governable scale, and positions the analysis as a strategic contribution to institutional financial-crimes redesign thinking

AI.tldr: 该执行机构简报分析了美国四大银行（美国银行、富国银行、第一资本、道明银行）的反洗钱/银行保密法案例，指出这些案例并非孤立的合规失败，而是揭示了金融犯罪运营模式的系统性崩溃：无法将客户知识转化为风险理解、风险理解转化为监控、监控转化为调查、调查转化为报告、报告转化为治理、治理转化为证据的完整链条失效。
AI.research_question: 美国四大银行的反洗钱/银行保密法执法案例揭示了什么更深层次的金融犯罪运营模式问题？这些案例中的合规失败模式有何共同特征？如何从经济学角度分析这些案例的补救成本？
AI.motivation: 通过对美国银行、富国银行、第一资本、道明银行四大银行的联邦执法案例进行分析，揭示金融犯罪合规不仅仅是技术性失败，而是整个运营模式的系统性崩溃，为金融机构重新设计金融犯罪防控体系提供战略思考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融犯罪运营模式理论、合规经济学理论、风险转化链条理论、治理有效性理论、成本分类分析框架（直接记录负担、披露成本储备、隐藏但验证的成本类别、保守建模节省）
AI.method: 基于公开可得的执法材料和银行披露的财务信息进行案例分析，采用比较分析方法识别四大银行案例中的共同模式，运用成本分类框架进行经济学分析。
AI.findings:

title: Paper 7 -The Architecture of Affordability
